description:
Step into a thoughtfully designed home in the heart of Istanbul. This second floor two bedroom apartment combines modern comfort, smart practicality, and inviting details, offering a peaceful retreat within one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Ideal for both short stays and longer visits.

Whether you are here to explore the city or work remotely, everything you need for a seamless and comfortable stay is right at your fingertips.

reviews.text:
The apartment was clean, comfortable bed & pillows, & responsive team.
The location is convenient yet away from Galata crowds.

Apartment was exactly as described, light and bright and spacious and spotlessly clean. Clear communication with host throughout. Only minor con were the noisy neighbours above and noise from the street.

The staff that assisted with the place including the lady cleaner and the gentlemen I think his name is recep were very good at their jobs and extremely helpful. The place was very comfortable and walking distance to all that we needed.
Highly recommend this place to anyone that wants to stay in the galata area

Central and perfect location, yet in a very calm street.
Cozy feeling inside the apartment with all the basic equipment you may need for a short or longer stay.
Host is very reactive and friendly
A very good value for money, thanks for welcoming us.

We spent a family vacation in istanbul and stayed at noa.
great location, has everything you need for a comfortable stay. The owners are always in touch, all our requests were always taken into account

description: The flat is located in one of the most central areas in Taksim, Istanbul. The flat is recently furnished with brand new furnitures. It includes private terrace, dinner table, smart tv, fridge, electrical oven, washing machine etc.. Guests can find anything (cafes, bars, restaurants, museums, sights (Galata Tower, Taksim Square, etc.), metro&bus&tram in walking distance 5-15 min by walking from the flat. Self-check-in is possible for this apartment

reviews.text:
The apartment generally matches the photos, but they are taken from angles that make everything look much better than it actually is.
As mentioned in other reviews, you can indeed hear the club from inside the apartment. If you plan to stay there in the summer and sleep with the window slightly open, it will be very noisy—something to keep in mind. The bedroom, however, is relatively quiet, and it was possible to sleep there comfortably with the window closed.
Cleanliness could be improved. Overall, the apartment is tidy, but it clearly needs a deep cleaning. There were black hairs on the bed, although the linens smelled freshly washed
The kitchen is equipped with everything necessary for cooking
The location is great: lots of cafés, beautiful streets, and shops nearby. We really enjoyed walking around the area. There is also a metro station not far away.
The price was objectively lower than other apartments in the area, so overall I would rate this accommodation as acceptable.

Good location to see Istanbul,very close to Taksim square.
Would not recommend to older people, there is no elevator in the building. The appartement is on the 4th floor. Alot of noise at night because of the nightclub downstairs, not for light sleepers.
The appartement was fairly clean and the host was very friendly. Check the code for the entrance with the host before you arrive. Great wifi and big terrace!

Konumu gerçekten çok iyi, Taksim’de merkezi ve kısa süreli konaklama için oldukça uygun bir ev. İlk girişte ev henüz temizlenmemişti, ancak ev sahibiyle iletişime geçince aynı gün hızlıca temizlendi. Ev genel olarak rahat ve ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her şey mevcut. Yaşadığımız bazı iletişim aksaklıkları dışında konaklamamızdan memnun kaldık.
Such a wonderful place! Great location, clean and looks bigger than the photos! Anıl was a lovely host & check-in was very easy! I'd recommend to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Great stay in the center of Istanbul. Place felt like home for a couple days. Had all the necessities and was very clean. The bed was comfortable and the balcony was very nice and spacious. The Apartment was a 1 minute walk from İstiklal Street and a 7 minute walk to Taksim. Transport was everywhere. The location was so convenient. Would definitely recommend and would stay here again. Great value.

description: This special apartment is a beatiful travel adress where you can feel at home and stay in peace and cantral location. Bathroom with private hottub, 2 bedrooms, work area, netflix, coffee machine and equipped kitchenware. It is 2 minutes away from the metro,ıstiklal street and Galata tower. There are many restaurants, pharmacies, cafes, markets and shops around.Despite its central location, it is on a quiet street.

reviews.text:
We were welcomed by a very responsive and friendly host. Check-in was very easy and location was easy to find. The bathroom had a very clean luxurious bath and spacious shower. The kitchen had a lot of appliances like coffee maker, kettle and some essential kitchenware. All appliances in the appartment were new and in excellent shape. The bedrooms were a bit too tight on space, but had large beds. The appartment had a beautiful style to make it look like right at home.
The downside of the place is the ground location. It has very high humidity and very bad cell connection. Humidity was fixable by two good ACs which helped to dry the air and dryer to dry our clothes and towels. Cell signal was very weak and we had to rely of Wi-Fi which was also not the most stable.
Overall it is very great worth appartment. Private bath and walkable distance to all Taksim/Galata attractions greatly overweight all the downsides.

The apartment was clean and as described. It is very centrally located, within easy walking distance of most of everything we wanted to see and do. It is a basement apartment, and there was some noise from upstairs neighbors, but nothing more than you'd expect. The property managers were responsive and helpful with a few minor issues that arose. I would definitely stay in the space again.

Lovely place, everything was as described and easily found, right at the heart of the tourist area. Very close to everything you’d want to visit.
Place was very clean and all amenities were available. We had the WiFi stop working but the host was kind enough to come and fix it right away while weren’t there. I definitely recommend to anyone looking to explore the tourist parts of Istanbul.
Thank you for having us!

Very near to everything! So close to Galata Port and Galata Tower. Love the jacuzzi. A few things to note, there is a wood shop directly across the alley and hammering begins pretty early in the morning but if you have a white noise machine or use your phone to play white noise it helps drowned out the ruckus. There is no air conditioner in one bedroom, the air conditioner in the second bedroom was broken and the air conditioner in the living room drips. Luckily I came during cooler weather and the host brought us a fan. The water is super hot with amazing water pressure. The place is adorable, in a good location and the host is very responsive.

We had a great stay overall and would definitely recommend this place, especially if you’re looking for an apartment with a private jacuzzi. The location was convenient, with metro and bus connections nearby, making it easy to explore the city. The host was very responsive, always replied quickly, recommended nearby stores, and gave clear instructions on how to reach the apartment by public transportation.
The jacuzzi was definitely the highlight of our stay. We used it every day after long days of sightseeing, and it was the main reason we booked this apartment. It completely lived up to our expectations and is what really makes this place stand out.
There were only a few minor downsides. We could sometimes hear the neighbors’ children running upstairs. Slippers were not provided even though the floor was cold, so we bought our own. Disposable slippers would be a nice addition. There was also no toothpaste, but the host told us where to buy some nearby.

description: Our apartment is located on the 5th floor of a 5-storey building. The other apartments in the building belong to us and are rented as Airbnb. There is an elevator in the building and it is in a quiet and central location. By choosing our apartment, you will have a comfortable stay for your family and be close to the unique beauties and most popular tourist attractions of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Great location – just 5-10 minutes walk from Galata Tower and the heart of Beyoğlu, perfect for exploring. On the 5th floor with a nice Bosphorus view and surprisingly little street noise.
However, cleanliness and maintenance issues spoiled the stay. The apartment hadn’t been deep-cleaned: dust everywhere, walls cracked and peeling from dampness (clear sign of neglect), kitchen utensils dirty, chipped/cracked glasses, and bathroom towels with rust-like stains. Bedroom had uncovered electrical outlets that looked unsafe and messy.
Bathroom problems were the worst: broken toilet flush (I had to fix it myself via host messages), occasional sewage smell. The balcony (source of the view) was covered in large seagull droppings with no netting or deterrent – one gull even flew into the glass as we closed the door. The balcony door itself is hard to close and lock securely.
For this price and prime location, much better care is expected. Wouldn’t recommend until fixed.

First: The location is exactly as described, very clean, and close to all the beautiful places in Istanbul.
Second and most importantly: Ismail is a very respectable person, always responsive to your needs, and guides you with any questions or inquiries you have.
Finally, I enjoyed dealing with Ismail and wish to continue dealing with him in the future for anything through him. I will be very happy and excited to do so because he is a very respectable and highly trustworthy person.

I had a wonderful stay at this property. The host was very responsive and accommodating, making the check-in process smooth and hassle-free. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. It was well-equipped with everything I needed for my stay, and the location was convenient with easy access to nearby attractions.
I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable experience. Thank you for being such a great host!

The location of Ismail's flat – in the heart of the Beyoglu district – is truly the best starting point for exploring Istanbul. The main shopping street (Istiklal) and Galataport, as well as the underground station (Sishane) and tram stop (Tophane), are a five-minute walk away, while the main square (Taksim) and ferry station (Karaköy) are a fifteen-minute walk away. The flat itself is really spacious, much larger in reality than the photos suggest. It is clean, well-equipped. The only thing we missed was a proper duvet, as there is only a bedspread available. As it is located on the fifth floor of a building with a lift, the terrace offers an incredible view not only of the sea, the harbour and the Bosphorus, but also of Istanbul's most important sights such as Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and Topkapi. It is incredibly quiet, with no traffic noise, only the ship horns, the seagulls screeching and muezzin's call to prayer. If we come back to Istanbul, we would love to stay here again!

We had a wonderful experience with our host. The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The location was also excellent. Our host was very attentive, regularly checking in to see if we needed anything. He even booked a taxi for us to the airport. When my son developed a fever during our stay, the host was very caring and frequently asked about his well-being. We truly appreciated his kindness and hospitality.
Whenever we return, we will definitely stay here again, and we’ll gladly recommend this place to our friends as well.

description:
Comfy one bedroom flat, 10 minutes walk to Taksim, central location in Cihangir,
Compact, user-friendly & cozy. Recently renovated
10 min. walking distance to Taksim metro station, centrally located in Cihangir neighborhood & newly restored.

reviews.text:
Tarik was very helpful and attentive. Great location if you are taking the bus from the airport to Taksim, just a 10 min walk (not too hilly and no stairs to/from taksim).
Very safe and lively neighborhood, plenty of coffee shops, grocery stores, restaurants, etc. yet quiet enough to rest and sleep. 10 min walk to Istiklal st. and 20 min walk to Galata tower.
The apartment is in the basement level, barely 20 steps down if you come with luggage. Well equipped, it has all necessary items (including clothes iron). Bathroom is remodeled and functional, shower does not flood the floor and works perfectly. Soap and shampoo provided by the host.
Interior bedroom has no view (window to inside patio) but it is protected from street noise, perfect for sleeping. Exactly what we were looking for. Fan at night took care of heat. Overall, a great place to stay. Comfortable and very convenient. Would definitely recommend to friends and would be back even for longer stays. Thanks, Tarik!

Tarik was a great host; very responsive to my questions and very friendly.
The apartment is as it looks in the photos. Water was nice and hot with strong pressure, and the heating in the apartment is more than enough for winter stays. It has all the amenities needed, the best was the heated towel rack, made towels and laundry easy. The bedroom gets dark enough, and although it can be quite loud in the living room, the bedroom is very quiet.
The location is great, in nice neighbourhood and right next to a supermarket and many cafes. Taksim is only a 9 minutes walk away. The Havaist Bus stop at Taksim is a ~15min walk away with luggage, so very convenient.
The apartment could be a little cleaner, particularly on the dining table and in the bathroom, but it is a minor complaint. The apartment is also in the basement level, so there is not much sunlight in the apartment (we went during winter).
Overall a great apartment, mainly due to the location and the many amenities available.

We stayed 11 days at Tarik’s flat and it was a nice and pleasent stay. The location is amazing, Taksim is right around the corner and the metro station is down the hill. Walking home from the metro station can be quiet exhausting because of the hill but it’s no too big deal. The flat was very clean, had everything you need for your stay and Tarik was very friendly and helpful. The only disadvantage in summertime is the missing air conditioning which was a bit uncomfortable because of the hot days in Istanbul but Tarik provided the flat with a fan which is a plus. I’d recommend it anytime.

This apartment is very comfortable, clean and in a great location. The open-floor design makes it spacious and efficient. It also has absolutely everything one may need to feel at home. Heating is really good and Internet works very well. The water pressure in the bathroom is also really good.
Location couldn't be better as the apartment is very close and within walking distance to public transportation (Taksim and Kabatas), coffee houses, restaurants, bars and supermarkets.
Tarik is an excellent host who besides being truly friendly and kind, he treated us as friends from the moment we met.
Absolutely recommended.

My husband and I were staying at Tarek’s place for a month and from the moment we met Tarek we realized why we had read so many great reviews about his unique personality and unforgettable hospitality. He speaks English very well and communicates clearly which made it so easy for us to contact him with any questions.
The place looks exactly the same as photos and it has most amenities needed for every day living! But I think some more kitchen stuff could be added to make it more functional. Like knifes and spoons and maybe pot lid! But I am hundred percent sure he will take care of it for the future guests. The place is so homey and well designed and the neighborhood is so safe, quiet with lots of restaurants and cafes in walking distances. The only real issue that we experienced staying there was the fact that this flat is located below ground level which makes the air flow and circulation almost impossible. Tarek put this Ionizer machine to reduce the humidity, but the air still feels heavy and stale especially in the bedroom. Of course it has a lot to do with us being there during the heat wave and if you know Istanbul’s weather you will know how hot and humid it can get. Despite the little issues we had, we fully and truly enjoyed our stay and we will definitely recommend this place with it’s amazing host! Thank you Tarek!

description: I look forward to hosting you in these comfortable and central rooms.

reviews.text:
Mehmet's place was a great a relaxing way to spend a few days. It's a short walk from Taksim Square, with easy connections to the airport and both sides of the city.
Happy with the price I paid for a place with a washing machine, a larger TV, and well connected. It's a quick walk from the nightlife streets Beyoğlu, but out of the way. The apartment is on the ground level with a window directly to the street, but never really had a problem with noise, even when I slept in til the afternoon. Plenty of towels or extra toilet paper and trash bags available in the hall.
I think the bathroom/shower floor is level, but if you spend an extra 20–30 seconds with the squeegee-sweeper it all dries quickly. Had some Wi-Fi issues with my Fire TV stick behind the TV (against the wall), but signal was good otherwise around the apartment for multiple devices. These are fixable or easy-to-deal-with issues, so I still consider the place 5* for the price and location.
Would stay again.

Mehmet was very frenetic and responsive, the place is worth the money, neat and clean, host was also honest before confirming the booking about the short coming of property, mainly the internet was weak, but wasnt an issue at all, everything was good and definitely recommend it if you wanna stay nearby Taksim Square, it’s walking distance from the Airport Bus Terminal

Mehmet is an amazing host. he is helpful and provided me even more than it was listed in the amenities. He is very fast responded and my room was ready before check in time.
when I arrived, the next morning was raining and the smell of rain and the beautiful and peaceful window to the Alley made the experience feeling cozy and I enjoyed my coffee at the window.
the room walls are thick so at night I could sleep perfectly good without any disturbing noise.
the kitchen has also a window for ventilation which is good.
the bathroom was clean when I arrived .
because the housese in Turkey are mostly old , the bathroom pipe sometimes has a smell but even that was fixed by using a plastic at the drain cap .
overall I am satisfied and I continue booking this place again and again!

Place was exactly as the pictures, Also Mehmet was super nice and helpful and proactive to adjusts what I need. Neighborhood is close to so many touristic places so I totally recommend it. Don’t forget that when I did the check in , the place was so clean and smell it good!
The place was exactly like in the pictures. It was clean, good location and Mehmet was friendly and always responsive

description:
Our apartment with 3 Bedrooms & 2 Bathrooms is at the elegant 19th century building near Istiklal Street, renovated and decorated in 2024, can accommodate up-to 7 person in comfort.
Literally steps away to many spots, such as Istiklal Street, Galata Tower, Metro, Tram and even Ferries.
We designed this apartment for families and family gatherings who prefer a peaceful stay in a central location. Baby cot & high chair can be provided.

reviews.text:
The apartment is in a fantastic location, very close to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, with plenty of great restaurants nearby and lots of things to do. It was generally tidy and clean, although there was a slight unpleasant smell in the bathroom. Another downside was the low water pressure, which made it difficult to wash your hair, and the air conditioning wasn’t working. Also, if you plan to take a midday nap, you’ll definitely need an eye mask, as there are no blinds to block out the light.
The beds were very comfortable, and the host was extremely helpful and responsive—even assisting us late at night when we had an issue with the heating. He also prepared a useful guide for Istanbul, which we really appreciated.
Overall, if you’re looking for good value for money in a prime location, I would recommend this place.

We stayed five nights with our family in this apartment. We can say with confidence that everything was perfect. The apartment is clean, spacious and well maintained. The kitchen has all the necessary tools to cook, the bathrooms were clean and the beds / pillows were comfortable. It has a cozy vibe so you will easily feel yourself at home.
The location of this apartment is close to the Istiqlal street and restaurants and shops are nearby. However, the location is in a quiet street so you won’t hear traffic and people outside. Also, there are a lot of local places nearby where you also pay local prices. There is a bus station on the main road (-5 minutes walking) which will take you directly to Sultanahmet or other places in Istanbul. The closest metro stations (Taksim and Şişhane) are approximately 15 minutes walking.
If you will stay here, I recommend also recommend you to book the airport transfer as it will save you a lot of hassle and time, especially when you are with family.

The apartment at Beyoglu was very good. Comfy beds, good heating, great wifi and a really good kitchen for a family to use. Lots of little markets nearby. A great Kebapci and Borekci less than 5 mins walk away. A Lokanta at the end of the street that makes very good and very cheap food. 10 mins walk to Istiklal Ceddisi and another 10 to Taksim. Great access to public transport. The bus stops are very close and you can catch one to Eminunu with only 4 stops in between. Ubers are super cheap to the apartment as well. Galata Tower nearby easily walkable. We walked to Dolmabache easily, all downhill and Uber back is what we usually did.
The building has its quirks, the stairs are very steep but they give you a great workout and it can be noisy but this is what comes with an old building. The price is great and when comparing to what a place like this rents for in Australia it is a real bargain!
We loved our our stay and we felt immersed in the Taksim neighbourhood.

The apartment is clean and cozy as described. It is complete with amenities and you will feel like it is your own. The hosts are responsive and giving a very clear instructions about do’s and don’ts of our stay. However, the neighboorhoods were sometimes a bit noisy but it is tolerable. By the way, the apartment is on the third floor ( as described I think).
** There was just a bit of misundertanding on later part of our stay (airport transfer).
But overall I would recommend this Airbnb, it is budget friendly, clean and cozy, and it is just 10-15 walk going to some tourist spots that is a must visit when you are in Istanbul. ( Istiklal Street, Galata Tower, Taksim square).

The apartment was very clean and accommodating for our family. The location was perfect - in walkable proximity to many tourist sights and shopping, yet, in a very traditional and authentic neighborhood. The owners were very quick to respond and helpful.
There are a couple small convenience stores that work till late just around the corner.
The transfer from and to the airport is an extra service that is offered and it was totally worth it! Just make sure that the driver knows your address to avoid any confusion and wrong drop off as the owners have several Airbnbs.
The overall stay was great and the apartment felt very cosy and comfortable to return to after a busy day of exploring the city! Thank you for your hospitality!

description:
Experience the perfect stay in Istanbul's historic peninsula!

This booking offers a modern room in Old Town Istanbul, neighboring the historic monuments such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and more.

The tram station around the corner is your easy access to the other side of the Golden Horn for the Galata Tower, Galataport, Istanbul Modern Museum, nightlife, and shopping.

With our daily cleaning and dedicated concierge service, we ensure a memorable vacation!

reviews.text: The location was perfect. Very easy to get to, close to all the major sightseeing locations. The room itself was nice and the host was very helpful and responsive. Our only complaint is the bathroom. It wasn't the cleanest shower or toilet. After a hot Istanbul day you want nothing more than to go take a clean refreshing shower and unfortunately the dingy bathroom made this difficult. For the price and location, it cant be beat, just bring some shower shoes.
Location is perfect. The room its self was clean and comfortable and very cosy. Looks exactly like the pictures. Very easy check in and out process. Highly recommend.

Great option, especially for those who visiting Istanbul for the first time, as it is within walking distance of the main attractions.
The hosts are very responsive and polite.
The apartment is clean and fully corresponds to the photos.
I recommend it.

Elif's place was great for me and my wife to explore Istanbul while having a compact and comfortable place to crash.
we loved the place for it's price value and a great location very close to grand Bazaar and hagia Sophia, plus a tram stop right out the door.
Elif was a very responsive host and provided all necessary info proactively. one thing to note is that the street the building is on, does not allow cars or private vehicles. it is however less than a block away to the cross street and can be very easily approached on foot.
very friendly and responsible, thank you Elif for your hosting it was amazing and pleasure to stay at this hotel., very clean, cozy room, nice location, next time for sure i will come back 👍🏻👍🏻🫶🏻

description:
Looking for a charming and relaxing stay in the heart of İstanbul? Discover our inviting one-bedroom flat nestled in vibrant Cihangir.

Ideal for couples, solo travelers, and business guests, this thoughtfully designed apartment offers comfort and convenience. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen for home-cooked meals or delicious local takeout, unwind in the cozy living area, and savor a drink on your private balcony after a day in the city.

reviews.text: The place was quite good. The best part is location a short walk uphill and you’re on a lively street with plenty of restaurants and small shops. The downside - the place is actually slightly older than it looks on the photos, and there was cigarets smell in the flat. It is located on 2nd floor with quite steep stairs, so might be challenging for people with heavy luggage. But in overall positive experience, good value for money, responsive host.

The flat was clean and the two balconies made my stay much more enjoyable. Everything looks exactly like they are described. I enjoyed it. A few things were missing in the kitchen like cups but the host immediately provided them upon request. As said it is a nice, clean and comfortable flat. However, I was not aware the other flats in the building were also rented out through the Airbnb. The issue with this is that there are people checking in and out, arriving and making noise any time of the day and often in the middle of the night but you have no reception to call and ask for intervention. I stayed more than a week and worked remotely and this became a problem as I could not sleep until 2-3 in the morning. When I contacted the host they replied friendly and said they would contact the guests but this happens hours later - half a day in my case - and after you have already lost your sleep. If you stay short and are a tourist this might not bother you. For long stays be aware.

The place was exactly as described and pictured, and it's in a great location. It was clean and and a nice comfortable place to call home for a few days. The host was easy to communicate with and very helpful.

The appartment is very well located, near to many coffees and shops. i had an issue with the AC and internet, but they were very responsive to fix both issues.
Inside the appartment is very clean and comfortable..ok for one or two

Hello everyone!
We had a wonderful stay! The location is fantastic—just one street away from Cihangir Square and very close to Taksim, the metro, and the Grand Bazaar. The neighborhood felt safe, quiet, and pleasant.
The apartment was clean, newly renovated, comfortable, and had everything we needed, including plenty of storage and all the essentials for a great stay.
We didn’t meet the host in person, but we had complete privacy and the host was always very quick and helpful whenever we had a question or needed anything.
There is currently some road construction in front of the building, but it didn’t affect our stay at all.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and well-maintained apartment in a great location!

description: Welcome to our stylish and inviting 1-bedroom apartment in the heart of Ortaköy.Whether you're a couple seeking a romantic getaway,a small group of friends,or a family exploring the city,our space is designed to offer modern comfort and breathtaking Bosphorus views for up to four guests.Our apartment features a spacious living room with comfortable seating that doubles as sleeping arrangements for two additional guests.This versatility makes our space perfect for couples friends or small familie

reviews.text:
We stayed here for a few evenings as a family. The apartment was clean, and although the living area is quite compact, it was sufficient for our needs. The kitchen was adequately equipped for basic cooking. We didn’t experience any parking issues and were able to park in front of the building. We also appreciated the flexible check-in time and the self check-in option.
Regarding the location, the narrow and steep streets made both walking and driving a bit challenging for us. The bathroom does not have ventilation. The heating unit is located near the head of the bed, so light sleepers may notice some noise.

Mert was a great host. He communicated with me before my stay and allowed me to have an early check in. I needed help to find a pharmacy and Mert was able to provide directions to the nearest one.
The accommodation was great and like the photos. There was an issue with the water pressure towards the end of my stay due to a leak and Mert communicated this to me.
He also fixed the wifi issue when I raised it.

This was an excellent stay. The place had everything reported in the ad. Mert was very helpful. The place was clean and everything was new. It was definitely worth the money and I would stay here again.
The only thing to be concerned about might be the fact that the place is on a hill. I love walking uphill and it wasn't a long walk anyways, so no problem for me but if you aren't into walking uphill for a while, you might want to take that into account.

Araçla konuma çıkarken biraz zorlandık, çok dik ve dar yokuşların olduğu sokakta. Daire güzel temizdi. Sadece banyonun havalandırması yok bu durum biraz rahatsız ediciydi. Duş aldığınızda ya da tuvaleti kullandığınızda çok koku ve buhar oluyor. Bunun dışında her şeyden memnun kaldık.

Fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibiydi, temizliğe dikkat eden biri olarak Mert beyin evinde rahat ettiğimi söyleyebilirim.. mutfakta yemek yapabilicek yeterli malzemeler bulunuyordu. Sadece eve gidilen yol araçsız insanlar için biraz yokuşluydu.. Konaklamadan memnunum fiyat performans harikaydı :)

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped luxury apartment on Bogazkesen, the Cultural Path connecting Galataport to the famous Istiklal Street. You will find historic monuments, galleries, antique stores, the best of local cuisine, vibrant nightlife and more just beside you.

With daily cleaning service, assistance for your concierge needs and dedicated parking space, this apartment is set to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text: Location is great, apartment stylish but wifi didn´t work properly in our 5 day stay there was noch cleaning and no serious kitchen supply (one fork) - Güthar was responsive but overall a hotel would have been better for this price.

I had a wonderful stay at Urban Quarters. The location is excellent, central, yet quiet and easily accessible. The place was spotlessly clean, and everything was exactly as described. Communication with the hosts was smooth and timely, and they handled everything with great professionalism. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

First of all, we had trouble with the lock when checking in. If you’re tech savvy it may be easier for you, otherwise it is quite complicated. Thankfully it was easy to get support at the late hour we checked in, (around 2am). Another complaint is the faulty AC we had which the host gave no prior warning about! It was very hot in Istanbul so this caused us a lot of inconvenience. We had no idea and left it on at night and woke up with a puddle of water in our bedroom, the host did send cleaners as soon as they could to clean it up but this could’ve been avoided had they given us a warning. Overall the place is nice and clean and the location is good, close to the tram station. I would recommend this Airbnb and would probably stay again now that I know how to use the key and as long as the AC is sorted.

Pros:
-Very responsive and friendly host
-proactive with repairs that was needed
-super great location. Best part of the stay is the location
Cons:
-the place was pretty dirty in terms of surfaces visibly not being clean. The floors had clearly not been moped in a long time and would make feet dirty if you didn’t wear slippers
-poor ventilation and clear water damage on ceilings with musty odor
-we had issues with the air conditioner during our stay where for the first two nights it did not work at all. Luckily, the host sent someone to fix it for the second half of our stay. Worth noting as it seems the system is outdated and needs longer term fix.
-in general felt that the general maintenance and upkeep of the place could be better.

The place was great and just like the photos.
The bathroom has a glass wall, so if someone wants to take a shower, it will be fully visible — ideal for couples, but not very practical for friends.
The location is excellent. However, one of the AC units was leaking water, and I was asked to empty the tray placed under it if I wanted to use it.
The other AC worked fine and kept the room cool as long as the weather outside wasn’t too hot, but it made some startling noises at times.
Also, sound insulation was weak. While we weren’t facing the street and didn’t hear traffic or people, the birds outside were quite noisy.
If you usually sleep by 10 PM and wake up early, and you don’t mind a bit of AC noise, you’ll be fine.
Everything else was truly excellent.

description:
**** 8 minutes from Tüyap Convention Center
*** 6 minutes from the Marmara Sea
** Full AirCon throughout the home
* Spotless Cleaning

Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun. Our brand new flat is just what you need to relax with your whole family. All furnishings and appliances are new, and the neighborhood is safe and quiet. Just a short drive from wonderful restaurants and the West Istanbul Marina; you will find everything you need in wonderful Beylikdüzü.

reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant stay at this apartment. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and nicely furnished. It was also quite well equipped. Having air conditioning in three rooms was a big plus.
The neighborhood was calm and peaceful, and the apartment was a good place for a family stay. Drew and Evrim were both very friendly, responsive, and helpful.
Overall, we had a very good experience and would happily recommend this apartment to others.

The place is new and clean. Well furnished. Very comfortable. The only issue was its location. The location is very far from everything but very calm. Good place to relax. Beautiful view of sea. High speed internet. If location is not important to you it’s highly recommended.

We enjoyed our stay in this apartment in Beylikdüzü, very peaceful neighbourhood and not far from the sea. The apartment was nice and clean. It had all listed amenities and we were provided with everything we asked for. We were given access to the parking garage below the apartment complex which was great for days with very windy or rainy weather when you needed to drive in or out. The hosting team were incredibly helpful, responsive and supportive making sure that us and our other guests are taken care of either during our stay or when getting to the apartment or the airport by arranging transport.
Thank you so much Alma team, specially Drew and Evrim.
Cheers

A very beautiful apartment, more beautiful than the pictures, especially the beautiful view, the furniture is clean and new, and one of the most beautiful apartments I lived in in Istanbul, a very quiet neighborhood, and all services are available, close to the apartment, the sea is very close, and one of the most beautiful neighborhoods in Istanbul, and the owner of the apartment is very nice. I give it 5 stars in all aspects. I hope to come back to the same apartment again.🥰🤍🙏🏻
Very good location, clean flat and responsive host

description:
Experience a cozy stay in the heart of Istanbul!

This booking offers a stylish studio apartment on a tranquil street in Pera, with proximity to the famous Istiklal Street, prestigious Pera Museum and Soho House, historic Galata Tower, vibrant nightlife, and convenient public transit options, all just minutes away.

Featuring a useful private kitchenette, high-end essentials, daily cleaning, and concierge services, we ensure a memorable vacation!

reviews.text: I was very cold the first night. There are two electric small batteries. You had to wait a long time for the room to warm up. The toilet seat was cold and I had to sleep in my jacket and trousers. The next day they brought me a blanket and helped me to switch on the air conditioning. The air conditioners don't always do that well. The second day I was more comfortable. I asked the host to bring me a heater. He refused. Arguing that a lot of people live here and don't complain. I felt sick and broken after the first night. My hands and head were freezing at night. I think it is much easier to provide an extra heater than to prove a guest wrong. Other than that, they were polite. The room was clean. I liked the bed linen. Everything works. There's a big window and there's no radiator on this side. So if you go in autumn or winter, pay attention to this. The air conditioning warms it up a little bit. But it's still a little chilly. High rating because they helped me or tried to help me.
Herşey fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibi. Sessiz ve huzurlu. Ayrıca istiklal caddesine taksime yakın. Biz çok memlun kaldık. Ayrıca çok temizdi.

Great stay!
Irem was always just a couple of minutes away if I needed anything.
She was also able to assist me with a VERY early check in since I arrived early in the morning.
The self check in procedure is simple.
Maybe 5-7 minute walk uphill to Istikal street, tons of bars and restaurants around that area if you are not familiar.
I think the only thing is that the sound proofing from the door is not very good, so you can hear other guests, house keepers etc. but not a big problem by any means.
Highly recommended for short term stays.
Will return when in Istanbul again.
Great location. Clean place
Oda fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi, konumu da gayet elverişli ancak rezervasyon sonrasında sorduğum sorulara cevap alamamamı profesyonelliğe yakıştıramadım.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby. You'll be able to enjoy the convenience of having everything you need within walking distance. Our home is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text: Lovely stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Would happily stay again. Thanks for everything!"

description:
Have a pleasant time with your whole family in this stylish place.
A comfortable and clean apartment!

Features in brief:
*Luxurious furniture, useful items, clean linens & towels.
* Apartments with City View & High Floor Facade,
*24/7 Reception, late check-in possible,
*Security cameras (in common areas),
*Has a 4-storey indoor parking lot,
*Garbage is collected daily from the door,
*There are two elevators and also a service elevator,
*We have Wi-Fi - Fiber optic internet infrastructure, 100 Mbps speed.

reviews.text:
Ahmet was one of the most responsive and honest hosts I’ve ever had. We had great communication throughout our stay, and he was always helpful and quick to respond.
I traveled with my elderly parents, so having a place that was easily accessible was very important to me. The building has an elevator, which was a big plus. The street has some incline, but it was still manageable.
For someone like me who enjoys experiencing local life rather than staying in a very touristy area, I found the location excellent. It was convenient for transportation and grocery shopping, while still being quiet and away from the noise of the city.
The apartment has a spectacular view of Istanbul. Another thing I really appreciated was that there is AC in the dining/living area as well as in each bedroom, which was especially nice during our stay.
Overall, we had a very good experience and really enjoyed our stay.

The apartment was just as it appeared in the pictures, clean and tidy with a convenient location. The host was responsive and helpful when needed. We rented a family car, and while the Airbnb had parking available, spaces for larger cars were limited and on a first-come, first-served basis. We did struggle a few times to find parking, but the security guard was friendly and assisted us.
The road leading to the apartment was narrow and steep. It was challenging to navigate with a stroller, and would likely be difficult for anyone with mobility issues.

Our stay at Roni Apartments was the highlight of our family Istanbul trip. First of all, thank you to our host Mr. Ahmet. He is so kind and welcoming. He made our entire check in process so easy by giving out clear directions to reach the apartment and also coordinating with the receptionist for our late check in.
The apartment is exactly as shown in the images. I will say 11/10 on cleanliness and the thoughtfulness of our host. It feels right at home as soon you get inside. Everything inside the apartment is in pristine condition. There are cafes and grocery store nearby. The best part is that after a long day of exploring the city, you can come back and enjoy the city skyline from the apartment. Definitely recommend the property. We thank the host Mr Ahmet and his team. 🙌🏼

It was a pleasure to stay in Mr. Ahmed’s home. He was extremely responsive, friendly, and communicative from the get go. We really appreciated his kind attitude, helpful checkin instructions and local recommendations. His home was clean, comfortable, equipped, and easy to access. The view of the city is even better than the listing suggests!! We appreciated that the neighborhood was quiet but multiple public transit options and shops were within easy walking distance. Overall it was a really nice stay and Mr. Ahmed is a lovely host. We thank him immensely for his warmth and hospitality! :)

We stayed here for four days and absolutely loved it! The location was amazing — very convenient and easy to get around. The owner was super friendly and helpful, always in contact whenever we needed anything. Everything was just as described, and we felt really comfortable during our stay. I would definitely recommend this place and would love to come back again!

description: Our hotel is on the tramline, 10 steps away from the Sultanahmet tram station and 1-5 minutes walking distance to all historical sites. From our terrace, you can see the Sultanahmet Mosque, the Sea of Marmara, the Princes' Islands and the Sultanahmet Square. Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapı Museum, Grand Bazaar are 2-5 minutes on foot

reviews.text: The bathroom is a stall with doors that open in on an already small space. A shower head and faucet has been added right below the mirror. To shower you hook it above the mirror and shower in this small space between the toilet and sink. The smell of sulfur coming from the floor drain was constant and unbearable. The bed was very hard and I couldn’t sleep at all. We booked 3 nights and could only stay 1 before finding a new location. The host and staff were friendly and the breakfast was good, but the lesson is that I’ll never stay somewhere that doesn’t have a picture of the bathroom included again.

Probably the best location to stay in Sultanahmet with Hagia Sofia and Blue mosque right in front. You have a tram station right in front of the hotel which can take you everywhere in Istanbul. The room was decent but the breakfast was amazing. Karem and his wife were super hosts, helpful and considerate. Highly recommended if you're traveling solo or as a couple

Wonderful location! Just steps away from a tram stop and all the main sites. Beautiful view. Kind and helpful hosts always available. The room met our needs. I recommend white noise for the night as this is a bustling area.

We hebben in het algemeen erg genoten van ons verblijf in Istanboel. Toplocatie vlakbij de blauwe moskee, Hagia Sophia, de grand bazaar, kruidenmarkt,... We kregen tips van de host over welke plekken de moeite waard zijn om te bezoeken. Waar we niet tevreden over waren was de staat van de kamer. De handreep van het raam was stuk, de badkamer was verouderd wat op zich niet erg is, maar het was niet proper (kalksporen en vuilresten). We vonden het ook niet fair dat we bij aankomst 60 euro moesten betalen voor het vervoer van de luchthaven (ipv 50 wat aangegeven stond op het bord). We maakten er geen probleem van op het moment zelf maar het was niet correct. Voor de taxi bij terugkeer kwamen we 100 lira tekort (2 euro) en toch drong de host aan om nog geld af te halen terwijl we bij aankomst al 10 euro teveel hadden betaald. We hadden het bedrag op voorhand uitgerekend voor de taxi en maakten gebruik van de currency dat overal aangegeven stond om om te rekenen naar Lira.

This was our second stay with Kerem. The Sultanahmet is in a great location. very close to top attractions like the blue mosque, basilica cistern and grand bazaar. Also steps away from the tramline which is connected with one of the best public transportation systems we have used. The rooftop terrace is a nice getaway from the crowds and has pristine views. The breakfasts delicious and hosts very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.

description: Centrally located with sea and historical peninsula views, reliable. Bus 5 min, tram and minibus 10 min, and metro 15 min walking distance. 24/7 (reception) support, self-service 24-hour free tea and coffee service. For stays over 2 days, the room is cleaned and maintained every day. You can book this unique experience through the app.

reviews.text: Everything was as described and all staff were friendly and responsive. It’s easy to reach the Metro (M2 line), T1 trams to the centre, and Marmaray train to Üsküdar. There are also some good fairly local options for food. Would recommend.
A cheap and austere place. I don't recommend it to non-smokers, as the rooms smell strongly of cigarettes. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful
The place was as described, great communication, location and very hospitable.

Everything was great. The people working at the reception are very polite and attentive. The room on the 5th floor had everything you need. Hot water in the shower. The Wi-Fi in the room worked averagely, but for me it was not so important. The view from the window was right on the sea. The hotel is in a good area of ​​the city and close to the main places within walking distance. Thanks for hospitality!

This is a small hotel. The common area was clean. I have experienced poor and inconsistent wifi reception in my room. The listing states there is a kitchen with utensils. There is a kitchen, but it is for their staff's use. There were very few utensils. The room is good for just one person; the AC worked fine. The bathroom was dirty and had some mold.

description: Our place is 15 minutes walk from the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace. The nearest tram station is 400m away. Restaurants and markets can be easily found in the vicinity of the hotel. You can be sure that you will have a pleasant holiday in this place. There are also shareded areas on the terrace floor and in front of the hotel (hotel garden). You can this area. We also have free tea and laundry service. This is a family business

reviews.text:
Our hosts were very helpful and welcoming. Arrival was flexible and the room was clean although WiFi was slow. The place is located near the tramway station and next to many restaurants and shops, you may get lost at first but it’s easier to find your way after that.
I totally recommend !
I recommend this property to any solo traveler. Clean, comfortable and good view of the city and bosphorus. Within walking distance to most restaurants, shops and transportation.

Highly recommended.
Great location with amazing view of the water.
Mustafa is one of the best hosts I ever met in Airbnb. He’s honest, kind, and helpful.
Property is very beautiful and well designed.
Will stay here again whenever I return to Fatih.
Nice neighborhood with nice locals.
Many restaurants and shops nearby.
Area full of local charm.

This place is right at the heart of Sultanahmet area, the accommodation was so great specially at night it was a complete silence which I really prefer. In addition to that the bed was big and comfortable, the hospitality of the host was so great (it’s much appreciate it). I highly recommend it!
Great location, within walking distance to most sights, restaurant, shops and more. Hosts were always attentive and communication was smooth. Was just perfect for our short stay in Istanbul.

description: You will be surrounded by elegance and grace in this impressive place.

we had an excellent new year's eve at Miller's Home, and the hosts were exceptional in their communication and assistance to us..
.. everything was as in their listing, and the location was convenient to public transportation and within easy walking distance of all the main shopping areas and local open air markets
thank you!
Gözüktüğü gibiydi ev sahibi yeterince ilgili ve hızlı iletişim kurdu. Temizlik konusunda da başarılı. Memnun kaldık

description: Tucked into the buzzing core of Beyoğlu, this character-rich apartment blends exposed brick walls with a private sauna for a different kind of stay. The 45 m² space feels warm and intentional — a quiet retreat from the city's energy. Let the day go in the sauna, rest on a queen bed, sip your coffee in the living room or out on the back balcony. The kitchen is yours to cook in. İstiklal Avenue is 2 minutes away, Taksim 5. Designed warmth in a lively neighborhood.

reviews.text:
I have been using Airbnb for several year and there's no doubt that this was the worst place to stay.
The place is really small and practically there is only one window in the whole apartment where you can get the natural light from. There is a windows in the bed room which leads to a balcony but there are walls all around the balcony hence you can't use balcony either. The balcony is full with bird droppings.
The kitchen has no window and there is a permanent smell coming from it's plumbing. I messaged the host multiple times to fix it but no response.
The bathroom is so small that the toilet is built literally in the shower. There's no space to hang your cloths or towel. Toilet paper holder is broken.
The bed is broken as well and I had to fix it myself everyday.
The sofa is dirty and full of cigarettes burns.
Don't get deceived by the sauna pictures. It doesn't work.
I'm not sure how the host managed this rating. Please stay away if you don't want to ruin your holiday

The location was excellent, making it easy to explore the area. Everything was as described, clean, and comfortable. Check-in was smooth, and communication was clear. Overall, a great experience. Thanks

The apartment was functional and nice. But the hygiene was terrible. Really took away from the experience. The living room floor/carpet wasn’t clean. The mini fridge had dead fruit flies inside. The kitchen dishes were dusty and had small stones in them and no bin bags the bin also had dead bugs stuck to it. Complimentary tea bags were dirty and damp. The bathroom was the worst. Had constant bad smell. And only given 1 toilet roll and no hand soap and things were falling off the walls! The bedroom was fine although again the floors didn’t feel clean and there was only one towel per person and no iron cover for iron board and the bed cover was too small for the duvet. For anyone staying for a week or longer this lack of cleanliness and detail took away from our experience.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The place was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything we needed. A real standout was the sauna — such a lovely and unexpected addition that made the stay feel extra special and relaxing. The host was also fantastic to deal with, very flexible and accommodating with check-in and check-out times, which made the whole experience stress-free. Would definitely stay again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable, well-hosted place!
Great place to stay - comfortable setting, brilliant location and quiet. Loved staying here and would definitely come back next time I’m in Istanbul. Very responsive, helpful and friendly hosts

description:
Welcome to our spacious, family friendly hideaway nestled in the vibrant heart of Istanbul! This beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment blends Turkish charm with modern comforts, offering a unique and serene retreat just steps away from Istanbul’s most bustling attractions. It is also located steps away from metro and bus stations.

The area is one of the most historic residential areas of Istanbul. You can find many cozy cafes, shops and local boutiques.

reviews.text:
The host was very responsive and helpful, which we appreciated.
The apartment itself is poorly built and needs maintenance. In one small bedroom there were four sockets randomly scattered across the wall, while the larger bedroom had only one. Furniture was stained, and one room had no floor covering — just exposed concrete. AC and elevator were broken on arrival (host fixed them), and one toilet was broken and we had to fix it ourselves.
The elevator is unsafe: it opens directly into the apartment with no internal door, leaving the shaft fully exposed while riding.
Location is okay with a nearby subway, but the area lacks good restaurants, cafes, or stores. I’d recommend staying in a better district like Şişli.

We had a great stay at this apartment in Fatih, Turkey. It truly felt like home and was a perfect fit for our group of 8. The location is fantastic—very accessible, with the train station and bus stop nearby. Plus, having a supermarket and several eateries just downstairs made everything super convenient.
The space was cozy and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. However, we did encounter some issues with the bathroom—there was a persistent smell, and the water occasionally got stuck, which was a bit inconvenient.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend this place to larger groups looking for a central and homey base in Istanbul. A little improvement on the bathroom would make it perfect!

Overall, this was a good value stay and a solid, no-frills apartment.
The Wi-Fi was good and reliable throughout our stay. I worked remotely at times and consistently had sufficient speed with no major issues.
The apartment offers good value for the size. The living room and kitchen are the highlights, with large, beautiful windows that let in plenty of natural light during the day and make those spaces especially pleasant.
The place isn’t fancy or particularly modern, which was fine given the price. The showers were nice and had consistent hot water throughout. Towels were provided. Bidets are present in all bathrooms. However, only one of the bathroom sinks had hot water; the other two did not.
Location was very convenient - close to trains, trams, busses, the Fatih area. The hosts were professional every step of the way, and check-in was easy.
Great value for the money and I’d stay here again. Just don’t expect a 5 star hotel, and you’ll likely be satisfied.

It’s perfect for big groups. It isn’t luxurious, but it’s fine. The location was nice near to the bus and Metro Station and a lot of restaurants. If you were less than 7 persons, I do not recommend this apartment otherwise it’s fine. Also, it did look better in the photos and it didn’t have the baby bed or the baby chair. We had some issues like the water pressure was low, but it got fixed after couple of hour and there was an electricity shut down to the whole Neighborhood it last for 30 minutes then it got fixed.
Overall: we were only 4 persons - its 6,5/10
We could have gotten better for the same price
If we were 7 or 8 persons I would give it Easy 9/10 for that amount of Money and quality.

We stayed for 3 nights and loved the place! It was spacious for the 6 of us. It was clean and as described. We really love the location - lots of local restaurant, quite street and near the metro. It’s a 200m walk from the Aksaray tram station. There is a grocery store & pharmacy steps from the building. Overall, we would stay there again if we visit Istanbul!

description:
Only 5 minutes walking distance to Galataport, 10 minutes walking distance to Galata Tower,
-Consists of 2 bedrooms, open kitchen and living area
-Bedrooms provide privacy with curtains.
-Located on the 1st floor of the building, no elevator, easy to access
-Fully equipped (Air conditioning, wireless internet connection, dishwasher, automatic coffee machine, hair dryer + iron, vacuum cleaner, kitchen utensils and much more)
-Paid parking is 30 meters away.

reviews.text:
The Karaköy area is great and very convenient, close to many attractions, restaurants, and transport.
However, the exact location of the apartment is not ideal. There are cafés just downstairs, and sometimes it’s difficult to pass because tables block the entrance, so you may need to ask people to move them. If you open the window, cigarette smoke from outside can occasionally come in.
The kitchen has only the very basic utensils, so it may not be ideal if you plan to cook frequently.
There is also a large air-conditioning motor right next to the window that can produce some noise.
The mattress is very soft, which may be comfortable for people who prefer softer beds but might not suit those who like firm mattresses.
On the positive side, the host was responsive and kind in communication.

Kubra and team was responseive and allowed us to extend the check out for 1 more hour. but honestly, they need to work on this property a lot. We paid 100+Euros for an airbnb in Turkey but experience was very bad. Air condition could not be turned on due to smell of rat urine from it. Bathroom floor towel was on folded along with bath towel and kept on the bed. We selected this apartment because it is expensive and expected the quality for the price. No basic amenities like toiletries, 50ml water packet( they could have kept no water instead of that). Space seems very small compare to photos(photographer need raise). Though the property is newly renovated it has lot of moulds and dusts due to bad renovation work. I hope team will work on these things and make it better. We just needed a place to crash for 1 night before our final flight and hence did not affect much but could have gone for a cheaper one with this quality.

Quaint place nestled in the heart of Karakoy. You will not go wrong choosing this place. Fantastic location and comfortable room. Host was always ready to help. Many friendly locals in the area.
The rooms were slightly smaller than they seemed, but they were more than comfortable. Also, there’s no lifts so you have to carry your bags up the stairs.

Karaköy’deki bu eşsiz dairede konaklamak bizim için harika bir deneyimdi. Ev sahibi her konuda çok ilgili ve misafirperverdi, iletişimimiz oldukça hızlı ve nazikti. Daire hem konum olarak merkezi hem de dekorasyonuyla oldukça zevkli ve konforluydu. Temizlik konusunda da son derece özenliydi, her şey pırıl pırıldı. Özellikle Karaköy’ün canlı atmosferine bu kadar yakın olup aynı zamanda bu kadar huzurlu bir yerde konaklamak çok keyifliydi. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

The place was very nice and clean. Even though downstairs there are restaurants and cafes, the noise didn’t get to our room and we slept wonderful. The surroundings are very nice lots of restaurants and places to visit. Good location! The communication was great! Would recommend

description:
Hotel close to Galata Tower. Our apartment, which is close to Pera Palace Hotel and Istiklal Street, has a lot to offer. Guests can connect to the free WiFi in the room. Enjoy features such as 24-hour reception, tour/ticket assistance and concierge services, luggage storage, multilingual staff, and elevator.
Our apartment has thoughtful touches such as air conditioning in all guest rooms as well as amenities such as a minibar.

reviews.text: Otel inanılmaz rahat çok merkezli bir yerde çok temiz çok rahat Fotoğraflardaki gibiydi güler yüzlü insanlar tekrardan mutlaka ziyaret edeceğim çok teşekkür ederim 🫶🏼

Hotel is great for first timers in Istanbul! In such a great location with so many restaurants and cafes metres away, and trams/train stations and top attractions less than 15 mins walk away.
The room is small but what you need for a couple of days.
Would stay again!
Great location, nice hotel and staff… we will come again!

Nice room, very clean and modern, great location with lots of bars and restaurants nearby, very friendly staff.
Highly recommend.

Mahmuts home is in a beautiful part of Istanbul, so many amazing restaurants within walking distance, very friendly staff with lots of recommendations. Thank you for being a great host will definitely stay here again!

description: This apartment in the center of Kadıköy is ideally located for your trip. You can reach all the facilities of Kadıköy by walking, as well as all means of transportation that will allow you to travel. Moreover, on a street with historical Yeldeğirmeni houses, you have a balcony with a magnificent view of the sea and Haydarpaşa. Our only flaw is that we do not have an elevator even though our building is new. The apartment is on the top floor (5th) but believe me, the view is worth it :)

reviews.text:
I didn't meet Gülay in person but she was friendly and responsive in messages. The location is great, and the view from the balcony is beautiful. The stairs were not a problem and check in was smooth.
The walls of the apartment are bright yellow now. The bed was comfortable and bedding was clean, so it's good for a night's sleep after sightseeing but not really a cosy place to spend lots of time (for me). Overall it was pretty clean, but some of the surfaces were sticky/dirty and the glassware needed an extra wash before using. There was a sense of indifference (basic overhead lighting, matchstick furniture, sticky kitchen floor) that dampened the atmosphere, so I spent most of my time working in cafes (not a big problem as Yeldeğirmeni is a cafe paradise).
I've stayed in many apartments in Kadıköy and I wouldn't choose this one again. It could be great with a bit more love and energy put into it.

Gülay's place is located in a very vivid neighborhood, yet situated in a call street, as described the building does t have an elevator but the balcony's view is worth every step, metro and bus are also at a walking distance, the spaces in the flat are well organized, the host has great communication skills and is always very responsive

Konaklamamdan oldukça memnun kaldım. Ev, fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha temiz ve düzenliydi. Konum olarak çok merkezi, çevrede markete ve ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her yere kolayca ulaşılabiliyor. Ev sahibi iletişimi çok iyiydi; her soruma hızlı ve nazik bir şekilde cevap verdi. Sessiz ve rahat bir ortam olduğu için güzel dinlendim. Kesinlikle tekrar tercih ederim. Tavsiye ederim!

The location and the view can't be beat for the price! Just steps away from ferry and metro, and close to all the fun and culture of Kadikoy. It's on the top floor (that's why it has such a great view), so be ready for a bit of exercise! Bed was really comfortable. Kitchen was fairly well equipped, and it was nice to watch a movie while cooking. Overall, I would definitely recommend for the great price.

5 floors up was not worth the view as other reviewers may have said. Also the bathroom wasn’t very clean and shower barely worked and was spraying water everywhere from the pipe when turned on. Bed uncomfortable. Not the best stay

description: Located just behind the famous Istiklal Street in Istanbul, this apartment offers magnificent views and comfortable accommodation.The apartment is 5-10 minutes away from tram, metro, bus and ferry stations.This tastefully decorated place has 5 separate bedrooms, 5 bathrooms and 6 air conditioners and can accommodate up to 10 people. You can reach almost all the important touristic places and venues on foot from the apartment.There are many nice restaurants, bars and cafes in the surrounding area

reviews.text: Diyar’s place hit all the boxes:: the building is an over hundred year old property renovated with thoughtfully and culturally designed elements. We were given the entire place of 5 bedrooms to ourselves for a group of 6 people. The kitchen was well equipped and spacious rooms. Enough provisions of towels & tissues. Situated in a local neighbourhood gives an authentic stay feel. Supermarket and a food joint is right below the building. Some points to note are, no metro station is close by. Some leakage issues in some bathrooms.

This is a really beautiful apartment with lots of bedrooms and bathrooms. There were only 4 of us but you could easily come with a much a larger group and have plenty of room. It is located on a nice quiet street but is still very close to all the action. Highly recommended!
Clean, nice place. The WiFi was strong. The location is nice.

Giriş çok kolaydı bulmak da öyle fakat otopark yeri bulmak çok zor. İstiklal caddesine 10dk mesafede. Tarlabaşında bir ev. Muhit biraz ürkütücüydü ama her yerde polis olduğu için güven verdi açıkçası. Fakat akşam keş tipler baya bağırdılar evin önünde küfürlü. Gürültü alıyor ev ama oda çok güzel tertemiz. 130yıllık tarihi bir bina. Tv çalışmıyordu odada. İletişime geçseydik çözülürdü belki ama uğraşmadık. Genel olarak fiyat performans oteliydi diyebilirim.
Diyar beyin iletişimi gayet iyiydi yerde güzel ve temizdi fakat su ve kahve yoktu onlarda olursa çok daha iyi olabilir yinede teşekkür ederiz rahat ettik

description: King room walking to Hagia Sophia 5 miunts

reviews.text: The place was lovely - spacious and clean. It was in an ideal location, within walking distance from the mosques, Grand Bazaar and Topkapi Palace. We required an early check in as we were to arrive before midday and Mehmet ensured our room was ready by noon. As we arrived early we waited downstairs whilst Mehmet provided us with refreshments 😊 Mehmet is an amazing host - So friendly and helpful! Our taxi driver to the hotel tried to charge us an extortionate price for our trip but Mehmet jumped in and did not let us pay any more than what the trip should’ve actually cost (nearly a third of the price!). He went above and beyond for us and we will be forever grateful. Thank you so much for everything! 😌

Mehmet is a fantastic host! Great communication, easy check-in, and the place was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. He also arranged airport trnasfer for us and helped us to book tours.
We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone. Thank you!

Mehmet was an amazing host and extremely friendly and kind! He helped my mom and I out with our luggage and had room service come and clean so we always came home to fresh sheets and a clean room! The room is literally a 5-10min walk to the Hagia Sofia, Topkapi palace, the Blue Mosque so you cannot possibly runout of things to do for fun!
Mehmet was such a great host and I had a wonderful stay. The room was spacious and very clean. The location is perfect. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming.

Mehmet est un hôte accueillant et disponible, l'emplacement est parfait en plein centre possibilité de tout faire à pieds ou en transports en commun par contre difficile d'accès en voiture (pas de parking ou possible mais un peu cher) Logement fidèle aux photos mais nécessite un peu plus d'entretien et de ménage

Öncelikle konum olarak gayet merkezi bir yerdeydi. Eve giriş ve talimatlar kolaydı. Ev temizdi ve ev sahibi cips ve meyve koymuştu masaya🥹. Ev sahibi sorulara çok hızlı yanıt verdi. İki problem vardı. Sıcak su her zaman çalışmıyordu ve su akıtan bir boru vardı. Bunlar dışında fiyat performans olarak yeterli bir ev.

The flat was clean and smelled fresh when I arrived. It had everything I might need in the kitchen, the décor was lovely, and everything worked properly. Close to shops and Taksim sq and Istklal st. Very comfortable stay

This apartment is a 10 min walk from Taksim Square, so pretty much a great spot for getting a variety of food, and finding grocery stores, pharmacies, you name it. It can be noisey as it has a lot of movements in the area. The apartment was clean and had enough space for two persons. Everything worked as needed, it is not luxurious but a good and functional budget friendly option.
Altug is a very friendly host. Everything is described clear and accurately. Recommended

description:

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at Kenan’s place. The apartment was exactly as described—very clean, stylish, and comfortable. The location was excellent, making it easy to get around and enjoy the city.
Kenan was an amazing host: responsive, kind, and always helpful whenever I needed anything. Check-in was smooth, and everything in the apartment was well prepared.
I especially loved how cozy and well-designed the space felt. It truly made my stay more enjoyable. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting, and I would happily stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay. The host was very polite, friendly, and always ready to help with any questions we had. Communication was excellent from the beginning to the end of our stay. The location was very convenient and the accommodation was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We highly recommend this place and would gladly stay here again in the future. Thank you for your hospitality!

wonderful host, I easily found accommodation, the host helped me carry my heavy luggage, there were no questions about the accommodation, the very case when the price quality is ideal. comfortable bed and pillows, the host brought me an electric kettle in a second at my request, the house also has an elevator, which is very helpful. not all houses in Turkey have an elevator, this is a salvation. I sincerely recommend! for its price 10/10

I’m so happy i stayed at this lovely place! Everything was perfect, just like on the pictures. Very clean bed. I had everything i needed it the apartment, it was safe, peaceful, quiet at night, i felt comfortable and just like at home. Thanks a lot to the host, Kenan showed me the place and it was a pleasure to meet him. I highly recommend and definitely come back.

Oda da 5 gün 6 gece konakladım ilk iki gün oda da ki buzdolabı çalışmadığı için buzdolabı ihtiyacını resepsiyondan karşıladım bu konuda yardımcı oldular daha sonra ise başka bir buzdolabı verdiler oda fotoğraflarda ki gibi ve temizdi odanın duvarları ince evet ama yan oda da ki kalan insanların kim olduğuna bağlı olarak rahatsız oluyorsunuz ya da olmuyorsunuz ben son güne kadar rahatsız olmamıştım ama son gün yan oda da konaklayanlar oldukça gürültü çıkardılar, camlar açılmıyor ama klima tüm odaya yetiyor. Fiyat performans olarak değerlendirilebilecek bir oda.

description: Our apartments are centrally located and have all kinds of transportation and facilities, and consist of stylish and spacious spaces. All our apartments have a kitchen and two bathrooms and have 1+1 features. We have 1 double bedroom and a separate bedroom. Our room is in the most central part of Bakırköy. There are shopping malls, Marmaray and eating and drinking places within 5 minutes. You can relax in this peaceful accommodation.

reviews.text: We didn’t have a good experience here. It felt more like a hotel than an apartment. The place wasn’t very clean and lacked basic amenities: no washing machine, iron, or even proper trash bins. No shower doors, so water spilled everywhere. The listing promised shampoo and shower gel, but we found only two tiny unmarked samples for two adults over four days. The worst part — the apartment smelled of smoke, with an ashtray on the table, though smoking wasn’t mentioned. We also noticed sticky stains in the bathroom, dust in the bedroom, only one small blanket, no hand towels, and nowhere to hang towels. Overall, the stay was uncomfortable.

Loved my stay at Bakirköy! The apartment was super spacious, spotless, and felt really cozy. I settled in right away. Wi-Fi was fast (a lifesaver!), and the location was perfect surrounded by supermarkets, tons of great restaurants, easy logistics to the centre and anything else you could need. The İsmail was very responsive and the other staff were also beyond friendly and made everything easy. Honestly, I didn’t want to leave. Would totally stay here again!

İsmail Efe sorulara her zaman hızlı yanıt verdi. Ev konum olarak iyiydi. Ulaşım konusunda metro ve diğer yerlere yürüme mesafesindeydi. Evin temizliği iyiydi. Fiyat performans olarak gayet güzel bir yer.
Rahat ve temiz bir yer, kolay check in.
Ev sahibi ilgili ve cozum odaklıydı ev temizdi

description: It is located in the old city of Istanbul, Çapa Şehremini. Convenient to transport. 2-minute walk to T1 tram station. You can go to various popular tourist attractions. There are Chinese, Turkish and Asian restaurants nearby. Very convenient for eating! Full support facilities! Welcome to stay!

reviews.text:
Good location near transit/shops. Check-in/cleanliness okay. Kitchen lacked a bin, sponge, and soap; bathroom had no towel hooks, and only 2 toilet rolls for 10 days.
Negative point! 4 days before arrival, they claimed our apartment had leaks and moved us to a worse alternative. They paid the difference, but the original apartment was clearly occupied by someone else from day one because we heard noises and people coming in and out of the apartment. Why cancel our 2-month-old paid booking? The new apartment (with 2 bar stools) was extremely noisy at night. The communication was very poor/ignored/very late replies.

I really enjoyed staying at this apartment. It is so handy to everything I’d recommend the first thing you do is grab a transport card and then it’s a couple of minutes walk to the tram and really easy to get anywhere. The apartment was clean and comfortable and great value for money.

Amazing place, clean and quiet area, close to tram and bus station, many restaurants around, host was very responsive and solved any issues we had immediately, I would strongly recommend staying here.

Having booked here several times due to the location and general professionalism of the host, I can warmly recommend this to anyone looking for a place to stay whilst in Istanbul for business or leisure. The apartment is as advertised on the pictures.

Murat dost canlısıydı, ev temiz, düzenli ve dingindi. İçiniz rahat bir şekilde konaklayabilirsiniz. Evin konumu çok iyi istediğiniz yere raylı toplu taşıma ile istanbul trafiğine takılmadan gidebilirisiniz.

description: Stay in a private room close to the most interesting attractions. The hotel is very central and a 3-minute walk from Osmanbey Metro. The room has three beds with orthopedic mattresses. Cleaning is available in the rooms. The room has air conditioning, private bathtub, hairdryer, hygiene products, towels, slippers. There is always hot water. 24h front desk.

reviews.text: Central location, near to Taksim Square and Nisantasi. Free parking :) Good humored staff. Bed smell smoking but worth to place. Thank you.
Very responsive host, clean and comfortable place with great location.
Clean, close to the metro and overall great place, staff was very polite and very helpful. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.text: We stayed as a family of five. The host was very kind and thoughtful — since we mentioned that we needed to cook at home due to my father’s medical condition, they provided us with a new pot, pan, and spatula, which we really appreciated. However, some things in the apartment felt old. The TV remote didn’t work properly, there was only one remote for three air conditioners, and one bedroom AC didn’t cool at all. Unlike other Airbnbs we’ve stayed at, basic supplies such as trash bags, dish soap or dishwasher tablets, and cleaning spray were not provided (even toilet paper was only one roll). The host said guests must buy them, which was inconvenient. The location is only suitable if you have a car, as it’s not accessible by bus or metro. Also, reception staff did not speak English, making check-in difficult. Overall, the host was very kind, but the apartment could use updates and better preparation for guests.

It was a very wonderful experience. The apartment is very clean, the air conditioners are excellent, and the location is great. There is only one problem: there are no parking spaces. The nearest place to park your car is 100 meters from the building. Many thanks to the host, and I will come back again in the coming days. Thank you.

Çok memnun kaldık bir daha gelirsek tekrar aynı dairede konaklamak isteriz. Çok temiz ve kulanışlıydı. Ev sahibi çok kısa süre içersinde size dönüş yapıyor ve her sorunuzda yardımcı oluyor. Herşey için çok teşekkür ederiz ailece çok memnun kaldık.
friendly host that gave good recommendations for food nearby

I liked everything in the flat and Yan was a great host. The only thing i didn’t like is the check in for the building as they don’t speak English and it was hard to communicate with them. Apart from that everything were amazing

description:

I provide comfort and 24/7 reception support where my guests can feel at home
