reviews.text: Location is great but place was not very clean there was stains on the couch and the bed , communication with host was great but check in was hard because of the time on Airbnb and actually check in was different so we had to leave our bags and walk around the city

The check in receptionist guys were very nice and friendly. I also liked that there was a shared terrace where you could sit and meet new people to hang out with. The only problem for me was the stains on the bathroom counter and bed sheets which also had cigarette burns. It didn’t bother me too much because I was only staying one night. The hotel location is very good it’s close to Galata, metro and buses.

Konakladığımız yerin konumu gitmek istediğimiz yerlere yakınlığı açısından çok rahattı, zorlanmadık. Konakladığımız iki gün sürecince ilgi alakaları için teşekkür ederiz. Odamız temizdi kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik, fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi. Biz çok memnun kaldık İstanbul’a tekrar gelirsem konaklamayı düşünüyorum.

Konum ve ulaşım bakımından ev çok iyi bir konumda. Temizliği açısından da iyiydi. Fakat ışıklandırması kötüydü. Musluk akıtıyordu bu da gece rahatsız edici bir sese sebep oluyordu. Aynı zamanda televizyon çalışmıyor söylediğimizde de tamirci çağrıldığını ve gelip yapacağını söylediler fakat televizyonun bilerek yapılmadığı bariz ortadaydı.

Yer olarak çok merkezi 5 dakika yürüyüşle her yere ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Metroya ve tramvaya çok yakın. Temizlik konusunda da mükemmeldi, yatakları rahattı ve her sorumuza anında yanıt aldık. Fatih Bey’e ilgisi için çok teşekkür ediyoruz . Çatısı deniz görüyordu manzarası çok güzeldi. Ortak mutfakta istediğinizi pişirebilirsiniz. Kesinlikle bir daha geldiğimizde tercih edeceğimiz bir yer olur. Gözü kapalı öneririm.

reviews.text:
I absolutely loved this Airbnb! The moment you walk in, there's an immediate sense of calm and comfort. The air conditioning worked perfectly and kept the space cool and comfortable throughout my stay.
The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the balcony was one of my favorite spots. It’s spacious with cozy furniture, a beautiful view, and a refreshing breeze. Perfect for relaxing any time of day.
The kitchen was spotless and fully equipped with brand-new appliances, which made cooking easy and enjoyable. The entire apartment felt fresh and newly furnished, including the very comfortable couches.
There’s a small grocery store conveniently located right next to the building, which was super helpful. The location itself is ideal. It is surrounded by charming boutiques, cafes, and restaurants. The neighborhood has a great vibe and is perfect for exploring on foot.
I highly recommend this place and would stay here again!

Great apartment in Kadikoy! The view and the patio were really lovely. The bed was comfortable, the wifi was fast, and the water pressure was always strong. The neighborhood is convenient and safe, with lots of restaurants nearby and the train station and ferries within a 10-15 min walk. Yalcin was always friendly and responsive. Highly recommend!

My friends and I were comfortable at Yalçıns apartment! We felt right at home and at ease with check in. It was extremely clean and spacious and had all we needed including a washer and dryer! The balcony was perfect for some fresh air and cute city views! The metro is also about a 10 min walk and close to shops and restaurants. Yalçın was very kind and respectful and very quick to respond when needed!
I hope to be back in the future!

Beautiful and clean space, great patio, so many great restaurants, bars and shops a short walk away. Host was very communicative.
Only advice I have for any future residents is use the AC (which works great ) instead of making my mistake of open windows the first night or two. I got eaten alive by mosquitos! My mistake, nothing against the place.

A decent place to stay 👌
The terrace was great 👍
Could be cleaner, the carpet was a bit messy and apparently the clean up after the previous guests was done in a rush.
There is a stadium located near by and there was a football game during our stay, so it was very loud that night, something to keep in mind.
Would be great to have some basic stuff like tea, oil for cooking, more toilet paper and such.
As already mentioned the terrace is great, but not very private because there's very short barrier between the next terrace and this one. Luckily the other terrace was under construction so there was nobody there.
Also, not a downside per se, but the apartment is on the top floor with no elevator, so it could be difficult for some people to reach it.
The location is great! ✌️

description:
The apartment is located in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, and Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service to keep your comfort at the top, where they can stay like their own home.

reviews.text: Fatih was a great host and this apartment was in an awesome location in Istanbul! Check in and check out were quick and easy. Fatih was very responsive and organized our airport transfers that made coming and going from the airport very easy. The area is very walkable with many things in the neighborhood and the walk down to the ferry station makes it easy to access any part of the city! The apartment itself was wonderful as it was very clean, had everything we needed, and was exactly like the listing. You can definitely hear some noise from the street below but it didn’t bother us much. Would recommend this unit to anyone staying in Istanbul!

The place was everything we needed and very comfortable, perfect location a little noisey at times especially on the weekends but so close to town and all the shops and restaurants. we would 100% stay here again and recommend this airbnb to anyone. A couple of flights of stairs which felt like nothing. Felt very safe. Very accommodating host, flexible check in great communication, helpful and friendly. 5 stars for this Airbnb.

This was a fantastic location if you love party, Istiklal is right across the street. Walkable. Space was neat and clean. AC worked well and the host is super responsive and helpful. Do not hesitate to ask whatever you need, even if that is not related to your stay!

Flat is pristine clean. Kitchen well equipped. Great location, restaurant is just right downstairs, at weekend you will find yourself in the middle of local celebration. Anyway, all music and songs last just till 11pm.

We had a great 2-week stay in Istanbul. The location was excellent — very convenient for exploring the city, with lots of restaurants and attractions nearby. The hosts were very kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay.
It was also very convenient to have both a washing machine and a dishwasher in the apartment, especially for a longer stay.
A couple of things future guests should know: the apartment is on the 4th floor with no elevator, and it can get a bit noisy from the street since there’s a restaurant downstairs. But overall, we were very happy with our stay and would recommend it.

description:
Our house on Bahariye Street is 50 m2 in size. You will have a unique accommodation experience with its modern kitchen, bathroom, living room, carpet and wonderful view

It is within a 5-minute walking distance to the basic transportation network such as the ferry, sea bus, Moda Tram, Bahariye, M4 metro🚇, Marmaray and Metrobus.

If you land at Sabiha Gökçen Airport, get off at M4 Metro Söğütlüçeşme and walk 350 meters,
From Istanbul Airport, take the HAVAIST bus to Kadıköy stop and walk 350 meters to reach your home.

reviews.text: Apartment is falling apart, not like the pictures. Open cables coming out of walls, holes in walls. Wifi and the automatic lock on the door is connected to a plug that's not working. Owner asked us to meddle with the plug to make it work while the plug was making buzzing sounds, very very unsafe. Couldn't make the plug work so couldn't lock or re-enter the apartment due to automatic lock not working. The owner offered a time to come fix the issue, we said that time didn't work. Then owner told us he'll enter the flat despite us saying we're not comfortable people entering while our belongings are in the airbnb. Instead of trying to find a common time to come fix the issue, owner told us to leave the airbnb and cancel the reservation, while we were at the airbnb. First time encountering something like this. We left anyways because we didn't feel safe any more. Owner was disrespectful and unhelpful the entire time. You can find much better places nearby for the same price.

This place is amazing. Great view, kitchen has what a traveler expects. the only issue is that there is no elevator so please keep that in mind.
The place is centrally located and everything you want to do in or around Kadikoy is within walking distance. Host is responsive and when i needed help or had questions, he was on it, attentive and fast. I would definitely stay here again.

Evin konumunun tarifi, her konuda güzel iletişim ve eve girişte kolaylık gayet iyiydi. Evin konumu ve manzarası sebebiyle tercih edilebilir. Evin tek eksisi, mutfak, çarşaflar ve mobilyalar olarak temiz olması fakat tozlu olmasıydı. Temizlik iyileştirilebilir. Onun dışında çok güzel bir konaklamaydı. Ev sahibine çıkış saatinde esneklik yaparak destek olduğu için ve böyle güzel bir evi sunduğu için, internet bulundurduğu için teşekkürler🙏🏻 5/5

Enjoyed the stay. Nice view and neighborhood. Everything was clean.
Just make sure you can take the stairs to fifth floor. Also bring bottle of waters for drinking and temporary use, just in case of water outage in the apartment.

Erken giriş geç çıkış yapma imkanı sağladı, geç çıkmama rağmen uçak saatime kadar valizimi bırakmama müsade etti, evi çok kolay buldum fotoğraflarla ve arayarak anlattı ev temiz ve düzenliydi istediğim her an ev sahibine ulaşabildim mutfak araç gereçleri biraz azdı fakat fiyat performans açıdan değerlendirince sıkıntı yok

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: A great place in an excellent location. Everything was clean and comfortable, communication was smooth, and check-in/check-out was super easy.

Had a wonderful time at Adroniki’s, everything is as advertised and the location is prime, close to everything one could imagine.
The place was clean, quiet, and just a delight to stay at as well.
The host has been very kind since the very first message all the way through checkout. If I return to Beşiktaş, I know where I will be staying.
Gayet temiz,güzel ve sakin bir konaklama noktası idi . Teşekkür ediyorum iletişim kurmada problem yaşamadık . Odanın ısıtması , sıcak su olanakları vs. güzeldi . Teşekkür ediyorum.

Küçük metrajlı bi yer (bu konuda sorun yok zaten fotoğraflarda da böyle belirtiliyor) ancak bu kadar iyi çözülebilirdi diye düşünüyorum. Oda çok iyi çözülmüş. Buranın 2x, 3x büyüklüğünde çok daha iddialı yerlerde olan aksaklıkların hiç biri yoktu. Isıtma iyiydi, klima vardı, oda içi dolaşım kolaydı, lavaboda yerden ısıtma vardı sanki, buzdolabı vardı, boy aynası vardı….. Tam olarak yeterliydi yani.
Ev sahibi de mesajlara anında bakıp yanıt veriyor bu arada. Memnun kaldık.

Burcu Hanım giriş anımızdan itibaren bize yardımcı oldu ve ilgilendi. Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi ve tertemizdi, aksi bir durumla karşılaşmadık. Isınma konusunda da bir sorun yaşamadık, ev sıcacıktı. Konumu itibarıyla çok avantajlı, otobüs ve vapur ile İstanbul’un her noktasına kolayca ulaşılabilir. İkramlar ve misafirperverlik için tekrardan teşekkür ederiz :)

description:

With a great location. Walking distance, 100 meters from Istiklal street. 3 minutes to Madame Tussadus Istanbul, 20 minutes from Galata Tower, 15 minutes from Galataport shopping center. reviews.text: The host was very nice and responsive. The only challenge is that cars cannot reach the hotel door since it’s in a closed neighborhood, so you need to walk a short distance. This was a bit difficult for us as a family of five with a baby and luggage. The location is otherwise excellent, about 5 minutes to Taksim’s main street and 9 minutes to Taksim Square, with plenty of shops and cafes around. A police station next door made us feel safe, and the building has cameras and a secure entry code. The room was spacious, clean, and well equipped with a microwave, mini fridge, utensils, and toiletries. However, we faced issues: no hot water for the first two days, one full day without any water due to maintenance, and two power outages. The building does have an elevator, which was convenient. Overall, we the location, safety, and room comfort were good, but the water and electricity problems made our stay less smooth than expected and it was frustrating.

We had a wonderful stay and were genuinely impressed! The location was amazing - we found the place very easily, and everything important was within walking distance. The hotel/apartment is located on a quiet, cozy street, so despite being close to everything, it was peaceful and comfortable.
We stayed in a very spacious three-bedroom apartment and honestly couldn’t believe we got so much space and comfort for this price. We had an amazing time there.
The host was incredibly kind, responsive, and always ready to help. We felt truly welcomed and experienced such warm hospitality throughout our stay.
Highly recommend this host and this place - we would happily stay here again!

We had a great stay at this Airbnb. The location was amazing, the hosts were very responsive, and everything was clean and comfortable. The apartment is a bit small, but it had everything we needed. Overall, I definitely recommend staying here

2 gece konakladık. Kenan bey eksiklikleri tamamlamak konusunda özveriliydi. Konum oldukça iyi istiklale konumda gözüktüğünden daha bile yakın. Ancak deneyiyimimiz fiyat performans olarak bakıldığında iyi olmakla birlikte odaya girdiğimizde büyük bir böcek ölüsüyle karşılaştık ve temizlikle ilgili takıntınız varsa tertemizdi diyemeyeceğim. Kısa konaklamalar için iyi bir yer olabilir.

Konaklamamdan çok memnun kaldım. Oda temiz, konforlu ve oldukça rahattı. Kenan Bey çok ilgili ve yardımseverdi; kendisine ayrıca teşekkür ederim. Evin konumu da İstiklal Caddesi’ne oldukça yakın, merkezi ve ulaşım açısından çok elverişliydi. Her şey için teşekkürler, tekrar geldiğimde kesinlikle tercih ederim.

description:
Hello from Caferağa! 🏡 This friendly 2+1 apartment is perfect for families and relaxed couples: Queen bed and super WiFi. On the 2nd floor of the 3-storey building – few stairs, sweet view, almost no street noise.

10 min walk to Moda beach, 5 min to Bar Street (but on the quiet side). 6 minutes to the ferry, 15 minutes to Bağdat Avenue by train.

- Experience: Tip: Pies in Baylan in the morning, fresh fruit in Caferağa market at noon.

Family vacations, friend reunions – this place is as warm as home!

reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant stay in Kadıköy. The apartment was clean, spacious, and comfortable, with everything we needed for our stay. The location was very good and convenient for getting around and exploring Istanbul.
The host was helpful, responsive, and supportive throughout our stay, which made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable.
Overall, we had a great experience and would happily recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable and well-located place to stay in Kadıköy.

Nice flat, exactly as described, in a very lively area. It’s comfortable and fully equipped.
Worth noting: the neighbourhood gets quite busy and noisy at night. That said, the bedrooms are at the back of the flat and remain quiet.
Overall, I’d recommend the place. The host communicates clearly and promptly.

We had an excellent stay! The owner was incredibly friendly and provided very clear instructions, making the whole process seamless. The house was spotless upon arrival. What we appreciated most was the level of trust the host placed in us—he didn't even feel the need to do a walkthrough before we checked out. Because we felt so respected, we made sure to clean the house as thoroughly as possible before leaving. Highly recommended!

Great location. The apartment is roomy. There's stove, microwave and big fridge.
AC only works in the guest room.
It was easy to communicate with the hosts via Airbnb website

Highly recommend, not too far from the port, and the buses. 10 minute walk to the bus that takes you to the airport. Hood nigh life, good restaurants (try Kimyon it was so good!). The streets are a bit noisy, but our bedrooms were the opposite end of the apartment so the noise lever were acceptable.
I love Kadiköy and the place is in a great location!

description:
Located on Balat Seaside Road, just steps from the bus stop and within walking distance to the metro, tram and ferry pier, our brand-new modern 4+1 apartment offers a perfect stay. Built in 2023, the flat is fully furnished with all-new furniture and linens. Each room has air conditioning, a private bathroom, and a toilet. Enjoy a comfortable stay in the heart of historic Balat, where the seaside, restaurants, cafés, and shops are all just a short walk away.
balat99 .com

reviews.text:
We stayed in Mr Ali's house for 7D6N, we really loved the place. It was as described - cozy and clean.
The house is fully furnished and has all the amenities listed.
Mr Ali and his family are very helpful and responsible to us.
What makes this house really stood out is it's location : from the beautiful view of Bosphorus to the easily accessible public transport.
It is of walking distance to the metro station and bus stop, and grabbing a taxi from outside the house was very easy as well.
Many varieties of restaurants are located nearby the house, we just needed to walk to these restaurants and cute cafes.
Balat and Fener themselves are full of historical attractions. And for us who are really into art really found this area worthwhile to visit.
We are looking forward to visit and stay in Mr Ali's house in the future as we really enjoyed staying here.
We are really grateful to the host for making our stay memorable.

Ali’s place is perfect for larger groups to stay at Istanbul. The home itself located just around Balat port, so you have a magnificent view of river Halic. A perfect scenery after a long day of exploring the city.
I do recommend Ali’s home to a younger audience who are less afraid of the steep steps leading to the living areas. And also because the area gives off the hustle & bustle of a small town, you can easily find cafés, or other places to hang out, as the home is on the main road. The living areas each floor are well-equipped, but should you need anything else, there’s a store right around the corner for you needs.
Unfortunately, due to some issue unrelated ro the host, the AC units broke down right when there was a holiday in Türkiye, but the hosts were super responsive & managed to organise maintenance service to prioritise us, and the units worked just perfectly fine the day after holiday ended.
Definitely worth its value!

What a great find. Taking my wife and two daughters to vacation is always difficult because of accommodations, and it is very risky to find a place where everyone is comfortable. Look very honestly, if you cannot do stairs, please ignore this row house. But if everyone in your group is okay with stairs, this is basically the best you can ever get. Each floor has a bedroom and A FULL BATHROOM. yes each floor. There are 4 floors of bedrooms and full bathrooms. The top floor is the gathering area, small but sufficient enough to do morning coffee, hello you are in Turkiye,,, of course tea😂.
And late at night, drinks. The view is priceless. My wife did not complain so there you, stop your search, just book it. Keep in mind, multiple floors, always taking stairs, but each bedroom is like an individual hotel room. You get basically 4 hotel rooms, and maybe 5, because I would have slept on the top floor, if I were alone. All within walking distance.

We spent some unforgettable days in a charming apartment in the Balat district of Istanbul. It turned out to be the perfect choice.
The view from the top-floor terrace was breathtaking. The apartment was fully equipped for a comfortable stay; having air conditioning and a private bathroom in every bedroom made our experience even more enjoyable.
The water supply worked flawlessly, even when everyone was using the showers at the same time. The location was incredibly convenient, with the historic city center, excellent transport links, and shops all close by.
While the busy street and the small kitchen are minor points to note, this was hands-down the best accommodation we’ve seen.
Our large group of six fit perfectly and comfortably.
A special thank you to the host for his constant support and readiness to help 📞😎.
If fate brings us back to Istanbul, we will certainly stay in this wonderful apartment again.

Spent a week and were pleased. Great lounge on top floor overlooking a park and the Bosphorus. Very clean and the AC worked great. Close to coffee shops and restaurants. Excellent communication with host(s)....very responsive to the minor issues/questions we had. The layout is typical for an historic home in this area with an en suite bedroom to each floor and the lounge and kitchenette on the top floor. The steps did take some getting used to for us...we are older though very fit. It helped us get our steps in every day.
Glad we chose this place
Thank you

description: Modern 1-bedroom flat in a brand-new (2025) building on a quiet street in Moda, Kadıköy. Features 1 double bedroom, a living room, an open kitchen, a bathroom, and a large private terrace. Includes high-speed fiber internet, Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, iron, vacuum, full kitchenware, and more. Elevator in the building. Just 5 mins from metro, ferry, and public transport. Perfect for couples or solo travelers in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Overall, we had a very good stay. The apartment was clean, cozy, and comfortable. The host was extremely communicative and always available — every question or request was resolved almost instantly, which was honestly a huge plus.
The kitchen was well equipped with all the necessary dishes, and there was even a Turkish coffee machine, which we really loved.
The only thing missing for us was some basic household essentials — for example cleaning supplies and simple kitchen items like salt, sugar, oil, etc.
Other than that, everything was great. Thank you for the hospitality!

Our stay in Istanbul in November was beautiful! Although it was quite warm outside, the place itself is very warm. Everything is exactly like at the pictures. HUGE terrace, well organized place. The location is also perfect. Kadikoy may get a bit busy but this place is located close enough to all the cafes and public transport stops but is also very quiet and peaceful. No noises will disturb you during the night. Communication with the host was perfect! Everything was addressed very quickly. We also were able to leave our luggage and it was super nice that our check out was extended, much appreciated!

Berk's apartment is terrific. The location is really quite something -- it's a short few blocks to the buzz of Kadiköy's cafes and restaurants, and close to extensive transit options (including the metro line, buses, and several different ferries which get you to the European side of Istanbul). Supermarkets, bakeries, banks, pharmacies, etc are all blocks away.
At the same time, it's also a couple blocks from a serene and gorgeous waterfront walking path, which is especially amazing to explore around sunset.
The flat itself is super-clean and functional. There's a really lovely terrace, too. Berk's team met me upon arrival, which was great, and the team was really responsive with any questions.
Kadiköy is definitely an excellent spot to explore Istanbul, and this little corner of it is really wonderful.
Amazing stay! The place was very clean, well organized, and exactly as described. Berk was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommended!

Öncelikle konum harika. Kadıköy Ptt’ye 7 dk yürüme mesafesi. Çok yeni bir daire. Dairede 4 gece annemle kaldık. Zemin katta ve direkt bir bahçeye çıkıyor, bahçede vakit geçirmek için gayet güzel bir alan var ve yeşillik içinde.
İlk gün çok geç bir saatte girdik ve çok yorgunduk. Girişte otomatikte bir sorun yaşandı, kapı bir türlü açılmadı, hemen iletişim numaralarından birini aradık ve çözeceklerini söylediler. İletişimi kuvvetli bir ilan sahibi.
Lavaboda sıvı sabun yoktu iletişime geçsek hemen temin edeceklerinden eminim ama ben sürekli istek belirtmeyi sevmiyorum, çünkü çok temel bir malzeme.
Duşta sıcak suyu ayarlamak ve musluğu anlamakta zorlandık. İlk girdiğimizde klozet çevresinde kıl tüy vardı, koltukta büyük lekeler var, bunlar da rahatsız ediciydi ama genel manada tekrar tercih eder miydim? Evet ederdim.
Pürüzleri halletseler çok konforlu bir daire. Teşekkür ederiz. Tekrar görüşmek dileğiyle.

description: Modern and comfortable apartment located in a central location on a quiet and spacious street. An 8-minute walk to Fenerbahçe Stadium and a 3-minute walk to Bağdat Avenue. Marmaray & Metrobus 15 min, dolmuş and bus stops 5 min. Cafés and restaurants are very close by. Located on the 1st floor of a new, clean building that complies with earthquake regulations. Ideal for short and long stays, with a bright, pleasant living area and basic kitchen equipment.

description:
Step into a serene home with breathtaking Bosphorus views in the heart of Istanbul. This fourth floor one bedroom apartment offers a peaceful retreat with stunning Bosphorus views and a spacious private terrace, set within one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Ideal for both short visits and extended stays.

Please note that the apartment is located on the fourth floor and the building does not have an elevator, but we truly believe the breathtaking view makes it well worth the climb.

reviews.text: Unbearable location next to popular area but tucked away from all the chaos. Modern apartment with fully equipped kitchen. The hist even provided drinking water which is very convenient. Gorgeous view of the Bosphorus. The hosts are always responsive and prompt, no confusion whatsoever. The only downside is this is a fourth floor unit. If you have heavy luggage that means you’re going to have a workout upon checking in and out.
Great apartment and great neighborhood and fabulous view! Very modern and clean and perfect! You have to walk up the hill (or take a taxi/uber) but it is worth it!!

Great place with fantastic view and interesting/lively parts of the city start in that same street.
Downside: The heating system's gas boiler is right next to the bed, so you have to move the mattress to the living room to sleep well.
Great location and the view is well worth the 4 floors up.

description:
Pia Homes - Nevizade

Would you like a perfect stay in the heart of Istanbul's iconic Taksim district?

This modern space is just a 1-minute walk from Istiklal Street and Taksim Square, surrounded by museums, landmarks, shopping, nightlife, and public transportation.

Important Note: Nevizade is a lively entertainment area. On Friday and Saturday nights, street noise and music may continue late. Guests seeking a quiet stay should consider this.

reviews.text: The room was nice and clean, and the location is in a great district. There are plenty of bars, restaurants, and places to go out if you want to party, so it’s perfect for an active stay. The room was a bit smaller than what the pictures suggested, but still comfortable. Pia was very responsive and nice, which made communication easy. Overall, a good stay!

I had a pleasant stay at this booking. The location is excellent—very close to public transport, shops, and restaurants, which made it really easy. The room was clean, comfortable and quiet.
The only issue was the shower, which didn’t work properly and could definitely be improved. Aside from that, everything was fine, and I enjoyed my stay overall.
Her şey temizdi, konumunun çok iyi ooması odanın küçüklüğünü kapatıyor. Gayet iyiydi.
I felt like I got what I paid for. It’s in a central location! Close to every metro station and good coffee shops. The only annoying thing was the smoke from the neighbors.

Yıllardır belki bütün sokaklarında konakladık beyoğlunun ama bu kadar evimde gibi hissettiğim güvende hissettiğim olduğunu hatırlamıyorum temizlik ekibinim samimiyeti içtenliği mekanın temizliği titizliği her türlü ihtiyacı göz önünde bulundurup eksikiz hizmetinizde emeği geçen herkese sonsuz teşekkür ederim… 🤩

description: Make some memories at this unique and family-friendly place.

reviews.text: Temizliğinden ve konumundan çok memnun kaldık. Ev sahibinin talimatları sayesinde giriş-çıkış süreci çok rahattı. Keyifli bir konaklama oldu, tavsiye ederim.

Great value for money, was walking distance to the 4 Seasons and many restaurants and cafes etc. the room had AC and a good shower also, suited me perfectly for my short stay especially for the price I paid for it

Great location, close to the palace and the beautiful Yıldız Park, as well as Ortaköy and Beşiktaş.
Set in a quiet area, yet surrounded by everything you need within walking distance.
Yes, it’s on a hill - so you get the true Istanbul experience!
Friendly and helpful staff.
And if you’re lucky, like I was, to stay in a corner room, you’ll enjoy a partial Bosphorus view - absolutely worth it!

Airbnb de tuttuğum konum ve daireyi 1 gün sonra sizi başka yerde ağırlayacağız diye aradılar ve yeni yerin fotograflarını attılar. Fotograflarda gayet güzel ve bakımlı duruyordu mesafeleride çok uzak değildi kabul ettim. Daha sonra gece giriş yapacağımız için yeni attıkları yere gidince bize reception ile aramızda sadece 1 kapı olan bir yer verdiler. İçerisi köpek bağlasan durmaz derecede pis kokuyor ve kirliydi.

description: Istanbul Beyoglu is a multicultural and 24-hour living attraction center that welcomes tourists from all over the world all year, offering experiences you can't get enough of exploring... Latte3, our chic flat within walking distance to Istiklal Avenue, Taksim Square, and Galata Tower, is waiting for you in the heart of Istanbul! Book now for a flawless stay in our Beyoglu short-term rental flat!

reviews.text: Fiyat/performans açısından değerlendirildiğinde oldukça memnun kaldık. Dairenin konumu bizim için büyük avantaj sağladı; birçok noktaya yürüyerek rahatlıkla ulaşabildik. Konaklama süresince ihtiyaçlarımızı fazlasıyla karşıladı. Tek olumsuz nokta ise binanın bulunduğu bölgede otopark sorunu yaşanmasıydı. Ücretli otoparklar dışında park yeri bulmak oldukça zor. Bunun dışında keyifli ve sorunsuz bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Ev sahibi rezervasyonu yaptığımız süreden konaklama başlangıcına ve konaklama bitişine kadar yapmış olduğu bilgilendirme ve yönlendirmeler için ayrıca teşekkür ederiz.

Excellent apartment in a fantastic location! It’s just a short easy walking to Galata Tower and within easy walking distance of many cafés, restaurants, shops, and public transportation. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything needed for a pleasant stay. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in very easy. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would definitely stay here again.

Ömer is a great, responsive and kind host. He helped us during our stays, responded quickly and provided many recommendations. The apartment is exaktly as described and in a great location! Would recommend any time for a trip to Istanbul

Great stay at Omer’s apartment. Everything was perfect and Omer was a very accommodating and helpful. The location is perfect opposite Galataport and the T1 tramline Tophane station. Definitely recommend for families.

Ömer was a very friendly and welcoming person, he gave a accurate information to enter the place and he was following up my need if there is any. The place was clean and appropriate for stay. I recommend it.
thank you Ömer for your hospitality.

description:
This stylish 1-bedroom residence is located right next to Bomontiada and Hilton Bomonti, one of Istanbul’s most lifestyle and cultural hubs.

The apartment offers a spacious living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and comfortable interiors designed for both short and long stays.

Perfect for business travelers and leisure guests, the residence provides easy access to restaurants, cafes, and entertainment venues in the heart of Şişli.

We look forward to hosting you and wish you a pleasant stay!

reviews.text: This is a large hotel space, and is better described as a suite, instead of an apartment, or house, or home. That being said it was fine for my needs to attend a conference. What I missed are the things you would expect in an actual home such as kitchen towels, dish soap, clothes washer soap, extra blanket, more clothes hangers, etc. There is a clothes washer but no dryer and no clear place to dry clothes (no line/rack/etc), which is a weird combo. Apparently you can ask at the front desk for soap and other consumables like toilet paper.

I went on a “workation” to Istanbul, didn’t want to stay at a hotel, because I wanted more space, so I picked this AirBnB and it was exactly what I needed, beautiful, minimalistic, chill and the noise from the mosques are not loud. I enjoyed it. Also it’s quite cool that you can order meals directly from the restaurant below to your room
Great place, exceptional host fast to reply and attentive
Genius living is great. They are professional & supported me through the whole stay
Felt like at home + reception always there

reviews.text: Great Room, on the 4th floor of a quaint building. There was no noise whatsoever from the street inside the room, and I am extremely sensitive to noise: I didn't even need earplugs, which is very rare for me, even at home. The A/C worked perfectly. The room was clean, linen was fresh, bathroom was clean. It had everything I needed for a 4-day stay in Istanbul. And was about 15-20 minutes walk to the Blue Mosque. The area is very commercial (shoe stores), so absolutely quiet at night (I didn't feel unsafe, though). Although close sultanahmet, there were loads of small restaurants to eat like a local. It was also very close to the tram (5 min walk to Çemberlitas). The host was very responsive and gave me clear instructions for a flexible check in in the middle of the night. He even helped me arrange a transfer, which was much appreciated.

Zeki was very easily reachable, communicated well and helped out in every way. The place is close to many attractions, easy access to store and tram. The apartment itself was comfortable, perfect for a few day visit, matches the price. Only downside is that the balcony was a dirty and the outdoor furniture was unusable. Otherwise the place gives you the perfect Istanbul feeling!

Mükemmel konum..
Topkapı Sarayı, camiler ve müzelere çok yakındı rahatça gezdik. Temiz ve tüm ihtiyaçlarımıza uygundu. Memnun ayrıldık, tekrar tercih edebiliriz.

Fotoğraflarda gözüktüğü gibi ihtiyaçlarınızı rahatça karşılayabileceğiniz, konforlu, temiz bir odaydı. Balkon detayı en ilgi çekici kısımlardan biri denilebilir, oldukça güzel ve geniş bir balkon. Ulaşımı gayet rahat, basit bir şekilde bulunabilir, işlek bir yerde olduğu için her şeye ulaşmak da kolaydı. İletişim konusunda hiçbir sıkıntı yaşamadık, genel olarak güzel bir deneyim oldu.
Zeki was a helpful person and the location was good 6 min walking to tram , the place is calm at night

description: The flat is situated at an elite quarter in the heart of Istanbul.You will have the chance to view from the living room and garden terrace the major landmarks of the city such as Santa Sophia Museum, the Topkapi Palace, the Blue Mosque, etc.

reviews.text:
The location of this place is superb, with great views over the city. It is safe, and with great transport links. It is way to walk to many popular tourist destinations. Whatever imperfections this place may have, they are more than compensated by the magnificent city views.
We enjoyed our stay, and the host Ilhan was great to communicate with, and extremely resourceful and kind with offering his help when we got ourselves into trouble.
The beds are very comfortable and the bed linens and towels are very clean. The kitchen is well equipped and we found there everything we needed, including supplies of sugar, tea and coffee.
I would only mention that the apartment is on the top floor, right under the roof, and the ceiling is very low. Also, remember there are six flights of stairs to climb, no lift. Finally, the smells in that part of town can be quite strong, so prepare your senses. The bathroom could be better ventilated, too.
Overall, we would stay ther again, if we were in Istanbul for another visit.
We would recommend local restaurant BARAN (Kuloğlu, Turnacıbaşı Cd. No:39). Fantastic value for money and great food, a great find, always full of locals!

What a delightful place to spend a week. Although it’s quite a climb up 6 floors, the view is amazing and worth every step. Wonderful,windows and balcony to rake in the Beaty of Istanbul. Although the apartment is quite simply furnished it’s comfortable. The beds and couch are great. The kitchen is basic but came stocked with spices, oil, vinegar, etc as well as ample paper towels, cleaning products and drinking water. Plenty of sheets, towels and blankets as well kettle for water, French press for coffee and plenty of pots, pans, and dishes. Doesn’t have oven, microwave, or toaster but worked fine for us.
The location is perfect - it’s close to everything you want to see and do in Istanbul. The Cihangir neighborhood is bursting with cafes, restaurants, and all kinds of shops. All of this makes it a great place to stay. Host İlhan is very communicative and a great source of helpful tips. Mobility limited people will want to consider a different place to stay, but if you’re up to a 6th floor walk up, it’s amazing. Hope to stay here soon again!

Perfect location for our trip to Istanbul. The apartment offers everything you could want including: comfortable beds & living room, clean kitchen & bathroom, beautiful view of the city (especially the Golden Horn).

The Cihangir neighborhood is very cool & welcoming. We enjoyed finding delicious cafes and restaurants along the winding streets. Also walking-distance from the vibrant Istiklal and Nevizade areas.

Ilhan is a pleasure to deal with & extremely accessible. He has posted a giant map of Istanbul in the entryway which provides a very helpful view of the city including points of interests, metro stops & markets.

5 stars; 10 out of 10; highly recommended.

We had a fabulous time in Istanbul and this was the perfect location to enjoy the old city. It's close to the hustle and vibrancy of Taksim Square as well as the historic Galata Tower. There are a number of small to medium sized grocery and convenience stores close by so it's easy to cook a meal or two at the apartment.

The absolute best thing about this space is the spectacular view. It was truly a joy to wake up every morning of our week long stay to the sight of Istanbul and the Bosphorus in the distance.

There are some challenges to this apartment. There are five flights of stairs to the suite and the kitchen is very small, which makes cooking a little difficult. We ate out most of the time, but usually like to prepare some food in-house. Having said that, the kitchen was fairly well equipped and Ilhan even provided some basic spices, oil, milk etc., which was nice. There were actually a lot of nice things supplied -- hair dryer, laundry soap, basic toiletries, umbrellas and a wall-sized map of the city -- all very helpful.

The two bedrooms are a good size and the bed we slept in was comfortable. The space was very clean upon our arrival and Ilhan provided us with a good overview of neighbourhood despite the late hour we showed up due to plane delays.

All-in-all, we'd recommend this space provided you don't mind the challenges outlined above.

Everything was perfect with this apartment. Clean, beds were comfortable, kitchen stocks with essentials. several flights up but the view from the apartment made it well worth the exercise! Amazing view of Istanbul. and located within walking distance to trams, and great restaurants. spent 5 nights here and wasn't ready to leave. Ilhan was the perfect host. Highly recommend!!!!

description:
My apartment is just one step to metro, ferry, and buses. If you would like to stay in a safe, cheerful and social neighborhood, my flat is the best for you. It's in the middle of the best cafes, bars, restaurants, bakery, and boutique stores in Kadıköy. You can walk to Bosphorus in 2 minutes from my apartment.
There is a double size bed, 3 doors wardrobe, work table, side drawer, bookshelves in the room. I share my kitchen stuff, wi-fi internet, bathroom, laundry and such things with my guests

reviews.text: This is a great deal! I stayed with Firat in Kadiköy for two weeks, and had the best trip of my life! He’ll be the first to tell you his place is not “classy”, but it is comfortable, clean, convenient, and Firat is simply the best host! He is friendly, helpful, positive, has a great sense of humor — and really makes you feel at home. His English is very good, and he really knows the city. His place is a 5th-floor walk-up, but I’m 66 and it was no problem for me. Good exercise! The apartment is on a quiet street just a 3 minute walk in any direction from markets, pubs, restaurants, shopping, night life, and the ferry terminal! I found carpets at a shop three blocks from his flat for a fraction of the prices in Grand Bazaar! They say location is everything, and in this case it is certainly true. I rate my experience with Firat with as many stars as possible, and would stay with him again any time!

Firat is a very kind, easy-going and friendly host who will go out of his way to make you feel at home. The room is clean and comfortable and the location is excellent. There are many cafes, restaurants and bars in the area and it is not as touristy as Sultanahmet. This means that prices are generally a bit lower and you don't need to deal with all the touts as you're walking around. In addition, I really enjoyed the beautiful 20-minute ferry ride across the Bosphorus every morning on my way to the tourist sites. I definitely, recommend staying in Kadikoy for a more authentic and relaxing experience and Firat's place is a great choice.

Necat and hıs sıster are the best kind hospitable people I have met in Istanbul. These two weeks were my happy experience: the flat and the room are very clean and cosy. The guest room I stayed in, was very big, in comparison with other variants for the same price in the city. The bed and blackout curtain made so comfortable to sleep. The interior of the flat is made so stylish and some things of furniture and all paintings are handmade. When I came, Necat helped me with luggage. i felt like home. They told me so much interesting and unique details about Istanbul and Turkey and wonderful stories. Always offered me tea and nice food Necat cooked. The location of the place is my favourite in the city: 5 minutes from ferry station, but very quite street, it is safe and beautiful, green neighborhood, nice people are living here. If you are lucky to have the opportunity book this place, I recommend you to do the booking with no doubt. We had wonderful chat together - this is my first time in using airbnb, and i am so satisfied and happy. Necat, Thank u so much! Everything was great) I will come back definitely to you, see u soon)

The location is superb. Access to all public transport within 5-10 mins (for subway). The neighborhood is local, no tourist crowds. Tons of cozy cafes with delicious coffee and brekfast, dinner, anything you want really. The bread and produce are also of good quality.
The room is exactly as described, black out curtains for good night sleep and the bed is really comfortable. Plenty of space.
The stay here was the right choice. Neçat and Meral are wonderful people whose hospitality extends beyond formal niceties. It is truly sweet home Kadikoy. I loved every day of it. Thank you both for your warm welcome❤
Have no doubts about booking here.

This apartment could not be in a better location. Literally a 5-10 minute walk from everywhere you will possibly need. The ferries, the metro, the shopping area, cafes, bars, restaurants...it was all perfect. Firat was very helpful and even took time out to take me sight seeing on the European side and had great knowledge of the area which made my trip even better to be shown around by someone local. His apartment is in an old building with no elevator and about 60 stairs to climb but it keeps you fit! The apartment is so cute and my room was pretty much perfect. Lots of space and a very comfy bed! I had the best time there and would not hesitate to stay there again and recommend his apartment to everyone. x

description:
In my house located right next to the first residential historical Istanbul region;
A fully equipped kitchen;
Public transportation everywhere;
Balcony with great view;
24-hour hot water, shower facilities;
Free Wifi;
Fan in the room,
Washing machine and free detergent;
Complimentary tea and coffee;
A great shared living room.
I'm waiting for you at my home. 🙂
My house is on a street walking uphill and is not modern as it is in most part of Istanbul.
Book now if you're sure my home is a good fit.🤗

reviews.text: This clean and comfortable, bedbug-free home features a fully equipped kitchen that’s perfect for longer stays. The highlight is the wonderful balcony with beautiful views and stunning sunsets, making it a great place to relax after a day of exploring. Located in a safe neighborhood with plenty of late-night dining options, it also has an incredibly attentive and friendly host who goes out of their way to make every stay enjoyable. Highly recommended!

very dirty place
stairs are terrible
dirty nasty washroom
the balcony on the pictures is a scam.....as it is trough another rented room ....no access
dirty smell fridge
lots of clusters everywhere
over used pillows and bed sheets
many many side roads and uphill location
I couldn't stay for 1hr and just left😡😡😡😡😡

The place was same as pictures. A bit rought to walk because it is on a hill and you need to walk 3-5 minute ramp. Room is on ground floor and window directly sees street so street sees too but there was curtain. Beds was comfy and duvet covers was super clean but carpet and floor were little bit dirty so we used slipper. We had some private problems but Mr. Özay was super helpful and hospitable. I am so satisfied about Mr. Özay's accomodation.

Özay is responding fast and is happy to help if anything is needed.
The place is quiet and big, location is fine.
The appartment is generally overdue for maintenance. Even though the hosts roughly cleans the surfaces every day, the Appartement seems pretty dirty. Especially the bathroom and the windows. The kitchen was kept clean well though. I mopped my own room and the water was very dark. Also the shelves of the closet wasn’t wiped for ages.
You get what you pay for - the stay was okay.
Now I prefer spending 2-3$ more a night and get a better place.
Excellent host, ozay is very responsive and helpful. The space was really clean and matched the photos.

description: Custom-renovated one-bed apartment in the historic area of Fener/Balat, within the walls of the Old City of Constantinople. Full kitchen, bathroom plus living room, internet, washing machine. 40 m2. Easy access to all Istanbul's most important sites.

reviews.text: Isle was the ultimate host. She was present at the appartment when we arrived and made us very comfortable.We could contact her by sms at all times to ask for basic info. She was very helpful. The unit is on the ground floor and easy accessible. After settling Isle took us to a local coffee shop and we met up with her friend Kennard who was part of our daily routine. The appartment set in very old authentic part of Istanbul, away from the touristy areas. It is accesable by taxi and close to main route to all the important tourist atractions on the Golden Horn and Sultanamet 10 TL. Had a daily walk to the local bakery for fresh bread and supplies and experienced the local area. Street activity during day with vendors selling there products was lovely to see. The unit very well decorated (like pictures) and very clean. It is a four sleeper with double bed and sleeper couch in seperate room.The kitchen needs more utensils and and cutlery. I would recommend visitors to stay in this unit

This is a great value apartment in a fascinating neighbourhood that is in transition: very interesting for photography and exploration. The beautiful Chora Church and intriguing Edirnikape neighbourhood are a 15 minute climb away. A great bakery cafe is just a few minutes walk down toward the water. Lindsay was not there but Isil will greet you and is so kind and helpful that I worry she may tire herself out! She gave a great orientation and assisted with many questions as it was my first visit to Turkey. Please don't take advantage of her kindness! I would definitely stay here again. The weather was quite cool but unlike in other places I have travelled, and that includes staying in many hotels over the years, there was good heating if needed. What you see in the pictures is exactly what is offered. My only suggestion would be to swap the sitting room and bedroom as the back room is quieter for sleeping. Tesekkur ederim!

my husband and I stayed at Isil's apartment at the end of july for 4 days.

it is on the first floor, even a bit bigger than on the pictures, very-very clean (which was very important for us taking into account our previous experience), just renovated and cozy. the bathroom is quite comfortable, the water is good - no "contrast shower" as sometimes happen in other flats. we tried the washing machine and its doing good :) the bed is big and very convenient! and the ventilator above the bed is also doing good - it was not hot in the appartment. we were not disturbed by anything during our stay (no outside and inside noises).

as for location - we liked it. there is a bus station not far away from the flat - so, all sightseeings are reachable quite in a short period as public transportation is very good in Istanbul. we liked the atmosphere of the location - it is not a touristic place, everyday life of Istanbul people is just around you - a lot of children playing all the day outside (so it is a safe place), drying lingerie along the streets, cats and cockerels :).

Isil has given good corrections to our plans so it was a fantastic, full of emotions and impressions trip. she is very hospitable, friendly and very sunny person. we are very happy we have chosen her place!

thank you dear Isil! we wish you a very good luck and lots of nice and open-minded guest! hope to be back in Istanbul one day and see you again :)

My girlfriend and i stayed in this lovely apartment for a week.
Lets start with the place itself! A nice decorated, newly renovated studio with a good amount of living space and storage & nice clean kitchen & bathroom.
Right bang in the centre of historical Constantinople in the district of feneh the location is perfect if your in town for some historic treats and a taste of real life in old Istanbul. The area is working class, low income but dont let this put you off! people are very friendly and children play in the streets. If you are on a business trip or just plan on hitting the rooftop bars and clubs then i would say check into a hotel but if you want to get a sense of the sounds, sights, history & culture of real Istanbul and its people then this place is a real diamond!! 2 minutes walk to the bus which gets you over to the tram/bus/ferry port of eminonu in 5 mins, from here istanbul is at your feet!
Last but by no means least our amazing host Isil. After a warm welcome at 2am! to ensure we had everything we needed we met the following day at a local bakery to sample local breakfast and of course turkish tea. Isil and her friend paul are extremely knowledgable on the subject of Istanbul, its history and its future and I could have sat and listened for the whole day but we had some sights to see and again they were more than helpful with transport advice, where when and how to get there and a few insider tips too. We met up once more during our stay and had a great time been shown around some istanbulli hot spots you wouldn't find without such a guide. Thanks Isil!!
I dont usually leave comments or feedback but here i made an exception, a wonderful week in a real unique city with a little help from a great host!!
10/10

Isil was a great landlady. She was super kind and welcoming from the first sight. We had a chance to have a coffee before I rent the flat and she told me every detail about the neighborhood. So I knew what exactly to expect and I can honestly say that both the flat and her attitude was above my expectations.
The flat is small but ideal for a couple and even for two couples. We had everything we needed, even the towels and detergent for the laundry. The flat was cleaned in advance of our arrival so we entered to a flat which was brand new. The building is a renovated building in Balat. Balat is a historical neighborhood where you can experience 1960s Istanbul. It is only 10 minutes to the historical city and 15 minutes to Taksim. A cab willl cost you max 15 TL from Taksim if you wanna go out at night. You can have a morning walk at the seaside and than a photo shooting sessions at the amazing streets full of old buildings and kids around. The neighborhood is extremely safe, even at night. There are people living from all segments of the society and they are all friendly and welcoming.
We stayed for 10 days in the flat and Isil was always there and nicely asked us if we need anything or if we were happy or not. There was a problem about the toilet in the first days but she solved it as soon as we told it to her and she even made the house cleaned after the repair.
In the end of the 10th day, I was really sad to leave. It is such a cozy and homy atmosphere that you will enjoy every minute of your stay !

description: The flat is just next to Galata Tower which is one of the most famous historical landmarks of Istanbul. It is in the intersection of local and other touristical areas also 3 minutes away from metro and bus stations where you can also hail a cap. There are many boutique cafes around where you can have coffee - breakfast ( One is under the building opposite the supermarket) The rooftop with breathtaking view is accessible for you to take your breakfast or a grab a drink at nights.

reviews.text:
The place is very close to Galata Tower which makes it a great location near restaurants, bars, coffee places, and attractions. A little bit of the noise from the busy streets comes through but it is not excessive, however, if you are looking for a peaceful/quiet place this is not for you.
The place is cozy and perfect for a quick stay just like described and shown in the pictures. It does need a deep clean in general, the shower is also moldy. The bed and pillows are very comfortable. There is a washer available which was a life saver. The host was nice to leave water for us which was helpful as we arrived late. In general I recommend the place and host

The location of the apartment is fantastic, it really is right under the tower.
The booking process was simple and we received immediate confirmation from the hosts. Our flights were night flights and we received very clear instructions for check in and check out with clear photos on how to find the apartment.
The apartment was ok, much smaller and older than it looked in the photos. We were disappointed with it but it did the job.
We didn’t cook there, that would be difficult. We had to buy wine glasses as cupboards were poorly stocked. No dishtowel was provided for the kitchen and only one set of bathroom towels were provided for 6 nights. Bedroom is ok but access to bed is from one side only. Bathroom was not good. Tiny and needs a deep clean. Shower head is broken and shower tray and curtain full of mould. No handles on vanity unit doors, bits of string instead. We did not use the roof top, it was run down and needed a clean.

First off, communication before, during and after our stay was great (through WhatsApp). We were personally checked in by Chiko's cousin who showed us everything in the place - we even met him once at the tea place next door, and he invited us to join ;-)
It really is within short walking distance of Galata Tower and the cousin helped us with the luggage.
The place was pictured in the listing, and had been cleaned just before our arrival. The bathroom was simple but also clean; and the fridge was pre-stocked with a bottle of water. The kitchen(ette) has the basic equipment - as pictured - and is enough to whip up a simple meal. (Air-conditioning was out of order when we were there, which can happen. Chiko provided fans for cooling, and assured us that by now a new and improved unit has been installed for future guests.)
The location was really great. This was our first time to Istanbul, and the Galata area seemed much more laid back than the Sultanahmet/Eminönü side where all the "must see" spots are. You'll find food and drink places nearby and you can be at the Galata bridge within 10 minutes of walking. A collection of guide books was in the flat, in case you forget yours.
The best part was the rooftop terrace, which was great to enjoy the sunset and offered an amazing view on the Golden Horn and most of historic Istanbul. Just grab a few beer and snacks from the supermarket around the corner and enjoy.
You can reach Galata tower easily by taxi or public transport - given the current state of the Turkish Lira, getting a taxi to/from the airport is quite affordable compared to other major cities.
We stayed at the apartment as a couple, for which it was perfect, and you'll probably with 1 or two smaller children on the couch. (Staying with 4 adults is also possible, but I guess you'll have some "hostel dorm" feeling in that case). Note that this place isn't for you if you are of limited mobility - you must be able to navigate a flight of stairs to get there.

Place was very well located , the terrace worth the stay and communication was perfect .
The cleanliness was at the worst possible stage . The sofa was was filthy ( it was covered so was ok ) but to sleep on it it’s not recommended!
The kitchen was dirty , no clean plates , the knives were like in the Bedouin’s home where there is no water supplies!
The place was dark and because we were only 2 nights and almost few hours on third due to a very early flight, we did not consider the hassle of moving !
Bed ok !

Nice clean and cozy apartment close to the Galata Tower, shops, and restaurants. About 1.6 mile walk to the Sultanahmet area. No elevator, street noise until late, and some repairs are needed especially in the bathroom (door does not close and needs replacement hinge screws, the shower head has no support rod and hangs freely, and a power outlet is not secured to the wall. For the price it is okay.
