reviews.text: We only stayed for 2 nights, but I am so glad to have had my last experience in Turkey be here. Despite our very unfortunate transfer times (very late at night and very early in the morning) Basma was very supportive and flexible...even staying to welcome us in at 1 am. She was also able to accommodate my brother with a space in the living room on short notice.The room was fine, the bed was soft and comfortable, and the shower was perfectly warm. I appreciated how close she is to 2 metro lines, and taxis into Sultanahmet were very cheap. The neighborhood had anything you'd need from clean socks (at the end of our trip we did!) to breakfast and a shave. I would recommend this place to a friend looking for comfortable, affordable spot with a gracious host.

…from MONTE CARLO with LOVE!

In all my years travelling the globe, this was the first time staying with a host and the result was a formidable experience. My parents stayed in one room and I had the other which boasted a mattress from Heaven, so needless to say, I slept like a baby.

Basma opened her home and her heart, in return we adopted her as part of our family. She is warm, sincere, happy and an excellent host, we were most impressed and were privileged to spend time with her as we discovered Istanbul for the first time. Our visit was during Ramadan and we were fascinated to be immersed in the culture and its traditions. Almost every evening Basma shared with us and her closest friends, Iftar, the evening meal when Muslims end their fast at the time of sunset. She spoiled us with her cooking!

Her flat is perfectly located on a quiet street and just a 2 minute walk to the tramway. Just 6 stops away is Sultanahmet, the oldest part of Istanbul and the location of most of its historical sights: Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Hagia Irene, Sultanahmet Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Hippodrome, The Museum of Archeology, Great Palace Mosaics Museum, Museum of Turkish and Islamic Art, Million, Gülhane Park and Soğukçeşme Street.

Staying on the same tram for another 3 stops to tramway stop Eminönü takes you to the famous Spice Market, the New Mosque and up the hill, the impressive Süleymaniye Mosque, an Ottoman imperial mosque located on the Third Hill of Istanbul and the largest in the city. On this same tramway stop are the ferris that cross the Bosphorus to Uskudar, the Asian side. Make sure to take the ferry around sunset for breathtaking views. Expect Basma’s insider tips, discover more for less!

Now cross the bridge by foot or get off at tramway stop Karakoy to catch the magnificent Tunel which takes you up to the chic Istiklal Caddesi (Istiklal Avenue) which ends in the famous Taksim Square.

From the next tramway stop, Tophane, the famous Istanbul Modern is a short walk away. This magnificent museum of contemporary art is a “must-see” and still an insider secret.

Basma provides her guests with a tramway card which you can charge up thus saving substantially.

Her apartment may be modest but it’s clean, convenient and full of love. Unfortunately, the Singapore guest before us, Khairiyah, was not only abusive and untrue, but through her review she aims to discredit Basma’s efforts. Unfortunately, few people like this exist, and its best to ignore them.

Today is Eid al-Fitr, an important religious holiday celebrated by Muslims worldwide that marks the end of Ramadan, the Islamic holy month of fasting. From Monte Carlo we send Basma are best wishes for health, peace and joy!

Thank you for making Istanbul an experience we will never forget. You’re an exceptional host, congratulations!

Much love, David, Mama and Papa

It's a simple bit comfortable and clean apartment. The location is pretty good, you can get on a tram that is 3 min walk from the apartment and get to Sultanahmet, Topkapi Palace, the market or the quay very fast. Bus to Taksim Sq is also near, so it makes a trip to SAW airport rather convinient. Basma is soooo nice, she treated me with tea and cookies on arrival, after a very long trip it was great! She gave me tips on what to do and where to eat during my 2 day stay, I appreciated it greatly. The bed was comfortable, the room and bathroom were clean.

Great place and clean, Near to Yusufpasha tram and aksaray metro, The airport bus Havaist stop very close. We were always go to Blue mosque and Grand bazar walking, you can go to everywhere very easy. Many restaurants around home by local price. we recommend Basma's home.

My husband and I had an excellent time at Basma's place. Basma was kind warm and took care of our every need. She did more than was required to make our stay as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. The flat was clean and comfortable. The location was excellent and it was very easy to get to all the main touristic hot spots. Basma is a lovely person and she took great care of us. Many thanks Basma for everything!!

description:
Top renovated and furnished central flat, 3 minutes walking distance from Istiklal street with all its bars, coffee shops and other boutiques.

The flat has two bedrooms and one living room.
One 140 cm bed, one 90 cm bed and one couch/sofa.

reviews.text:
We've been somehow followed by bad luck while staying in Mersin's apartment for two weeks. Upon arrival the toilet was very dirty, and even though the cleaning lady came and without using any detergents cleaned it somehow, it was not really as we would expect.
The apartment itself is very nice, but as it is on the ground floor you never get any real sunlight, and don't know how the weather is outside. The neighborhood is very dirty, but very convenient location and local shops and restaurants are accessible … however don’t expect to buy a glass of wine there.
Waking up on a Saturday night and not having running water was very unpleasant (people say it is not uncommon in this area), but it was even worse when it happened to us after a long day of working and wanting to wash our hairs on the next day morning.
The internet is not excellent but you’re lucky if it works, our balance was 3 days without internet connection, which is not the best thing if you want to stay connected or urgent things to solve.
Having said all this I have to mention Mersin was very responsive and his mother very willing to solve our problems that became frequent during our stay … and I would even recommend this apartment for you if I didn’t have a visitor on the terrace on our last morning … a well fed rat smiling at me (photo: https://www.dropbox.com/sc/3ki0pqfq0p6pwjx/AACOipev-kuDoh0XVXJpmoo4a) .

Our one-month stay at Mersin's apartment was high-quality comfort and fun. Many factors contributed to our amazing stay in Istanbul :
1) Location. Perfect neighborhood. 5 minute walk to Galata Tower, 5-10 minute walk to Tram and Metro stations that will get you all around the city, 30 minute walk to SultanAhmet and all the Old City attractions, 5 minute walk to main shopping street and cool bar sector. Very close to markets and convenience stores.
2) Easy, fast and efficient communication with host. Whenever we needed his assistance, his answers were quick and cordial. His assistant's professionalism was impressive and very much appreciated.
3) Comfortable and practical apartment overall. Two bedrooms (one double bed, one single bed, the place is perfect for a party of three), nice open-space living room and kitchen area (full kitchen, good for cooking), entertainment system (TV and sound system in which you can plug your phone/pod/pad). Very good internet connexion.
We found Mersin's apartment to be great quality at great price. Book it. Do not hesitate.
Notre séjour dans l'appart à Mersin s'est soldé par beaucoup de plaisir et de relaxation. La qualité de notre incroyable expérience Stanbouliote a été marquée par plusieurs facteurs :
1) L'emplacement. Quartier idéal. 5 minute de marche de la Tour de Galata, 5-10 minutes de marche du Tram et du Métro, qui vous mèneront partout en ville, 30 minutes de marche de SultanAhmet et tous les attraits de la vieille ville, 5 minutes de marche de la principale avenue commerciale et du quartier cool des bars. Près de marchés et dépanneurs du coin.
2) Communication facile, rapide et efficace avec l'hôte. En cas de besoin, Mersin a toujours répondu très rapidement et de façon cordiale. Le professionalisme de son assistant nous a impressionné et a été très apprécié.
3) Appartement très pratique et confortable. Deux chambres (un lit double, un lit simple, parfait pour trois personnes). Très agréable aire ouverte salon-cuisine. Cuisine complète et parfaite pour préparer quelques repas. Télévision et système de son dans lequel vous pouvez brancher votre téléphone/pod/pad. Excellente connection internet.
Nous croyons que l'appart à Mersin représente un excellent rapport qualité-prix. Réservez. Sans hésiter.

We were met by assistant on time when we arrived. Mersin wasn't himself there, but he was constantly in touch over internet and very responsive to our requests.
Apartment is nicely furnished and well stocked with kitchenware, soaps and other necessary stuff. White style decor makes you feel like having more space. Everything was fairly new and very clean and tidy. Beds were soft and comfy. The bathroom has all things you need, except toothbrush and paste. Washing machine in bathroom is very handy. The grocery store is right at the corner. But I would recommend going down towards Tophane turn left and there is a minimarket opposite to a small park, there you'll have a wider choice.
About the neighborhood itself. It's very close to Galata tower and Istiklal street. Tophane train station is 2 minutes walk from apartment. You can also reach Sishane metro station in 10 minutes walk. But I would say that this place is for younger crowd. Stone paved streets around can be quite steep and can require some stamina to walk, especially towards Istiklal. The streets there could be cleaner, sometimes there are small bits of trash laying around.
Liked our stay in apartment a lot. I think it's one of the best offers in that neighborhood and I would definitely stay again there.

We were very happy with Mersin's apartment. It is very clean and exactly as pictured in the listing. Very spacious, everything we needed and more in the kitchen, excellent wifi, and we very much appareciated having a washing machine. The location is excellent - a three minute walk to Tophane tram station on the T1 line which gets you to Sultanahmet and other convenient locations. There were great cafés a 10 minute walk away in Cihangir. Key exchange worked very well. Mersin's assistant met us at the apartment at about 10pm after our flight was delayed. The only drawback in our view, which others might not see as a drawback, was lack of interaction with the host. Mersin checked in frequently via this website and I always felt he was totally available for questions. However, we did not meet in person. Compared to other Airbnb apartments, i missed having a local contact who gives recommendations of places nearby, etc. Overall, highly recommend this apartment.
Clean flat, exactly as in the photos. Good location in the old town. Mersin and his assistant were helpful. Can recommend it to others

description: 50 meters from A plus Shopping Mall (next to the A plus mall) Very close to the seaside, cute, 65 m2 (65 m2 cozy) apartment on the ground floor. Wi-Fi, Netflix, cable TV...

reviews.text: I satyed at Canan's place in December 2020, during pandemic. I needed a place to quarantine after I arrived Istanbul, before I saw my family. I chose the location because it was near where my family lived at the time. Location is perfect, walking distance to Maramaray, very nice mall with a market, a downtown area with restaurants, food shops etc. Canan was great from the time I booked her place until I checked out. She was responsive, thoughtful and always available. Check in was very smooth. She had left some snacks and drinks in the apartment for me as I arrived late in the evening, during weekend when there was a curfew. The apartment was spotles, clean. I loved the design. I stayed there for a week, worked remotely. So I spent a lot of time inside the apartment . I was as comfortable as I could be at my home. I had a very pleasant stay. Would recommend her place to tourists as it is super close to Marmaray which takes you to all major sites very quickly and you can relax after a long day of sightseeing. Thanks again Canan.

Canan is a professional host and a kind-hearted person. She did her best to make our stay comfortable and hassle free. We got help every time we needed it. It was a great luck for us to find this apartment. It's equipped very well with everything you might need during your holidays.
The location is convenient, between the mall and a small local market with lots of cafes. There's even a small park by the sea in a walking distance - Baruthane Millet Bahçesi. To reach it go to the SeaPearl Ataköy first and then move along the road because there's no other way to cross the road nearby.
The surface is relatively flat in the area unlike in many other Istanbul districts. The free parking space is not a problem at all.

Loved my stay. Everything turned out to be as described in Canan’s listing and other guests’ reviews.
Home and location had everything you needed. Be it for home cooking or dining out or other daily needs.
Transportation was great - taxi station, Marmaray train station, istanbul airport transfer bus stop (havaist), all within walking distance. There is also other bus stops and routes but I didn’t try those.
Her unit itself felt cosy. Great for solo travelers or couples. Not too small. Not too big. Easy to maintain. Plenty of wardrobe space for those who want to stay longer.
If you need top up of something (e.g. i needed more toilet paper), Canan got it done almost instantly!
Groundskeepers were also very friendly and helpful.
Language seemed like a barrier at first for everyone but all was easily overcome with patience, friendliness and warmth.
I also felt safe living there.
Felt sad leaving.
It was my first airbnb experience and it turned out to be a very pleasant one.

I lived in an apartment with my girlfriend for over a month. A very nice quiet area with excellent infrastructure: a large shopping center across the road, a market, cafes, bank branches within 3 minutes walk, 10 minutes to the park and the embankment.
The apartment is well prepared for a long stay: everything is very clean, plenty of storage space, a complete kitchen, fast wi-fi.
It is also very convenient and fast to get to the historic city center - 15 minutes by train and you are in Sultanahmet.
The hostess is very polite and responsive.

Loved our stay here!
A very nice quiet area with excellent infrastructure. The apartment is clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Everything was perfect!
But the real standout was Canan herself. She was an incredible host - friendly, helpful, and always quick to respond to any questions or concerns we had. She made sure we had everything we needed and made us feel welcome in her home.
Would love to come back!

description: Step into a piece of history with our exquisite 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment, a true gem in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Beyoglu district. Originally crafted by the renowned architect Giulio Mongeri in 1904, this remarkable space preserves its historical charm with 4-meter-high ceilings, original walls, doors, windows, and even the main door. The kitchen showcases its classical roots with an authentic cookstove and range hood, adding a touch of nostalgia to your modern Istanbul experience.

reviews.text:
Beautiful apartment in a central location. It is exactly how the pictures show it to be and better! The interior decor is great with personal touches. The place is not very hard to find, although our taxi drivers through out our stay were a bit dramatic and struggled to find out. The host was absolutely lovely and helped direct our taxi driver to the location.
The apartment is bright, spacious and very nicely decorated. The beds are super comfortable and climate control is fantastic. The kitchen is modern and spacious and having dishwasher was wonderful.
The TV system was great, but we did need help from the host who personally popped in an helped switch it over to the English mode. The kids were happy to have their programs on YouTube and Netflix. The internet was brilliant but it does cut off when you are in the kitchen area.
The water pressure in the showers was great- although we did have a slight problem with the hot water temporarily stop working but the host and I resolved it over the phone, despite the late hour.
The apartment is in a very central location and is extremely charming. There are a couple of convenient stores close by and there is also a Metro Stop close by. The only problem we encountered was that in 2 of the 3 nights we stayed at this fantastic property, the lift was not working. Since the apartment is on the 5th floor this was a slight problem with kids and older people. Overall, we could not have asked for a better location and we all wished we could stay longer.
Thank you Missy for opening your beautiful home to us. It was a long overdue family holiday and my parent's 40th wedding anniversary and it could not have been more perfect!

We are very grateful to the host! Great location, lots of food nearby and plenty to explore with kids. We came for a family reunion, and everyone had their own bedroom. Big plus: the main bedrooms have ACs, so each person could set their own temperature, helpful since our parents like it warm, and we don’t! The bunk bed room has fans, but stayed cool when ACs in other rooms were on.
The kitchen is functional, our parents even cooked soup, and we had breakfast in the apartment every day. The neighborhood is lively but quiet at night thanks to the 5th-floor location (with elevator).
Bathrooms are a bit unusual, but having three of them, all clean and working, was a huge plus. Laundry was convenient too. Trams are nearby, and the funicular makes it easy to get up the hill. We went to Sultanahmet daily with no problems.
Shops nearby made it easy to get water and breakfast supplies. Highly recommend this place for family stays.

This apartment was perfect for our 2 week stay in Istanbul and an excellent base to explore the city. We were 3 families with a toddler and a baby - the apartment is well furnished and equipped with everything that we needed for our stay. It was very clean and well prepared for our visit with comfortable beds, travel cots, plenty bed linen and towels and an excellent welcome pack. The only problem we encountered was on the first morning when we had an issue with 2 of the showers: when we contacted Missy, she sent her handyman promptly, within the hour, to fix them.
Contacting Missy from our taxi into the centre of Istanbul from the airport, to ask her to give the exact location of the apartment to the taxi driver was definitely worth it and saved lots of time since it is located on a pedestrianised street. Julia, her sister, was standing outside in the street waiting for us to welcome us which was a really nice touch. Checking in could not have any been easier!
Missy also helped us with ordering a taxi back to the airport on our departure day. Our first visit to Istanbul was a most pleasant experience and we would not hesitate to book this fabulous apartment whenever we return.

Great space and sleeping arrangements for our group of 6 girls and 2 adults, and a convenient location near Istiklal and public transit. Unfortunately, our experience with the host was disappointing. She informed us of a leak in one bedroom before arrival and left buckets, which we understood. However, the leaks worsened significantly—spreading to multiple spots—and one bathroom became unpleasant to use due to water, debris, and sand from the ceiling. We notified the host, but little was done. A handyman and her sister came late and left without helping—no cleanup, no emptying buckets, no effort to manage the situation. When we followed up, we were told nothing could be done and that a downstairs neighbor had complained about noise. We adjusted our plans to spend less time in the apartment. Due to the conditions and lack of support, we would not stay here again.

Stay here! Missy's AirBnb has historical charm, modern amenities, and a phenomenal location right in the heart of Istaklal St.. The home is large, clean, and has tons of bedrooms and bathrooms for your entire family. The kitchen is fully stocked for everything you need to cook. The family and dining room have enough room and seating for the entire family to comfortably gather and enjoy each other's company. The building has an elevator which was very convenient especially since we were traveling with seniors.
The location is close to everything from Taksim Sq, Galata Tower, train station, shops, restaurants, grocery stores, etc. You are literally in the middle of everything.
Communication was prompt and Missy answered any questions we had and was always willing to help.
We are looking forward to coming back next year and staying here again.

description:
Located within 50 metres of Istiklal Street and 450 metres of Galata Tower in Istanbul, Dorne Suite Taksim provides accommodation with seating area.

The air-conditioned units come with a kitchenette that includes a fridge, a private bathroom with a hairdryer, and a living room with a flat-screen TV. A stovetop and kettle are also provided.

Popular points of interest near the aparthotel include Taksim Square, Dolmabahce Clock Tower and Spice Bazaar.

reviews.text: The communication with the host was always good, and there was always someone in the reception. The apartment was very clean and well located, close to Galata but in a quiet street. However, the isolation of the building is really bad, we heard conversations, the building door closing loudly during night and washing machines running at 3 am. The apartment is also not big enough for three people, and already very tight for two. Kitchen is more than basic. For a short stay, it's okay, but I've found better places for better prices in Istanbul.

Thank you very much, rooms are cozy and clean, staf is very kind, helpful and understanding. Location is so comfortable, 5 minutes to metro, T1 tram, bus stations. They have everything for cooking in the room.Place is safety and calm. After exhausting day we felt like home. Thank you Dorne Suit Taksim. Sinan the best!! :) all the love, Zhanna, Diana, Adina from Kazakhstan <3

Very clean bathroom, very helpful and hospitable staff. The location is perfect as it's close to all the attractions and the main street. The only downside I would say is a little noise from the outside however, if you sleep late like us around midnight it shouldn't be a problem. Would recommend.

Stayed there for 6 nights. Location next to Istiklal Street. 5 mins walk to Sishane Metro & Funiculer down to Karakoy or 10 mins walk to Tophane T2 Tram station. Very lively & easy access. Apartment good & comfy with elevator for 2 pax. Host helpful & flexible. Thank you Dorne Suite Taksim.
Nice location. The flat is clean and newly decorated. The bed is very comfortable to sleep in. Recommended.

description: Available for mid-term rental. Cozy, beautifully decorated flat in the heart of Istanbul's best district. Fully furnished with a fully equipped kitchen, smart tv, lots of light. Half a story up, access to a large terrace with a superb view of all of Istanbul's most iconic monuments. Apartment is on the fourth floor without elevator.

reviews.text: AMAZING apartment in the heart of Istanbul. I had the pleasure of a 6-week long term stay at Williams apartment and I can't say enough good things about him as a host and the apartment itself. The location is fantastic, walkable to hip neighborhood Cihangir and central to the main area of Taksim. The apartment is really well laid out and not cheap like many rentals in Istanbul. William takes great care in the touches within the building including a full kitchen and other amenities like dishwasher, washing machine, air conditioning, etc. Internet was very fast and reliable allowing me to work from home with no problem. Beds were super comfortable and the street itself is quiet at night (which can be an issue in some other places) Check-in was simple and communication was constant even throughout the stay to see if we needed anything at all. It should be noted that if you have mobility issues the apartment is the top floor with no elevator, but this is quite common in most Istanbul buildings. The benefit is though the rooftop is just outside your door which gives nearly 360-degree views of the entire city (great for having a glass of wine and watching the sunset). Everything we needed was included in the apartment and I would highly encourage others to stay here. I have been visiting Istanbul for nearly 10 years and it was one of the best Airbnb experiences I have had.

Everything was perfect. Besides the very clean and nice and comfortable appartement, the host gives you all the information about the surronding and Istambul itself, you may need. If you have any wishes, or questions you got the answer promptly. Yes, it is on the 4-th floor, but never mind, so the rooftop terrace is very near. :) Bonus: cheap parking lot, right in front of the house. Great! Highly recommended!

This place was amazing and advertised exactly as expected. My friends and I stayed here for a couple of nights and had exactly what we needed to make this an enjoyable stay. Location is convenient, check-in process is smooth, the place was spacious and tidy, and the main features that really stood out to me is the terrace attached to the bedroom and a cute rooftop terrace at the top of the building. Despite William being out of the country, he maintained such swift communication with me and my friends given the time difference. William and MJ are wonderful hosts. I highly recommend their place!!!
Note that there is no elevator in this property so walking up a couple of stairs will be needed to get to the unit

Great apartment !! Great location !! Great host !!! I'm not exaggerating! I was in Istanbul to study. The apartment owner, William, contacted me first. Described in detail how to get there. Helped in everyday life, helped with excursions in my free time! Intelligent apartment !!! Many books in different languages. I didn’t want to leave !! Clean and comfortable. Filipina, Mary Jane, helped clean the apartment. The location of the apartment is excellent! 20 meters from the noisy Istiklal, but it was quiet !!! In general, I am very grateful to the owner for everything !!! I didn’t want to leave. I will be in Istanbul next time - I will stay in the same apartment !!!

This place is just as it is described and seen on the pictures. It is very clean and William an Mary Jane are so nice and helpful! It is worth climbing up the hill for this amazing apartment. Love the style and furniture 😍 Recommend it to everyone visiting Istanbul.

For the low pricing it was alright: Within arrival room smelled like smoking and lots of parfume, bathroom wasn’t exactly clean, and shower is really molding. Bed and towels were fresh and clean. Contact and communication was ok, host was friendly. Reception covered all night.
If you are just looking for a cheap place to sleep, this is a good go-to.

Konum olarak gayet iyi giriş çıkışta sorun yaşamadık çalışanlarda gayet samimiydi uygun fiyata kalmak için iyi bir yer duş geniş ve temizdi sadece yatak rahat değildi ve asansörün sesi biraz fazla geliyordu

I highly recommend staying at this lovely hotel! The location is perfect and it has everything you could possibly need to feel happy and right at home during your stay. The room was a decent size and sparkling clean. Truly an excellent value! Thanks so much to Yasin for being an excellent host.

Average Kadikoy hotel :) if you ever stayed in another one over there, you already know what to expect.
The owners were really nice and hospitable all the time, the location is far enough from the crowded streets, but close enough, if you want to go out. Also the ferry station is just in 5 min walk, as well as the bus terminal (make sure to use public transport in Istanbul, especially in the summer - it's really good!).
The downsides are typical for most places like this - you won't have much tableware if you're used to cook at home. There were just two tiny tea cups and plates for them and a teapot. But the fridge was also there, which is nice. Also there was some smell in the bathroom, plus if your neighbors will decide to smoke at their flat, your one will smell as if they were smoking in your bed.
The AC works fine and it's shady, so in the summer it doesn't get too hot. The bed is a bit worn and could've used a replacement, but is still pretty ok.
To sum up, if you plan a short stay and can stand some inconveniences in exchange for good location and hospitality, it's a good option

The hosts were extremely nice and very helpful , very caring and respond immediately.The hotel room is cozy , nice , very quiet and clean , all the necessary items are needed in the room. the location of the hotel is super close to the metro , bus station , and shopping street as well. I love this place , will book again once i come back to istanbul . Best place ever . Thank you

description: We are Tsn for Property Mngmt company with over 45 apts in our portfolio. Our 1 Br apt is located in Hacımimi street, Galata. Located in first floor, 500 meters away from Galata Tower w/ easy access to all attractions and hip restaurants & cafes in its neighbourhood. The apt is 40 sqm and well designed for our guests needs: 1 bedroom, a bathroom, a kitchen with all appliances and utilities, a large living room, ULTRA FAST wifi. We look forward to hosting you here

reviews.text:
The apartment is in a good location - walking distance to Tophane tram station, Galata tower and İstiklal street. The street itself is quiet but once your step out to the neighbouring areas you will find plenty of restaurants, bakeries and coffee shops.
The unit was very clean with a lot of amenities including excellent WiFi and Netflix. It looked exactly like the photos. You do have to climb one flight of spiral staircases so keep that in mind. We had a comfortable stay here & would gladly stay again.
However check in process could have been smoother as we could not find the exact unit and the host was not there to greet us. Luckily the neighbouring apartments are helpful and everything was sorted out.
Checkout on the other hand was very easy and fuss-free. Overall would still easily recommend this place.

Very good location on a relatively quiet street. Host is very responsive. Cons - dark and more old/out of date than photos appear, shower does not adjust to comfortable water temperature properly, no drinkable water provided on arrival. Bathroom soap container was empty. Would recommend for the price overall. Not suitable for persons with mobility issues - staircase to unit very steep and building is located on a hill.

Definitely recommend! Host(s) we’re very responsive and helpful (kindly carrying my suitcase up the hill and up the stairs - thanks, Can!). Apartment was clean, well maintained, and the toilet and shower work well. Close to everything you need, including a pharmacy. Listing mentions it being in a ‘lively district’ so I was concerned about noise, but the apartment/building was very quiet.
Note that Galata area is essentially a hill, and to reach the apartment requires an uphill walk on that street (dead-end so you can’t come in from the top). Those with mobility issues may find it challenging.
We arrived early so host suggested a hotel with coffee shop where we could store our luggage until checkin. Something to keep in mind - luggage is not stored in a locked area, and to get to the apartment requires a walk downhill on the cafe road, then a crossover to the apartment road, and an uphill walk on that one. (Thanks again, Can!) But a nice place to relax and enjoy a coffee.

We really enjoyed our stay at this Apartment. It was cozy, clean, and honestly felt just like home. The hosts, Sebastian and Sena were both incredibly accommodating, they even let us check-in two hours earlier than scheduled, which was such a thoughtful gesture. We felt genuinely comfortable throughout our stay.
The location was another big plus. Many famous spots in Istanbul, like Galata Port and the famous mosques, were within walking distance. The rooms were clean and comfortable, and we were able to use the kitchen with ease.
We’ll definitely book this place again and would happily recommend it to friends and family. :)

Host team was very accommodating - there in person to welcome me for an early check in, responsive and arrived day of to fix things when I reached out with a question.
Location was great, right between Istiklal/Sishane Station and the Tophane tram stop. In a pedestrian city, you have the metro access needed to get everywhere you need to be (about 15/20 mins via tram to Sultanahmet stop and the Hippodrome). Walking distance to good restaurants and shops, Modern Museum, İstiklal & Beyoğlu has a ton of nightlife options. City is full of hills and this neighborhood is no different, so be good for a climb/stairs before you book the trip.
Actual space was beautiful, just like the photos show. Cozy and warm, enjoyed my November stay.
Had everything I needed, would certainly recommend.

description:
I have 11 apartments where I can host my guests. If this apartment is not available on the dates you want, please check the other apartments in my profile. You can find all the reviews about me on my profile.

My apartment is within walking distance to Istiklal Street. Thus, bus, subway etc. located in Taksim Square. you can easily reach public transportation vehicles. It is also very close to Karaköy and Beşiktaş. You can shop from stores in the street and eat and drink in cafes and restaurants

reviews.text:
Konum mükemmel, ev çok rahat sessiz ve ihtiyaç duyulan tüm eşyalar var, ev sahibi iletişime açık ve yardımseverdi. İlk gün biraz üşüttüğüm için kendisine huysuzluk ettiğim halde bize gayet kibar davrandı ve sorunumuz hızlıca çözüldü. Evin çevresinde her çeşit restoran ve esnaf dükkanı var, taksime, Karaköy’e, cihangirin güzel cafelerine yürüme mesafesinde. İstanbul’a geldiğimde tekrar konaklayacağım her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz
The location of the house is great, the house is very clean. There are many nice cafes, restaurants and shops in the neighborhood where the house is located. Walking distance to the most beautiful places in Istanbul. The house is very spacious, big, quiet and comfortable. The owner is very polite and responds quickly. thank you for everythin :)
My stay at this apartment was definitely worth the money. It’s situated a walking distance near downtown, it was clean and communication with the host was perfect

Harika bir tatil için çok teşekkür ederim. Daire çok yoğun bir bölgede yer almaktadır, yakınlarda bir polis karakolu vardır, alan sessiz değildir, ancak daire, uyumanızı ve kendinizi evinizde hissetmenizi sağlayan kulüplere ve gürültülü kafelere yeterli bir mesafededir.
Dairede yaşamak için gerekli tüm olanaklar vardı, yatak çarşaflarının temizliğini ayrıca belirtmek isterim, tüm oda tazelik kokuyordu. Daire sıcak ve ferah, tavsiye ederim.
Kurallara göre saat 12: 00'de ayrılmama rağmen, uçuşum akşam geç olduğu için saat 15: 00'e kadar kalmama izin verildi, bunun için ayrıca çok teşekkür ederim.
Thank you very much for a great vacation. The apartment is located in a very busy area, there is a police station nearby, the area is not quiet, but the apartment is at a sufficient distance from clubs and noisy cafes, which allows you to sleep and feel like home.
The apartment had all the amenities necessary for living, I would like to separately note the cleanliness of the bed linen, the whole room smelled of freshness. The apartment is warm and spacious, highly recommend.
Despite the fact that the departure according to the rules at 12:00 I was allowed to stay until 15:00, since my flight was late in the evening, for which I also thank you very much

Great stay overall. The apartment was clean, easy to find, and everything was well organized. The host was very kind, responded immediately, and made the whole experience simple and comfortable. The instructions were clear and easy to follow. I would happily stay here again.

Ev sahibi çok iyi , her konuda yardımcı oldu .
Evin temizliği , güvenliği çok önemliydi bizim için çok memnun kaldık .Konum olarak her yere çok yakındık ev sahibiyle iletişimimiz kuvvetliydi tekrar bir konaklamada görüşmek dileğiyle hoşçakalın🌸

description:
My Apartment is centrally located in oldtown, just 5 min. walk to Sultanahmet Square & Hippodrome also historic attractions.

Duru Istanbul Apart: our apart hotel, your home.
If comfort and hygiene is your red line, then Duru Istanbul is your place to stay. Our name Duru, stands for pure and clear in Turkish, and we chose our name for a reason. In these times, where hygiene is more important than ever, Duru Istanbul Apart’s mission is to provide its guests a comfortable and safe place so stay.

reviews.text:
absolutely phenomenal.
we stayed about 9 nights. excellent value for money and our ground floor apartment was beautifully clean and welcoming.
the apartment is perfectly situated in the heart of sultanahmet and easily accessible for basically anywhere you want to go. Just be prepared for lots of hills but that's true for anywhere you stay in sultanahmet.
the apartment had everything we needed. The mattress felt brand new, firm and just perfect for my back. the pillows and sheets also felt and looked new and very clean.
the kitchen is fully stocked and the bathroom has a powerful shower with good heating (or cold water if you need to rinse off after a roasting hot day out in istanbul).
the AC was also very powerful and a life saver coming home from long walks in the 30°C heat!
I think
the housecleaning service is also excellent by Irina, very professional and cleaned the room top to bottom whenever we requested.
Thank you Ercan for an amazing stay!he AC and the powerful shower were m favourite features.

The place is conveniently located in the old town, and it was very easy to get on a trolley to get on another side of the city.
The host was very responsive and proactively suggested local amenities.
The place was very clean and had everything for a comfortable stay (coffee maker, some dishes and utensils). The bathroom and the kitchen were quite small, but if just enough to make breakfast and take a shower.
I'm quite sensitive sleeper, and when since the apartment is on the first floor, you may hear noise from the street, but the airplugs solved this problem for me.
Quite important for me was that the room had a king bed with comfortable matress
I would definitely recommend this place is your priority is basic amenities, safety,
clienliness, and location.

Good, but not perfect.
PROS.
- great communication.
- all requests fulfilled quickly.
- comfortable bed
- good shower
- quick Wi-Fi
- great renovation.
- central location
- easy and fast check in.
Cons
- hair on the pillow (definitely not mine, very long)
- when I arrived, there were only thin blankets, the first night was cold. However they gave me a normal blanket for the second night.
- the place is near the mosque, I was woken up at 5 o’clock.
- generally noisy. You can hear the street very well despite good windows.
Overall, good value for money, but not perfect.

The place was great, and accurately described. However, one small issue we faced was that the kitchen floor got wet everytime we use the kitchen sink. That made things messy.
Apart from that, the location was great. The host was kind enough to arrange for us a late check-in at 4am, and personally sent his employee to ensure we smoothly check in. Ercan and Younus were super responsive and made sure they were there.
There were few power outages though, and we were told that the whole area experiences power outages from time to time. We'd recommend this place.

Really clean and functional apartment in the heart of old Istanbul, with a little kitchenette for self-catering and a supermarket round the corner. The airport transfer was well worth the money for the hassle-saving and peace of mind. Because it’s in the bustling heart of the city, ear plugs were helpful for light sleepers. A really comfortable, easy place to stay.

description:
This is a cozy private room with the bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 5-6 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City.
Also, we have a 24/7 front desk agent to assist you with anything you might need.
Our hotel is only 100 meters away from Istanbul airport shuttle bus stop CATLADIKAPI (HAVIST SHUTTLE BUS STOP)
