reviews.text: I had the room with sea view and two single beds (I thought it would be a double bed as in the photos & the balcony’s view was a little more restricted than in the photos). I could see the sunset from the balcony though which to me was totally worth it and I think you could probably see the sunrise too but didn’t wake up early enough to confirm this. Location is ca 10 min walking to Sofia Mosque. Restaurants nearby. Quieter but still central. The bathroom wasn’t super clean nor the bedroom. Only negative thing was the lack of cleanliness, otherwise was great imo.

location is pretty good. About 5-10 minutes from blue mosque and ayasofia. The property itself is not really as pictured. Those pictures have to be taken on the most beautiful day with the best lighting. the rooms pictured are probably not the one you will get. it could have something to do with me going in the off season. I had a great view of the train tracks. Room is pretty big which is a plus. 2 doors over from the airport transfer office as well which is another plus. a few restaurants are right in front of the hotel. so basically location is good, everything around it seems pretty decent, just don't expect your room to look the way it does in the pictures. pictures those rooms ,maybe 15 years older then they look in the epics

I really appreciate all the efforts made by Alihan and all other hosts to make my stay most comfortable and convenient. People were very friendly and helpful. They helped me and my mom with everything. All our requests were heard and all questions answered in a timely manner. I really liked the place. I felt like I was home. Breakfast is great and the location is the best: beautiful view to the sea and very close to all tourist attractions. I strongly recommending to chose Alihans place if you decide to visit Istanbul.

This hotel is amazing,very nice and clean
Located at very prime location.
Hotel staff were just amazing,they help us to plan our trip in instanbul.

This place is perfectly located, only 10 mins walk from Blue Mosque and majestic Hagia Sophia. It welcomes your day with a fabulous view of deep blue see and bids your day with a grandiose sight of Blue Mosque. Rooms are cozy & clean, hosts are always ready to guide with the best available information.
Highly recommended.

description: 1+1 65 sqm room with kitchen

reviews.text: place is same as in the photos. the whole apartment is squeaky clean which is the most important. location is great walkable to galata or istiklal street around 5 mins walk and some stairs. there was a small issue in the bathroom and got fixed right away when we let them know. the things i didnt like was the AC it gets hot in the night and the AC doesn’t cool enough had to open the windows which was noisy especially during weekends and the mattress was kind of hard and uncomfortable pillows.

Place is in amazing location, just a few meters from metro station and maybe 5 min walk from Galata tower. Just perfect location. Place itself is a hotel but room we got was like on photos, just without oven in apartment. Place was bit worn out but clean and everything working. Price to quality very good and would stay again :)

The location of the apartment is spectacular with a gorgeous view. The suite was spacious and was a reflection of the pictures. The staff were very friendly and very helpful. Just a few points that could have made the stay better. The floors were not cleaned well - very dusty and sandy, making it difficult to walk barefoot. My bathrobe was ripped in 2 places, so I suggest getting new ones. Some of the furniture was clearly old and overused. I also had insects appear in my bathroom every day for 3 days and I told the bellboy who evidently didn't speak English but portrayed that he understood when I asked them to spray the bathroom. I managed to tell the receptionist who was very apologetic and polite and offered to switch my room but I was checking out the next morning so I decided against it and they ended up spraying it for me. Finally, I had written to the owner/hotel on Airbnb asking for late check out (around 6pm) because my flight was late in the evening and they assured me that would be possible, only to find out at reception that check out is at 12pm and no exceptions are made so there was some miscommunication there that was disappointing. But they instead stored my luggage until that time. The overall stay was okay in the end!

I had to cancel my reservation as I felt unsafe traveling alone -- the door lock and jam had recently been broken down. The Air B&B customer service team were very responsive, and the hotel staff didn't make it awkward when I left. Beyond that, the pictures make this space look beautiful and clean, but that is not the case, as the walls, floors, surfaces and linens had all seen better days or were outright dirty (ie, hand prints on the glass, dirt and hair on the floor, stained carpets).

Amazing and comfortable one bedroom suit in a continental hotel with all the amenities and spotless with magnificent view. I feel so comfortable here every time I stay and I always come back to the same hotel. Great restaurants inside the hotel. Helpful staff. Elevator and easy access from the street. No stair on the street or entrance which is a great deal in Istanbul if you know. I recommend this place 100%.

description: Stay in the heart of Maçka, one of Istanbul's most desirable neighborhoods, perfectly located between Nişantaşı and Beşiktaş. Hosted by Homie Suites, this bright one-bedroom apartment is ideal for both short and long stays. Enjoy seamless self check-in, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, and a comfortable space to unwind after exploring the city. Cafés, restaurants, parks, shopping, and public transportation are all within walking distance

reviews.text:
This stunning apartment is in one of the best neighbourhoods in Istanbul has a spacious floor plan and a lot of natural light. Tucked away from all the tourists and you enjoy the local community vibe.
We planned to stay one week, and one month later, we were still there. You feel at home, and the apartment is cosy and comfortable, also perfectly equipped for cooking at home.
The wifi was lightning fast with incredible download and upload speeds, perfect for all those travellers who work remotely.
The apartment is spotless and maintained weekly. You are often surprised with gifts of chocolate, water and even olive oil, lovely little perks.
All your essentials are on the doorstep. You are spoilt with coffee shops, we fell in love with the coffee shop directly across the road, owned by a lovely lady, and the coffees were exceptional. There is also a great supermarket just across the street, where they are so welcoming and friendly, along with a great selection of fresh produce, groceries and spirits and wine. An excellent dry cleaner called Dry Try is a one-minute walk.
You are a ten-minute walk from the beautiful Nisantasi, where you can shop and dine to your heart's content, and a five-minute walk from the trendy neighbourhood Beşiktaş where you are spoilt with casual to fine-dining options. You are also five minutes from Macka Park, which provides you with the comfort of nature you need in a bustling and intense city.
Tunç is the most supportive and attentive host, with excellent English and a pleasure to communicate with. He is always there to make sure your stay is comfortable and you have everything you need; he was also incredibly kind to help us organise a luxury transfer to Bursa when we departed.
Apartments are self-check-in, and we were able to arrive earlier also, which was a bonus. Thank you again, Tunç.
We cannot recommend these apartments highly enough. They are your perfect accommodation that tick all the boxes for a short or long stay in Istanbul in the most desired neighbourhoods.

We really enjoyed staying here. The location is top notch, and everything we needed was just a short walk away. The space itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, which made settling in so easy.
The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay, making check-in seamless and ensuring we had everything we needed. You can tell they truly care about their guests’ experience.
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place in a perfect location!

We had a nice stay overall. The apartment is new, clean, and comfortable, and it worked well for our visit. The location was excellent and very convenient, which was a big plus for us.
The space is quite minimal and could feel a bit more welcoming, at least for those staying for a longer term stay. A few basic kitchen items would have made it better to use, such as salt, cooking oil, dish drying rack, or tea bags. We also noticed that the couch and coffee table were dirty when we arrived, so we used a sheet to cover the couch during our longer stay.
Overall, this is a pleasant place in a great location, new building. That said, it felt a little expensive for what was offered. Some additional effort, such as some niceties or help arranging airport transportation, could help the space better match the price point.

5 stars across the board for this apartment. Location is as good as it gets. Plenty of food, shopping, entertainment and other options within walking distance. The apartment it self was very clean and spacious. Communication with the host was easy - very eager to help and make sure you habe a comfortable stay. I highly recommend this place.

This was a great apartment in a perfect location for my visit to Istanbul. The place was clean, comfortable, spacious, and peaceful. Nice trees out the windows to the courtyard. Excellent A/C. Everything went smoothly, great communication from the hosts. Great cafes and stores nearby and easy access to transportation. Highly recommended!

description: Experience one of Maçka's most unique stays in this stylish two-bedroom duplex penthouse with a private terrace and beautiful sea views. Perfectly located between Nişantaşı and Beşiktaş, this spacious apartment is hosted by Homie Suites and combines modern comfort with an exceptional outdoor space. Whether you're visiting Istanbul with family, friends, or for business, you'll enjoy seamless self check-in, high-speed Wi-Fi, and everything you need for a memorable stay.

reviews.text: I had a fantastic trip to Istanbul and coming back to this apartment every night was the cherry on top. It was very cloudy for most of my stay, but the big windows still made the apartment bright. Tunç is a phenomenal host who goes above and beyond. He helped us make two different private car reservations and even connected on a 3way call to translate between Turkish and English to help me find the driver at the airport. The apartment is beautiful and clean and looks exactly like the photos. Just beware of the staircase - make sure to walk slowly as I actually slipped and fell once. The neighborhood is perfect and everything you need is within 1 block in any direction. Loved the market next door. Don’t hesitate to stay here!

Everything was great. The place was clean, comfortable, and matched the photos. It may not be considered luxury, but the condition is well above expectations. The location is excellent. There was a small issue with the AC, but the host responded very quickly and fixed it right away. The only downside is limited parking, but overall a very good stay.

Great location! Close to restaurants and shopping, yet very quiet and comfortable. Beautiful view to the city and water. Several grocery stores with in few feet from the lobby. New building and apartment. Beds were very comfortable. Sheets clean and crispy. Host was very attentive and caring. Had a great experience.

one of the best stays in istanbul especially if staying more than 3-4 days; can easily accommodate 4-5 ppl without extra beds. more than 5 will need extra bed mattress.
the apartment is amazing, VERY clean, located near literally everything and the views are the best in town.
easy to check in and check out, the host js very nice and accommodating and easily reachable.
extra sets of towels, coffee machine and coffee, TV with Netflix and fast wifi and all amenities and what you need is available whe you check in.
this will be our stay in Istanbul for many times to come

Great central location and very comfortable home. It was as pictured and very clean. Tunc was sweet, responsive and helpful. We loved it there and will definitely be back there the next time we are in Istanbul.

description:
This apartment is very spacious and comfortable.
There is a living room with twin beds&sofa with compact kitchen and a bedroom.Pharmacies and supermarkets, restaurants, cafes.
With a great location. Walking distance, 100 meters from Istiklal street. 3 minutes to Madame Tussadus Istanbul, 20 minutes from Galata Tower, 15 minutes from Galataport shopping center. This is family boutique hotel which is you will feel like home. Please note that additional guests are not allowed.

reviews.text: Kenan is a really nice host. The pictures are a bit outdated and old, for example there were two single beds in the living room (which was actually really convenient for us!). The kitchen could use some more equipment (more cups, forks, knives,…) and in the bathroom the flush for the toilet wasn’t working at some time. Overall it was a pretty good stay in a convenient area.
A bit different from the photos, a bit dusty but great location!

Kenan bey çok iyi bir ev sahibi, yardımsever ve çok nazik, ilgili bir beyefendiydi. Ev çok temiz, düzenliydi. Taksim gezilecek tüm yerlere çok yakın olduğu için rahatlıkla istediğimiz yere gidebildik. Binanın hemen yanında polis karakolu olması da çok iyiydi güvende hissettik. Yeri otogardan çok rahat bulabildik. Herkese tavsiye ederim. Konaklama mükemmeldi.🙂
Great location, lots to do , close to everything. Host very responsive and helpful. Small details about bed sheets they were a bit old .

The accommodation was very comfortable to stay and clearly as accurate as describe. My friend and I were really satisfied with the facilities provided. Kenan, the owner also was very helpful when we requesting to store our luggages first before checkin and after checkout.

description:
Wireless internet. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nişantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text:
the apartment is very clean and tidy same as the pictures and has all the tools that I needed in my 3 nights stay,
it's in a luxury building with a free swimming pool, gym and sauna. and importantly free car parking.
it takes around 15 to 20 minutes to walk to taksim Square and istiklal Street, ( some up hill road)
the host is very responsive and helped me with check in even though there was a reservation problem.
overall I recommend this place and hope to come again later with this good price.

Brand new and gorgeous, exactly like in the pictures. The building had 24 hour security so I felt very safe being there alone. There is also a pool and sauna downstairs. Nearby there are some small shops and you can get great coffee, sandwiches, and wine at the hotel next door. The building is not yet complete but that didn't hinder my stay. Some more amenities in the unit would have been helpful (salt, pepper, wine opener) but this was not a major inconvenience. Instructions for check in. check out, laundry, etc would have been useful but I was able to get help very quickly. Since this is a new unit I imagine it will only be better moving forward. The host accepted my last minute booking and also accommodated an early arrival. Very happy with my stay overall.

Great Airbnb. Beautiful. Spacious. Very responsive host. I love the big windows. Bed is comfortable. Wifi is fast.
I’ve had a few issues with power outages during my stay which was a problem because the Internet was off and I needed it to work. I think this was due to construction so hopefully this is not going to be an ongoing issue.
The place is a 15 minutes uphill walk to Taksim station where you can get the metro. It was fine for me but perhaps a bit much for other people. Taxis/Uber in Istanbul are very unreliable so if you don’t want to walk the distance might be an issue.

Located just a stone's throw away from Taksim Square, this apartment offers top-notch amenities including a washer, comfortable sofa, and a luxurious showerhead for a truly rejuvenating experience. While some reviews might mention its proximity to a busy thoroughfare, rest assured that the apartment is well-insulated, ensuring a peaceful night's sleep undisturbed by outside noise. Moreover, the sleeping area is cleverly enclosed by thick retractable doors that offer a noise-free sanctuary. The host is attentive and communicative, providing support via text messages. In conclusion, my stay here was superb, and I wholeheartedly recommend this accommodation to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Photos definitely make the place look amazing, in person there is a difference. The bathroom would probably be the biggest Con as well as the noise. Bathroom shower door doesn’t shut nor does the water drain down fast enough so the water spills out into the bathroom floor, clumsy bathroom finish during construction so you’ll see the minor finishes that throw the urban studio apartment off. Secondly the noise from the street is heard with all windows shut. Honking 24/7 so if you can adjust to the noise it’s a good rental for 1-2 people. Didn’t check out the amenities in the building so can’t speak on those. Also WiFi in the apartment is horrible! 2mb down. Took 20 min to download translate app on iPhone. For the price it’s a good spot 3.5-4/ 5 stars.

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located, quiet place.
My house, which is within walking distance to the market, pharmacy, bus and taxi stops, Private and State Hospitals, Cafes and dining areas, Metro and Metrobus, has a large kitchen and living room where you can cook and spend time. Enjoy a safe and peaceful stay in this private room where the towels, pillows, duvets and sheets you will use are provided to you hygienically.

reviews.text: Konaklamamdan çok memnun kaldım. Evin konumu gerçekten harika, ulaşım çok rahattı. Aracımla geldiğim için otopark sorunu yaşamamak benim için büyük bir artıydı. Oda ve banyo oldukça temiz ve düzenliydi. Ayrıca ev sahibi çok yardımsever ve ilgiliydi, her konuda destek oldu. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederim!

Orhan turned out to be a hospitable and responsive host. He made sure I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay in Istanbul and even accommodated me earlier than the allowed check-in time. He was rarely home, so the entire apartment was at my disposal. About the apartment: it's clean and cozy, just like in the photos. Unfortunately, there is a large construction site across the street, so there's noise and dust from morning to evening. Because of this, the apartment quickly gets dusty, and keeping the windows open is uncomfortable. I hope the construction will be finished soon, and the area will become even more attractive.

My stay at Orhan's place booked through Airbnb was nothing short of fantastic. The host's attention to detail and hospitality truly made the experience memorable. The apartment itself was not only stylish and well-appointed but also exceptionally clean, providing a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. Orhan went above and beyond to ensure I had everything I needed, offering local tips and recommendations that added an authentic touch to my visit. The location was ideal, making it easy to explore the surrounding area. From seamless check-in to the thoughtful amenities, Orhan's place reflects a host who genuinely cares about their guests' experience. I highly recommend this Airbnb for a delightful stay with a personalized touch.

Beautiful cosy room in a well organized apartment located near Kadikoy area.
Clean and spotless, beautiful kitchen. Supportive and responsive host.
I recommend this place

Very clean place, had a lock on the bedroom door which was a nice touch. Orhan was very helpful, kind and friendly. There was a few flights of stairs to his apartment so consider this if you need to but it was fine for me. I would definitely stay again

description:
Thousands of years History in your apartment with amazing view of Bosphorus , Hagia Sophia, and Maiden Tower. Perfect way to understand what istanbul whisper in your ears. Take your coffee or wine, lean back, get relax and listen to İstanbul what says. Two big continence together with you during your stay in Bosphorus.

We provide to all guests;

- High Speed Internet
- Smart TV with NETFLIX/YOUTUBE
- Washing machine with dryer
- Towels and bed linens
- Our best hospitality

reviews.text:
Nice and clean place
Nice host
View and Location are good
the housekeeping lady is very helpful lady.
There is a free car parking in front of the building.
..
difficult to reach( by walking) for old people coz it in hi hills,
No elevator.
Central AC in 3 bedroom is poor and
we feel hot in these rooms, but other 2 bedrooms AC is good !
Upper dining room AC is not work totally.
bed rooms are small rooms, it is difficult to move with your bags.
No cabinets for clothes, but there is shelves.
no washing machine, but the host offer free laundry in same day, which is nice.
Microwave , and warming grill need to be placed in table, not under the sink . ( it is difficult to use them)

The balcony view is very nice and refreshing. The house is very clean and has plenty of rooms. The bathrooms are very clean and maintained. All rooms has ACs. The host is very kind and responsive. He was supportive in all of our requests. I forgot some stuff in the house and he kept it safe until my return.
However, the place is very costly and there are view things you need to consider though before renting the place. It is not kids friendly as the stairs is not that easy for kids. kitchen is not equipped enough and missing some mandatory needs. Rooms are kind of small and they are smaller that they look in the pictures.

The home was as described… beautiful view on patio.. the home was cleaned. He even arranged for transportation to the home for a fee which was very helpful. The location is close to so much! Restaurants, bars, shopping. The only negative was we had to wait for transportation from the airport. It would be nice to upgrade the couch upstairs but other than that. I would rent here again.

The apartment bears no comparison with the listing details or photos. General decoration, furnishings, equipment and cleanliness very sub-standard - the most disappointing AirBnB stay we have ever had. Apart from 'the view' - no mention of noise from cruise ships -, building materials left in lobby, shower heads broken & drains blocked, stained walls, pictures fallen & left lying around floors. Serious health & safety issues: windows on 1st/2nd floor stairways opened at dangerous height for children; both external balcony struts broken through, bare wires in walls, floors damaged & trip hazards. Main door often open, building materials left inside. Kitchen china/cutlery totally insufficient for 10 guests - unmatched china, no drinking or wine glasses. TV & microwave inoperable, freezer requires defrosting, sink stained, cigarette stubs all over balcony. WIFI cover requires carrying router around. Bedlinen torn. Small bedroom, can't walk round bed. Ironing board covers unusable.

We had a wonderful stay! The villa was beautiful, clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The location was peaceful, and everything was exactly as described. The host was very kind, welcoming, and responsive throughout our stay. We truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend this villa to anyone looking for a relaxing and comfortable place. Thank you for the great hospitality🤩🤩🤩❤️

description:
IDENTITY VERIFICATION IS MANDATORY FOR EVERYONE.

NOT SUITABLE FOR GUESTS UNDER 18 YEARS OF AGE.

Our place is located in Kadıköy and each room has steel doors with security.
24-hour reception and free Wi-Fi are available.

Our place is within walking distance of shopping malls, bars, cafes and restaurants and close to transportation options.

Being close to metro, metrobus, Marmaray, ferry, bus and minibus stops provides easy access to all tourist attractions of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Apartment is identical as in pictures, nice and clean, freshly renovated. There is abundance of hot water, good air conditioning, tv, elevator, 24h reception etc.
Amazing position just 5-10min away from ferry, bus, tram, metro and well connected to every part of the town.
Hosts are very nice and willing to help you with anything you need

The location is great, Yigit is very friendly and helpful, he made our stay easy and enjoyable. It is more of a hotel room experience. Very clean. I just wish it had some basic kitchen tools (like utensils, more mugs or cleaning tools to wash them and reuse them), and a microwave maybe 🙃 But aside from that the experience was good!

Amazing central location, clean, exactly as the photos room, helpful and warm hosts. It would be better if there was a table in the room by default but they helped solve the issue when they could. A great experience, certainly recommended.

This Airbnb was located 10 minutes walk from the Kadiköy ferry/bus terminal, and 12 minutes walk from the Söğütlüçeşme Marmaray train station. There are plenty of dining and shopping options available within walking distance. The neighbourhood is lively and safe without feeling touristy.
The Airbnb itself was as described. The bed was comfortable. Air conditioning and heater functions fine. There is a fridge as well for convenience. Towels, hand soap, shampoo and basic slippers are provided. My only caution is the bathroom (toilet and shower). There was no exhaust fan, and it was small for us (we are average sized). For a large person it would be difficult to use. Thank you for having us.

I had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was kind, attentive, and made everything easy. I would be happy to come back and definitely recommend staying here.

description:
In Beykoz, 10 minutes from the Fatih Sultan Mehmet bridge, we offer a stay experience away from the city life but inside the city. We designed our home, which combines modernity, comfort and natural beauties; to make your holiday unforgettable.

There is a requirement to provide a Turkish ID/passport number at our registered tourism facility.

reviews.text:
Mr. Tolga was the best host we could ever ask for. It was a clean and cozy place. The ammonites were all exactly as described. Located near a beautiful forest, it's a great choice for hikers and nature lovers. The breakfast that Mr. Tolga brought to us was the best breakfast we had in Turkey so far. High quality and so delicious.
In addition, the location is perfect for remote workers, it has a high-speed internet connection, and it is quiet.
Our time there was absolutely wonderful, and we would highly recommend it.

It’s a nice place to stay for a short while and to get away from the noise of the city. They have a beautiful upper yard and Tolga is a great host. There’s a lovely garden and a barbecue area, as well as nice views and fresh air.
At first, the house wasn’t clean when I arrived, but they quickly resolved this issue. The bedroom was very hot, and on weekends the neighbors’ loud music kept me from sleeping. It’s not really suited for long-term rentals, since the kitchen equipment was very limited. We even bought a kettle ourselves, because the one provided was very dirty and covered with limescale. Everything else was fine.
Living here without a car is difficult, as the nearest shop is about 1.5 km away, and you have to walk uphill. Taxis rarely come here, so getting around to other areas is also hard. Thanks to Tolga though—he is a good person and helped me bring groceries from the store!

merhabalar öncelikle teşekkürlerimi emine hanım ve eşine iletmek istiyorum. bizi çok güzel ağırladılar. konum tam olarak tarif edildiği gibiydi. ev fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibi tertemiz idi. Bu arada merdivenler iki kişinin rahatlıkla çıkabileceği genişlikteydi. emine hanımın müthiş kahvaltısı da sabahlarimizi mutlu etti mükemmel bir mıhlama olmuştu. akşam mangal yakmak istediğimizde emine hanımın eşi bize hazırlayıp getirdi.kendi bahçe mahsullerinden ikram ettiler hiçbir şey eksik değildi aksine çok güzel ağırladılar bizi çok teşekkür ederiz. bu arada doğası için İstanbul da olup ama bir o kadar kafa dinlemelik mükemmel bir olaydı. Garaj sıkıntısı yaşamadık. İstanbul kalabalığından kaçıp kafa dinlemek için mükemmel bir yer. gözünüz kapalı tercih edebilirsiniz

We loved it! This was the greatest bnb experience ever! Every little detail of this place will make you feel special during your stay. The lovely hosts did their best job as hosts. They did more than just fulfilling their obligations as hosts, they were kind and they made us feel at home. I'd like to thank them for their hospitality.
The area is green and peaceful, you're surrounded with nature and there's a beautiful view from every window. The design of the house and the usable fireplace matches the vibe of this charming area, creating a beautiful experience.
The entire place was clean and everything described in its features were provided complete.
The hosts are extremely helpful, ready to help you with anything you need 24/7. The breakfasts we had every morning were delicious, with most of the products being natural and organic.
They really do their best to provide you a wonderful experience. We would like to visit again sometime.
Temiz, huzurlu idi. Emine Hanım çok ilgili ve misafirperver idi. Her ihtiyacımız mevcuttu. Temiz, düzenli ve sakin. Yatak rahat, internet hızlı. Bahçe mükemmel. Özel otoparkı olması da çok iyiydi.

description: Apart a self-catering accommodation located in the Historic Peninsula. Sultanahmet area, which houses many historic landmarks such as Topkapi Palace, Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque, is within a walking distance,great choice for travelers interested

reviews.text: Tevfik is a great host! He coordinated airport pickup and waited for us when arriving. The apartment was exactly as it was described to us before hand: clean, spacious, and comfortable. The apartment location is superb with many good location restaurants around. Yet it is located in a quiet but old area of town. Great walking distance to Grand Bazaar and a handful Hamams. Wifi worked well as expected. We will stay here again.

The apartment was clean and comfortable. Three separate AC units made it good for all. Lots of hot water was available.
The neighborhood looked a bit rough upon arrival, but we soon adjusted. Streets are narrow, cobbled, and very steep. Restaurants, shops, and tourist areas are about 1.5 blocks away straight uphill. Tram is about 10 minutes away. All major sites are within walking distance. There was lots of space to spread out, but the second bedroom was a bit tight. There were two sleeper sofas in the family room but no extra linens for them. If we had asked they likely would have been provided.
Check in was a bit difficult, we were met with a locked building. Finally a resident came and let us in, but we still found no one to give us a key. After a few minutes someone came, and then all was well. Communications were terse but adequate. They could have been more helpful.
Someone did enter the apartment and straighten it while we were out. We did not expect it.
A good stay.

We had a great stay at Tevfik’s place!
The flat location was incredible, walking distance to all the major places we wanted to visit.
Also there are lots of amazing restaurants 2min away from the flat which was super convenient.
In terms of the interior, the flat was very clean and as in the pictures. The sofas in the living room turn into bed which is also super practical. There were towels and linen provided for each person.
WiFi was working well, the cleaning lady asked us everyday if we needed anything and if we wanted the flat cleaned during our stay. Also the flat was very quiet which is a huge plus when staying in such a central location!
I would strongly recommend staying here if you are looking for a spacious flat in the heart of the old city.
Many thanks Tevfik!

Hosts are very helpful. Place was nice and clean. Nothing fancy but as advertised. Had hot water and central heat which was set to a comfortable temperature. It's a bit of an up hill walk to the major attractions like blue mosque, hagia Sofia etc. Since we had a child in stroller. Otherwise location is walkable to all the major attractions. WiFi was working in the apartment . All in all we had a good experience.

This apartment was in an awesome location. We were met at the door by host and Alex. Both incredibly nice gentlemen. The apartment was spacious and comfortable for Turkey standards. The kitchen was very basic but we were able to cook a meal for four without any problems. Bathroom ok.
The location was perfect. Set in the local area with locals all around you. Great little shops very handy and cheap to get the basics. A short stroll up the hill you meet up with the main hotels and restaurants. A good walk uphill to the attractions all close by. You can visit these all in a day or two but you'll probably get sick of the haggling all the time. Just walk on by! I recommend this place if you are on a budget and there are four of you.

description: The best place you can stay in the very heart of the historical peninsula . located on the calmest street of the neighbourhood only 50 steps away from the TOPKAPI PALACE , HAGİA SOPHİA and SULTANAHMET MOSQUE

reviews.text:
What a fantastic apartment this was! First and foremost, Volkan welcomed us upon our arrival after quite a long journey. He is an exceptional host who made sure we were very comfortable and taken care of. He contacted us daily to check on us, and always followed through on any request we had in addition to giving us great suggestions on dining and entertainment possiblities.

Secondly, the apartment--the only way you could stay closer to Blue Mosque or Aya Sofya is to have slept outside the steps to them! This apartment is ideal for visiting the Old Town Istanbul sites. We couldn't have asked for better....but, there was more! Downstairs from this apartment was a delicious and authentic Turkish restaurant. It was perfect after a long day exporing, and has the perfect view of an Old Town neighborhood street. The apartment itself was perfect--clean rooms, comfortable (and clean) beds, and everything a small group could possbily need (yes, even a hair dryer).

Do yourself a favor and stay here if you desire a fantastic place to stay in an even better location. Oh, and here's a pro-tip. Take a 2 minute walk to nearby Palatium cafe for a drink/hangout. We loved this place.

Tesukker Ederim, Volkan!!!

Volkan's place is in an ideal location as it is very close to the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and so much more. It was easy to take the tram to Dolmabahce Palace as the tram line is also very close. There are great places to eat nearby some with rooftop terraces for excellent views. Volkan responded to all questions promptly. He arranged airport transfer for a reasonable fee and shared his recommendations for places to eat. His place is clean and comfortable. We spent 6 nights and the beds were comfortable after days of site seeing. The shower had hot water and the room is separate from the little toilet room with sink. There is a little fridge which was great for putting leftovers in and then using the cookware and hotplate to reheat them. There is a washer and a drying rack too. It was chilly during our visit, but Volkan had little heaters as well as wall AC/heater units for staying toasty warm. In my opinion, the apartment was good value for the money spent to stay there.

Very well located apartment in Sultanahmet, just a 5-15 minute walk to many places of interest: The Hagia Sophia, The Blue Mosque, the Topkapi Palace, various museums, etc. This is a nice, friendly, low-key, quiet neighborhood. There are plenty of restaurants, shops, and cafes within a short walk. The place itself was just fine for our family- 3 bedrooms, so each of our kids got their own room; a functional kitchen, a small eating area, and airconditioning. It's a smaller space, but cozy, and just what we needed. Aside from the location, the best feature of the property is the host, Volkan. He was so warm and welcoming, very quick to respond to any query, and went out of his way to be welcoming and helpful. He made sure that our cab from the airport knew how to find the place by making himself available to the driver by phone, arranged a cab on our last day, had great recommendations for places to eat, and even brought us pastries from his favorite place on our last night. What a genuinely kind and welcoming human being! Highly recommended!

I had a great experience staying at Volkan's apartment. This was my first experience staying in an AirBnB and he made the whole process very easy. He was quick to respond to messages and easy to communicate with. I did not have the opportunity to meet Volkan because he was out of town, but had the people who own the restaurant that the apartment sits above assist me with check in. The lock was a little tricky at first, but they were helpful with helping me get in if I needed. They were very nice and be food was good as well.
The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and well kept. It's in a great location to all of the historical sights. I was alone for a bit of my stay there, and as a woman it can be a bit scary traveling by myself. I felt very safe at the apartment and didn't have any problems. The wifi worked great, which isn't always the case when staying in a foreign country. All around, I had an excellent time. I work recommend this apartment to anyone traveling to Istanbul.

This apartment worked uniquely well for us because we were three not-so-young childhood friends, currently living in different places, meeting for a short vacation, and really appreciated three separate bedrooms, even if the smallest was a closet size. Separate shower and toilet are also helpful.
The apartment’s wonderful location is well described in other reviews. Restaurants surrounding it on all sides had good vegetarian options.
If anything to wish for, a small microwave for heating leftovers would be nice; and some bigger mugs - dainty Turkish cups are too small by American standards :)

description: This is the house at the centre of Cihangir which is considered the home for artist, international people. You can easily find any kind of food, bakery, art galleries, transportations within 10 min walk. Taksim(İstiklal) is 5 min away too. And the town is quite safe so you can walk 24/7. We are 2 min away from you in case of any need. The building has a lift, and it is quite brand new so the furniture are brand new too. We do run airbnb in the building so you will have fun to stay here

reviews.text:
Positive: The apartment and neighborhood are nice, with a supermarket, bakery, and small shops just 3-4 minutes away. Istiklal Rd and Taksim Square are 10-15 minutes away, and the train is 10 minutes away. However, note that the area is VERY hilly, so taxis are recommended for older travelers, as there's no direct public transport back to the apartment. The host was helpful and respectful. The water and coffee was waiting for us in the apartment.
Negative: Avoid booking a taxi through the host. He promised a VIP Mercedes or VW to pick us up at the airport, but we regretted it. The car was dirty, no phone chargers, smelled of cigarettes, and the driver smoked during the ride. No water was provided. I had requested photos of the car beforehand, which I never received. Book your taxi through Tripadvisor instead!! The only downside to the apartment was mold in the bathroom and the smell from it, which I hope they address soon.
Overall, I believe the apartment is worth the price we paid.

Deniz is a fantastic host, extremely responsive and accommodating. The apartment was super clean, and looks just like the pictures. Fantastic location, surrounded by so many coffee shops everything you need. Located just minutes from Taksim square. There was a slight issue with the hot water one morning, but Deniz got it fixed within 15 mins and left a gift for us outside the door which was very thoughtful. Highly recommended would definitely stay again! :)

I recently stayed at this Airbnb for 9 days and had a good experience. Here are the highlights:
Pros:
The owner is incredibly responsive, replying within seconds.
The hosts are genuinely nice people and very accommodating.
Cons:
The main entrance has 5 steps before you reach the lift, which might not be comfortable for elderly people.
The flat is located in a very hilly area, making it less convenient for those with mobility issues. However, this is common in Istanbul.
Inside the flat, while it is a good-sized two-bedroom, it feels quite dark. More lighting and fixing the missing bulb would be improvements.
All the walls have a rough plaster finish instead of paint or wallpaper. The pink color seen in the photos is the rough plaster finish, which gives the flat an unfinished look.
There is minimal cutlery for five people, so adding more cutlery and a toaster would be beneficial.
There are only four chairs at the dining table, which is inconvenient for a group of five. Happy stay x

We stayed in unit number 4 of a building dedicated to Airbnb stays. The location is superb, with lots of shops, restaurants, etc. Upon our arrival, we were greeted by the host who arranged for our luggage to be carried upstairs to our apartment. The apartment and building appeared to have been recently remodeled. The host was responsive to our requests and we were happy with their attentiveness. They immediately addressed most of our initial concerns such as a thorough cleanup of the unit and clean sheets, kitchen utensils, dishwashing soap and sponge, etc.
A few observations, especially if you’re traveling with a child: the walls had recently been painted with a material that wasn’t like regular paint, and the surface was designed to have protrusions, sharp enough to break the skin if you bump into the wall or brush against it. My toddler scraped his forehead when brushing against the paint and my wife scratched her arm.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would stay again but in one of the other units with normal paint on the walls.

Serhat was very responsive and checked us in within one hour after booking. The place is exactly as it is in the photos. Some missing kitchenware was quickly provided. The 2 bedrooms are distanced one from another which is great for families.

description: A beautifully decorated, comfortable space, where you can call home right in the centre of Istanbul. The flat is located a short walk from Taksim Square. Enjoy this stylish and artistically decorated home & it's convenient location.

reviews.text: Dündar and his girlfriend are very friendly. They did everything to make us at home. If you need anything, just ask them. They will be happy to help you. They had great advises about Istanbul, and the place is amazing (beautiful design). I forgot to tell him that my friend and I are not a couple and he managed to arrange a great room with king size beds with tv, stereo and sofa (We could not dream better). You will have access to the living room and the kitchen where we can share nice moment with your host or other guests. The apartment is on the top of hill but it's 15 min walk to Taksim and there is plenty of bus nearby (number 70ky) to Taksim that cost 1TL and plenty of taxi (6TL or 10TL if the driver is dishonest) that will take you to Taksim in 2 minutes. So location is not an issue. There is plenty of shop in the street (food, night shop, Carrefour). I do recommend Dündar's place. Enjoy your holidays !

Dündar is an excellent host! Great communication and very friendly. Did everything to make us feel welcome and enjoy our stay in Istanbul. Even gave us his public transport card and plotted the sightseeing route on our map.
The place itself is in a great location, next to Taksim square and subway stations, it's also very close to the coach bus stop to Ataturk airport.
Rooms are furnished and decorated in a dadaesque style, and the people staying in other rooms come from all over the world, it almost feels like a flashpacker hostel at times. Loved the atmosphere. Clean and well equipped, You'll find everything You'd need for a prolonged stay.
Staying at Dündar's might not be for You, if You don't smoke though, as the host and other guests frequently smoke indoors, both in the common livingroom and the kitchen.

Dündar was an extremely nice host! He was very caring and tried to help us with everything he could. The apartment is nicely decorated, the kitchen well equipped and the location is really close to supermarkets and the authentic local life. We would definitely stay there again. The only thing that is good to know, is that there is only one shower, so if there are a lot of guests u might have to wait for your time in the bathroom a bit. The beds were extremely comfortable! The communication was extremely nice and quick. Thanks for everything, Dündar! Hope to meet u and your girlfriend again!

We enjoyed our stay at Deniz's place! Apartment was very spacious and stylishly designed. Wonderful apartment very clean rooms excellent host. Supermarket was also literally around the corner, so very convenient for us to access. All of the bedrooms has ACs and the two big bedroom gave a very deep good night sleep as they are facing on the parallel street. Highly recommended.

Dundar was a great host, he was always available for questions and for recomendations. The flat has a good location and the rooms are big enough. The bathroom is always clean. We had a great time in Istanbul, I definitely recommend this place.

description:
Room for 6 People (at most 6 people can stay)
6 bunk beds (190cmx90cm)

Curtain separation in dorm beds
Breakfast including

Street view

Shared Bathroom
24 hours hot water
Flexible check-out
Central heating system
Air-condition
Deposit box
Clean and fresh sheets
Free Wi-Fi connection!
Wake up service
No Smoking
Blanket

reviews.text: I only stayed one night but i would definitely recommend it for a longer stay :) the dorm rooms are clean and the beds are comfortable. There is no separate shower space in the bathroom, but it's surprisingly easy to shower, it functions very well. The staff is super nice and friendly and always available :) the roof top terrace is a unbeatable highlight, the view in on the Bosporus is a highlight and the breakfast you get up there is very good :) you start perfectly into the day at Antique Hostel

The hostel is clean and in a charming building located within 5-minutes of the Blue Mosque. Check-in and check-out were hassle-free. I stayed only one night - and during that time I enjoyed friendly conversation and had a comfortable sleep.

Pros - Affordable, close to tourist attractions, friendly receptionists, good view from the terrace, amazing breakfast, good wifi, clean washrooms and showers, personal reading lamps and charging outlet for all beds, private lockers.
Cons - a bit crowded in a room of 4 beds, less number of showers and washrooms on the ground level.
Final word - great place to stay if you are willing to adjust a little. I would return to this hostel in the future and would recommend anyone looking for an affordable stay!

The hostel was really great! Location is excellent! The rooms and bathroom very clean! The room had a great cooling system! The staff is super friendly and they have 2 computers at the terrace with good internet connection! And wifi in rooms! Simply great, wouldnt stay anywhere else!

Great location and adequate breakfast but definitely one of the cheapest hostels in the area for a reason. They were really nice to give me a bed (upper bunks were already available) when I arrived 5 hours before check-in time. It was wonderful to be able to sleep!

description:
Fully Furnished, Luxurious 1+1 Apartment

A PLACE SUITABLE FOR LONG-TERM STAYS

We offer you amenities that reflect the warmth of a home

If you choose this place, we will give you a 1-hour Bosphorus tour as a gift

No matter how much I tell you here, you are already aware of the beauties of Ortaköy. My apartment is a spacious and clean apartment with all the facilities, kitchenware, wifi, smart TV, air conditioning, etc. You can use it with peace of mind during business visits or holiday visits

reviews.text: Amazing location super close to busy walkable streets with an abundance of restaurants, cafes, and local businesses. The unit is in a quiet area where sleeping was never a problem. Also good layout and great internet and TV for days where on need to spend a bit more time at home. Isa has been on top of communication from start to finish. I highly recommend this place. If you stay here, make sure to check out local breakfast spots and make time to go eat at Memet’s and try their chicken skewers. One of many gems to be found in the neighborhood.

Hello,
It was great say.
House is clean and comfortable.
Isa is helpful and friendly
We enjoyed our stay

The host was nice, nicer than I can explain.
The place is exactly like the pictures and the location is amazing.
It was good experience.
Isa was very responsive and friendly. Place was as how it’s in pictures and the location is amazing with lots of things to do around.
İsa Bey gerçekten çok ilgili bir ev sahibi sorunlarımızı anında çözdü. Ev konum itibariyle harika. Konakladığımız süre boyunca çok rahat ettik.

description: Relax with the whole family at this earthquake safe building.

reviews.text: We stayed at the apartment for two weeks and were happy with it. The apartment: as on the photos, very clean, pretty small, the kitchen area can be separated from the main area by the sliding doors, the matrasses are good, heated floor (can be turned on/off and t can be tuned), the matrasses are good. Location: quiet, 10 min to Marmara (~20 min to Kadikoy), 15 min to the sea (very nice long embankment), lots of cafes/restaurants, a supermarket. Host: Cihan was very helpful and always on touch.

The apartment (and the building) was clean, spacious, quiet, and well looked after, with everything you need. The hosts were kind and lovely, and always willing to help at anytime.
We're glad we booked the apartment, and will for sure book it again. Comfortable stay, highly recommend.

Cihan hanım her konuda çok yardımcı oldu. Sorum olduğunda güzel cevaplar alabildim. Hep ulaşılabilirdi. Ayrıca çok samimiydi. Ev de fotoğraflardıki gibiydi, girdiğimde temizdi. Konumu caddebostana çok yakın, etrafında da istenilebilecek her şey var. Toplu taşımaya da yakın. Her şeyden çok memnun kaldım.
Ev, Marmaray’a çok yakın konumlanmış, sakin ve huzurlu bir bölgede. Etrafta kafeler mevcut. Ev sahibi Gülçin Hanım son derece güler yüzlü, pozitif ve proaktif. Ev gayet temiz ve ferahtı.
Super apartment, clean and a very responsive host. I highly recommend !

description: My suites are in Sultanahmet, the most beautiful and most historical area of Istanbul. There are 5 or 10 minutes walking distance to historical places. Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Hippodrome, shops, markets, tram stations, boat and bus stops.

reviews.text:
This Airbnb is amazing!
Originally we had a different booking at a different place, but that place turned out to be a disaster.
This place & Cavit saved us!
They accepted our last minute reservation at 9PM, they welcomed us at the place. The guy who welcomed us was very friendly, and the place is just like on the photos! It’s warm, clean, well equipped!
The house has an elevator, the bathroom is full with amenities. They even had some instant coffee & tea for us.
Old town is in walking distance, lot of things to see around the place. Great restaurants too!
Bed is comfortable, bedsheets are clean. Place is really warm even tho that we didn’t turned on the heating, we felt really comfortable.
Internet is fast and stable!
We got fresh towels daily, and you can even store your important belongings in your little safe in your room.
If I’m ever in Türkiye again, I’ll visit this place!

The hotel itself is very good! There’s a functional kitchen downstairs which is always clean and got a dishwasher, there’s also laundry. Two of these are probably the greatest convinces and what got me sold.
We looked for the place in this neighbourhood because of my friend’s recommendation but I’ve found the neighbourhood too noisy (it’s near all the mosques), dirty and chaotic. Good thing is though: it’s close to all the history and everything is walkable, lots of food options. I also found that the neighbourhood is too catered to tourists and the surrounding restaurants are mostly very expensive. You have to kind of “know” where to go.
The only thing is that I want English speaking guests to be mindful of is the communication part. I think it’s good to double and triple confirm whenever you communicate in Turkey in general, I found there were some misunderstandings but we were eventually able to figure them out because the host stayed communicative.

This was my first rental using Airbnb accommodations, honestly, I was afraid of the experience, as you know many rentals could come just as total hype or have hidden issues.
I stayed for 14 days in Blue Marmara suites were just a true hidden gem, the small flat I rented was on the fourth floor, and has 1 single bed and another queen size bed.
The staff was very nice and friendly with us, they made sure that our stay is fairly comfortable, they lend us umbrellas for the rain and baggage scale for free to use and the cleaning lady was just delightful.
The room was as described, a clean and tidy place has heat, air-conditions Turkish tv and the water is strong and crazy hot we loved it after a rainy day.
Did not use the kitchen or the workspace, but they were as described in the basement.
If you want to stay in the Fatih area in Istanbul, this hotel is in a very suitable location for tourist destinations or the Camberlitash tram station which goes to the metro.

Great stay in Istanbul! We stayed for two days and everything was perfect. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was very convenient, close to everything we needed. The host was friendly and responsive, making our stay smooth and stress-free. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

It’s a nice hostel near the most popular tourist attraction and restaurants. Maybe for ppl who have walking difficulties should know that you have to walk very steep streets to get to the tourist attractions.
Overall stay was good. Communication was quick. Only downside was when upon our late night arrival (2:30am) there was no baby bed in our room while it was requested and promised and the AC was off. This made our first night quite challenging with a baby.

description:
Fully decorated, brand new apartment located in one of the rising strategic areas of Istanbul!
Remodeled to be a combination of Bauhaus and bohemian chic style.
Very spacious yet cozy 1 bedroom apartment, all yours to enjoy with your family and friends.

reviews.text:
I had a great stay at Wassim’s very nice apartment, very well priced. I stayed a month and was very happy here.
- The shower is hot and powerful which is nice for an Airbnb!
- all the yellow cabs run on uber which makes things super simple.
- the apartment is well lit and private. I felt extremely comfortable and was able to work well from the table in the living room.
- the restaurant on the corner was great, there are a few mini markets near by fall all your basic needs. The 6 floor shopping mall is 15min walk away.
I would definitely stay again in the future!

Beautiful accommodation as described, spotless, easy access to metro within walking distance. Wassim very responsive. Ayse also helped a lot with recommendations and advice, will definitely recommend for family and friends .

I stayed in this apartment for a little over a month. My first home in Istanbul! Check in was effortless, they helped me out with my heavy luggage. Plus, the hosts helped me out with airport shuttle services as well, so that was
very convenient.
Great location, only a few minutes walk to the metro station. Close to lokantas and other restaurants. Literally a few steps away from grocery stores (BIM and Migros).
The apartment also had complete kitchen equipment. Only thing I’d include would be a dishwasher but that’s a minor detail.
Overall a great experience. It was my first time in Istanbul and I felt right at home in this beautifully decorated apartment. Would highly recommend, especially for long stays!
Thanks to the hosts for being super responsive and helpful with all of my questions! All the best!

I stayed here with my boyfriend for a month. We were very comfortable here. There are construction workers, working, right outside your window though. However it was not too loud, it didn’t really disturb us. Communication was great with the host. They respond very quickly & check in was super seamless. The host met us outside the airbnb, helped bring our bags in and everything. The only thing that happened was the police knocked on our door, demanding our passports and asking us about a previous person who was staying at the airbnb. I guess they wanted to see if she was still there or not. Not sure why. That was a scary situation due to the world’s climate currently. But, other than that I would recommend. You’re about 10-15 min walk to both train stations. About 45 mins on the train to the main city. Grocery stores are right across the street/ 5 min walk away. We would rent this place again😊

We booked a 5-week stay for my father’s medical treatment. On arrival, the Wi-Fi and AC were not working, but they were fixed the next day. There were occasional short water cuts due to maintenance. Due to medical complications, we needed to adjust our stay, but the host was not flexible; Airbnb ultimately resolved the issue. At times, the host’s communication felt unprofessional and accusatory, which reduced our overall satisfaction with the booking.
The location and place were fine.

description: Enjoy a spacious stay in Bakırköy with beautiful views of the Marmara Sea. Hosted by Homie Suites, this modern two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers generous living spaces, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and air conditioning throughout. Located on Revnaklı Street, you'll be close to Bakırköy's waterfront, cafés, restaurants, shopping, and convenient transportation links to the rest of Istanbul

reviews.text:
Very disappointing stay. Cleanliness was terrible — there was a huge spider web, the smell was extremely unpleasant throughout the place. The floors were filthy, and the extra sheets were literally brought in garbage bags, which is unacceptable.
There’s no parking, not even a spot to drop off luggage, as the apartment is located in a very narrow and rough alley. To make things worse, there are about ten stairs just to enter the building, which means you have to carry your luggage.
The apartment lacked basic cleaning supplies — no detergents or tools except for a vacuum cleaner. All rooms had no trash bins except for the kitchen and bathroom, which was very inconvenient.
The only positive thing was the view, but honestly, it’s hard to enjoy it when the place feels this neglected.
To be fair, host was responsive and handled things professionally. Due to poor cleanliness, they cancelled the booking with full refund.
I would not recommend staying here unless major improvements made

Beautiful apartment with an amazing view. The beds were very comfortable and living room was great. The location was also great, at the end of the street where it was quiet but easily accessible to all the action of the area. The host was extremely responsive.
One note is there are approximately 7 steps to get into the apartment so if you have anyone with a wheelchair it won’t work for them, which is unfortunate as there is plenty of room in the apartment for a wheelchair to get around. That being said I would highly recommend it for anyone who is not wheelchair bound.

I absolutely loved staying here. The place is exactly as in the photos. Very comfortable. Well specced. The wifi is top notch. The sea view is incredible. The Marina is a short walk away and has an excellent selection of restaurants. Great public transport links. Highly recommended. Especially this time of the year.
i highly recommended this place, clean same as photos, new furniture, easy transportaion, Tunç our hostess was friendly and helpful, thank you and see you next time

Very beautiful and modern apartment but we hope that we know before we are in the first floor because the view is beautiful from upper level. The host very responsive he answer any questions and any requests in the same time. We had very good time in the apartment it contains all cleaning equipment. And near the shops but hard for cars to reach the building we had to walk distance to reach the cars. Absolutely we will come again and again. Thank you.

description:
Our room is luxurious, modern and carefully designed. Located in our hotel, this room has a large double bed, a 32-inch smart television and a private bathroom. Our room has a small kitchen with a mini fridge and small kitchen supplies.
Our room is on the 2nd floor. There is a 24/7 camera and security system. The building's exterior door is specially coded and protected. Our room is designed to accommodate 2 people.

reviews.text: Ms. Cansu was very helpful and reply very fast to our question. location is perfect. very close to phosphorus Caffes and restaurants walking 3 to 5 minutes. rooms are little small but comfortable for 1 person or couples. bathroom are very clean and shower is very nice comfortable. sure will reconsider for future stay.

Excellent stay in Istanbul! The host was very responsive and easy to communicate with. Place looked exactly like the photos and was clean and comfortable. The location was great and convenient for exploring the city. Highly recommend this place if you're staying in Istanbul!

This is a perfect homemade for visiting Istanbul. If you are planning to visit neighborhoods like Kuzguncuk, Kadıköy, Beşiktaş, and more, this is the perfect spot with an extremely convenient ferry. The neighorhood is fantastic and this Airbnb is exactly as is described. Clean, easy check in process, and all the amenities you would need. The hosts are extremely quick at responding and are more than beyond helpful. The place is slightly on the smaller side but if you are traveling solo or as a couple, it’s perfect! Would highly recommend. And if you do decide here, there is a great restaurant just outside the door😊

Ortaköy’s unique blend of historic charm and modern vibrancy made our honeymoon stay unforgettable. Perched close by the Bosphorus shore, we felt thoughtfully curated for romance and relaxation.
The space balanced modern comforts (fast Wi‑Fi, air conditioning, plush towels). Everything was immaculately clean and exactly as pictured. Our hosts were consummate professionals—always responsive and their genuine hospitality made us feel more like friends than guests.
The building sits in the heart of Ortaköy. By day, the streets hum with street‑food vendors selling iconic kumpir (loaded baked potatoes) and fresh waffle cones. By night, a lively scene unfolds: chic cafés, tapas‑style restaurants, and trendy bars spill onto the cobblestones, creating a festive backdrop that never felt overwhelmed.
For any couple seeking a blend of romance, culture, and the unparalleled beauty of the Bosphorus, this Ortaköy apartment is the perfect choice. Without hesitation, we recommend for all couples.

I had a good time staying here. The place was just as described in the photos. It was easy to access and it is conveniently located by some great coffee shops and restaurants. There is even a supermarket next-door. The host was great and they accommodated me they even went as far as to offer laundry service, which I happily obliged. Highly recommend this place.

description: Our apartment stands out with its proximity to Cihangir's lively and social environment. Enjoy a stylish experience in this centrally located place

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at Aslı’s place and would highly recommend it to other travelers. It is centrally located, super clean, and easy to get to. The fact it has an elevator is a plus. The neighborhood is quiet, but with good access to cafes, restaurants, and grocery stores. Aslı was a very understanding host. Since no one was checking in the day I left, she let me stay until it was time to leave for my evening flight, which I really appreciated and made my day much easier. The room itself was comfortable. The bed and pillows were good quality and the bathroom newly remodeled. There is a nice chair and good light for reading. The room looks out over the park and Bosphorus and since it faces eastwards it gets good morning light. There is also a tea kettle, coffee machine, and small refrigerator in the room, so you can easily make coffee when you wake up in the morning, always a plus in my book. In short, the place has everything for a comfortable stay and was a great value!

This was a really nice stay. If you don’t plan on staying in much, this might be the right fit for you as the place is smaller. The bathroom is really nice and clean. Bed is comfy - might prefer having one blanket for each person. Having water prepared in the fridge was a great plus.
The kitchen is located on another floor (one floor down), so not really suitable for making own food. Also, doors are really not soundproof.
The sound of dogs barking was present all the time but I did not mind that.
Id definitely recommend the palce and id stay there again - having in mind the down sides which are not deal breakers for me.

Clean, reliable wifi if working remotely, friendly host & building attendant, and really nice area with cafes! Great location to be away from the hustle and bustle of the more touristy areas. Not too far from bus stations, but if going a certain direction there are a LOT of stairs (as noted in other reviews).

Excellent room in my favorite neighborhood. Despite being in the heart of the lively Cihangir area, the street itself offers a peaceful retreat. The bed is very comfortable, and the room is equipped with both heating for cooler nights and air-conditioning for warmer days. The hosts were incredibly helpful, assisting me with booking a cab and making my stay seamless. I highly recommend this place and will definitely be back

Comfortable and clean stay! The descriptions are accurate. However, it is near a park and can be loud leading up to the night.
Very walkable location and easy to get to important parts of the city!

description:
New building and modern apartment with charming view on roofs of Cihangir Beyuolu buildings. 3 floor with elevator. Quiet and safe street. Orthopedic mattress are for queen size bed, sofa bed and baby bed. Warm floor is for cold seasons and blinds and air conditioning are for sunshine. There is WiFi and smart TV. We provided all necessary equipment for all guests.
Be careful Cihangir has hilly area.

Extra costs:
Early check in
Late check out
Extra sofa bed for 2 people sleeping separately

reviews.text:
The location is fantastic — everything is very close: Taksim Square, the Kabataş Ferry Terminal, the tram, and the lively part of Cihangir. The street itself is beautiful and quiet; there is some stairs, but it’s very comfortable to walk.
The building is excellent — modern, clean, and secure. The apartment is very comfortable, bright, and spacious. The view from the window is wonderful! The bed is comfortable, the living room is cozy, and the bathroom is spotless. An extra delight was the underfloor heating — it was a real treat in early March. Overall, the apartment has everything you need for a pleasant stay.
On the downside, the internet during our stay was not very stable. It also felt a bit unusual that laundry and dishwasher supplies need to be purchased (as described but anyway). We bought a pack of capsules, used two and left it — hope, it will be useful for the next guests.
Many thanks to Olga for hospitality and a late check out! ❤️

My family had a very pleasant stay at Olga’s place. Its a quiet building, the smart home has a lift, all rooms have air conditioning, as most places around this area don’t offer this. kitchen is fully equipped which is perfect for long stays, the bed and pillows are so comfortable. The shower is amazing. The apartment was spotless and is beautifully designed, compact and modern. It has an elegant and upscale feel. Location is very good, close to everything. It is a quiet street, although still very close to galataport, istiklal, karakoy and galata tower. There is a nice community playground nearby for those traveling with kids.
Our host Olga was very nice, responsive and helpful. Thanks Olga for letting us stay at your place. This has been our favorite stay in Istanbul, we will definitely be booking here again. Highly recommended.

Cute, clean apartment in Istanbul. Apartment is perfect for one or two people. Fully stocked kitchen, easy to cook. Good shower pressure and hot water. Comfortable furniture. Super nice rooftop views and morning vibes. Neighbourhood has tons of cafes and restaurants, and you’re just a short walk to Taksim station. Host was responsive and helped with a noise issue. Thanks!

A clean, modern, quiet, light, comfortable flat. It’s on a nice little street in the lovely Cihangir neighborhood (which has much better food and drink than nearby Istiklal Street) and is close to the metro, tram and ferry. It’s hilly and can be noisy, but that’s Istanbul. And inside the apartment is very quiet. It has everything you need, and it’s a nice place to relax after long days of site seeing. Olga is easy to communicate with and very responsive. Definitely recommend.

Very good location. Apartment is modern and quiet. However we had issues with the security system, hot water running out, and pretty much everything was of poor quality. The towels were paper thin and smelled. The bed and pillows were very uncomfortable. The closet was like playing rubix cube. Stay for the location w poor quality furnishings. I wouldn’t stay again.

description: Greetings to all🙏🌸My basic principle is that you can have a comfortable time in a sweet, clean room with a balcony for two. You can use the rest of the shared areas of the house as you wish during your stay. My Maltipoo dog lives in the house. Smoking is allowed on the balcony and at the table in front of the kitchen window. I will try to help you with anything you want to ask me. I am a harmonious, comfortable, clean, tidy person and I will be happy to host you🌸Thank you.

reviews.text:
I used Semra's place several times and it is my go to place in Istanbul when available. Semra is a great host, very helpful.
The location is just perfect, next to a major public transportation hub to get to all over Istanbul and steps away from great fun atmosphere of Kadikoy, and yet surprisingly quite when you are in the house.
The room is cosy, has great set up and everything I'd need in a place during my stay is right in front of me. The bed is comfortable, the sheets and towels are clean.
The entire house is squeaky clean (no joke). The kitchen is full of everything you need for cooking and serving. The living room is full of windows and gets all the light during the day.
Not for me but the only con for some may be is the apartment is on the third floor and there is no elevator in the building.
I highly recommend Semra's place.

Semra’s place is an amazing base from which to explore Kadıköy, or the rest of Istanbul. It’s well located near Söğütlüçeşme station for metrobus or marmaray, and an easy 20-ish min walk to Kadıköy station for the M4 metro or ferries. Plus you have the neighborhood of Kadıköy right on the doorstep, for charming streets and a plethora of cafes, bars, and restaurants.
The place itself was very comfortable, with a private room, shared bathroom, and shared living spaces. Semra kindly showed me the kitchen, but I wasn’t there long enough to use it.
A couple small notes, in case mobility is an issue for anyone: It is a walk up requiring a few flights of stairs. The building door also jammed on me, but ultimately turned out I was being too gentle - more force was the answer.
Finally, I must shout out Bili the dog (unsure if that’s spelt right), who was the sweetest and most charming host!

Thank u Semra for being a responsive and hospitable host! Though we arrive late, she’s waiting for us at home and gives us a detailed room tour. Every time I have questions, she responses quickly.
The location is fabulous, which is 5 minutes close to the bus station, and you can easily find restaurants and grocery stores nearby. However, it is still a quiet place, because the bedroom face towards a forest. Everything in the room is clean and cozy, me and my girlfriend love the decorations and it’s just feels like home.
The only thing I need to claim is that the curtain in the bedroom was not the thick one, so the light is easily get in and we wake up early in the morning, but it’s not a big deal because the bed is really comfortable. I’m sure I have a good rest.
All in all, it’s a great value-for-money and sweet home! Highly recommend!
PS: I’m really excited about the doggie Billy, but we didn’t meet her so I think I should book again!

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as described – clean, cozy, and in a great location. The host was very kind and responsive, always ready to help. I felt very comfortable and safe during my stay.
Thank you so much – I would definitely come back again and recommend it to others!

We had a great stay in Istanbul! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a perfect location — close to shops, cafes, and public transport. Everything looked just like the photos, and check-in was smooth. Semra was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Istanbul!

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this quiet, centrally located place.

You are in Istanbul's favorite Taksim.

Welcome to Taksim, the heart of many historical and entertainment venues.

You are in the most central position for your visit to Istanbul to be full and to get to know this magical city.

reviews.text: Ali is a great host !! the location is in the heart of istanbul! MIni Market at 50 meters. Quiet neighborhood! everything is on walking distance and the place was very very clean ! always had hot water and the heating always was on !!! everything perfect as described !! will come back !!

Had a great experience staying at this Airbnb! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made sure everything went smoothly. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a hassle-free stay!

Check-in is simple, and communication with the host is good.
The nearest cafes are less than 100 meters away, shops are also around the block.
The accommodation is comfortable, however, for the kitchen, I thought there would be at least a small stove or a microwave to warm something up.
It was normal for a 2-week stay, shorter periods should be perfect.
Overall, I liked it.

I would like to thank Muhammet for his kidness and his smile.Everything was as described.Such a beautiful apartment .Clean and decent.
Taksim is 7 minutes walk from the easy neighbourhood.
I wish him all the best.
