description: The perfect place for our guests to fully enjoy the Istanbul experience! Luxurious accommodation in a stylish building right next to Taksim Square, with all the building facilities including a gym, pool, sauna and much more! The building is like a hotel with a very well-designed, beautiful reception area and 24/7 security. Discover the spirit of the city in Taksim's lively atmosphere with our modern, comfortable apartment with all amenities.

reviews.text: This place was the perfect amount of secluded from the noise of the tourist areas. It's walkable or very accessible from the tram. There are many restaurants in the area especially local restaurants and bakeries owned by families. The Sheraton is close by. The apartment itself is equipped with heat(we went in December) has a balcony, all the amenities you could need in the kitchen and even some welcome packages for the bathroom! There is also a pool, sauna and Hammam in the building.

Great place to stay! Felt comfortable and enjoyed the pool and sauna especially. The room was clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Location was alright; it was a 15 min walk to Taksim square so not too bad. It is just as described in the profile so you know what to expect. I would recommend this place to other people :)

Tevfik and Melike are excellent hosts and extremely accommodating. Their place genuinely felt like home, with a super comfortable bed and a very positive vibe. Benesta's location is perfect—just a short 10-minute drive to all popular spots in town, yet peaceful, which is hard to find in Istanbul. Based on our excellent experience, I would definitely recommend staying here.

The place is situated in a building that has a wellness area, with spa, pool and gym.
Felt private and easy to reach if you want to be near taksim.
The only downside we could find is that the Wifi was pretty poor, therefore you need to prepare to have mobile data beforehand. It also disconnected randomly
We loved our stay, the place was nice and clean. The communication with the host was excellent, she was replying instantly.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. Pool and parking available, inside the compound, unique

reviews.text: Temmuz 2026 tarihinde 5 kişi konakladığımız bu dairede çoğu şeyden memnun kaldık. Öncelikle giriş kolay ve hızlıydı,kapı girişinde görevli vardı yardımcı oldu.Konumunu beğendik yürüyerek plaja 10-15 dk uzaklıkta, arabayla 3-5 dk fakat ulaşım araba ile haftasonu trafiğinde zor olabiliyor.Dairenin bulunduğu siteden çok memnun kaldık insanlar dost canlısı ve tatlılardı.Güvenilir ve huzurlu bir site.Havuz bakımı gibi konularda iyiydi.Mangal yapma yerleri oldukça yeterliydi.Vakit geçirilebilecek bir ortam.Daire eski bir daire değil,oda sayısı ve yatak sayısı 5 kişi için yeterliydi.Temizlik konusunda pek memnun kalamadık,ortalamaydı. Banyolar temizdi fakat yerler,perdeler,nevresimler konusunda temiz hissedemedik. Perdeler tozlu gibi, yerler çıplak ayakla asla gezilecek ev hissiyatını veremedi açıkçası. Nevresim konusunda hiç memnun kalamadık ne yazıkki ağır koku vardı. Mutfak bulaşıkları bize yeterli ve temiz gelmedi.Ev sahibi yeterince hızlı dönüş yaptı, emeği için teşekkür ediyoruz.

I recently booked this apartment in this beautiful city, and while the location and surroundings were stunning, the apartment itself was a major disappointment. The furniture was very dirty, and the blankets and pillows were so filthy they couldn't be used—absolutely disgusting. To make matters worse, there were no basics provided, not even salt, sugar, or cleaning appliances. The internet was inexplicably switched off from 11 pm to 10 am, adding to the inconvenience.
We arrived late in the evening and had to cover everything with our own clothes just to sleep. Early the next morning, we had to drive into the city to buy our own blankets, pillows, covers, and other essentials. Although the host responded to messages, they only kept us waiting and never provided anything we requested.
Overall, this stay was highly disappointing, and I would not recommend it to anyone. The beautiful city deserves better accommodations.
We will go back to the city and recommend it but not with Airbn

Köpeğimizle birlikte, kendi evimizin rahatlığında ,huzurlu sakin bir tatil geçirdik.Ev çok kullanışlı ve güvenliydi.Site içinde ,yürüme alanları,havuzu,bahçesi ..güzel imkanları vardı.İlçe merkezine,marketlere yakındı.Sakin ama merkeze yakın bir tatil için doğru adresti.Ev sahibi Doğan bey sorularımıza hemen cevap verdi,iletişimi kuvvetli ve yardımseverdi.Şile tatilleri için aklımıza yazdık.

The place is as the the pictures. But the Pool on the pictures is not ready for use, it is dirty. Most amenities work, but you hav.e to phone sometimes to get it to work. I our case the gaz for the cooker and the TV. But Dogun responds quickly and accurate!
Apartment was very dirty and all furnitures different from pictures. And to much smell.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place. Experience lakeside living and Marmara sea view.Sega of Istanbul apartment is brand new complex close to metro station 12 minutes walk off the lake to the Marmary metro stations which makes it easier to reach anywhere in Istanbul, city park, lots of activities for kids and adults to do in the area enjoy nearby restaurants, cozy cafes by the lake, playgrounds, supermarket and stores within a minute walk

reviews.text:
The Host is very friendly, responsive and helpful, the place is family friendly and children have places to play. Many restaurants are nearby and beautiful walk side close to water. Nice view from apartment as you can see in the pictures.
We stayed around one month from middle of July until mid August and did not face problem. Just little hot in bedrooms that was just an issue in July month and loud mosque close by.

Our stay at Ali's apartment was great. The apartment itself is charming and comfortable. At night, there is a magnificent view of the city. Grocery store, bakery, and cafes are within walking distance. The host responds to messages instantly.

Ali proved to be an exceptional host, ensuring our stay was delightful with his prompt responsiveness and attention to detail. The location, with its stunning lake view and nearby amenities like restaurants and trails, added to the tranquility of our experience! I highly recommend both the place and Ali as the host.

Newly constructed and impeccably maintained apartment, clean, fully furnished with all amenities in a modern, newly built tower.
The view from the 13th floor was breathtaking and impressive.
There are two subway stations within a twenty-minute walk from the apartment.
The supermarket and local businesses nearby make it unnecessary to travel to the city for daily needs.
The only downside is that the subway ride to the city center (Taksim Square) takes about an hour.

Ali was a great host, responsive and friendly
The views were beautiful . The house was very clean.
Very good level of security. Our family felt very safe
We really enjoyed our stay and will go back if we are in Istanbul

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. Metropol Istanbul Residence, ultra-luxurious Residence with a shopping mall

reviews.text:
Can’s place was amazing. I attended an event at Dasdas, and the location was the best for it. There is big supermarket, shopping mall and restaurants just minutes of walking distance.
Can was super helpful, always reply my questions and help me with lots of problem, even gave me his travel card to take the bus.
Would highly recommend and hopefully will be back next time😀

description:
The space
Our suits are very central in Taksim. It is 300 meters away from Taksim square. Our suits are furnished and have comfortable real bed, full equipped kitchen and equipped bathroom. There is free wireless internet connection and cable tv. The suits are heated and has air conditioning.

You can find almost everything around. It takes only 5 minutes walking to istiklal street, which is Istanbul's most famous tourist spot with lots of cafes, restaurants presenting ottoman and turkish cuisine. Taksim or istiklal street has also very active night life from traditional turkish nights to electronic clubs. It is aslo very easy to come back home late. If you like history you can go to historical peninsula or Old Istanbul. It takes about 20 mins with public transportation. In historical peninsula you can see the Ottoman and Byzantine architecture such as Sultanahmet Camii(Blue Mosque), Topkapi Palace and Hagia Sophia.

Our suits are 450 m away from Tak

reviews.text:
We spent a week at Safa's place and we had a real good time.
The flat is very well located, near Taksim (5 mn walk), in the very nice area of Beyoglu where you will find everything you need : bars, restaurants, shops. You can do a lot of thing walking and metro is very near if you need it. You have 2 small supermarket downstairs if you need anything.
The flat is nice, comfortable, clean and similar to pictures.
Safa is a very good host, talkative and friendly and very reactive in communication.
I highly recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again when I'll be back to wonderful Istanbul!

We had a wonderful stay at Safa's place. It's actually a hotel. Omar (the receptionist) was always available to help. He assisted with arranging the airport transfer there and back. The location is great. I liked that there were little grocery shops opposite the hotel. There is always someone available at the reception. We were there for 10 days. On 2 occasations I asked for the room to be cleaned and it was arranged by Omar. Any questions I had were answered immediately. I always appreciate a place with a washing machine and it's worth mentioning that the shower was also great. The one discrepancy is that there is one queen bed and not 2 single beds. The photos need to be updated. My room also has a double sleeper couch and a single sleeper couch so we still had 2 beds.

Safa is your man in Istanbul.
Extremely kind and always willing to help.
The rest of the stuff is excellent too.
The place is as described. Spacious and well equiped.
The location is great, regards ghr in the heart of Istanbul , but in a quiet and safe street.
Minor things such as a tv set with sound problems and no cleaning services (at least for the 4 nights we stayed) are nothing comparing to those guys kindness.
Let me say that Safa book a private parking for my car and came by to deal a better price , right there in the heart of the city.
Recommended 100%.

Safa was very nice and helpful. My stay was great at his stay. The flat is exactly how it is the pictures; and it is very comfortable and it’s got all I needed. The location in Taksim is close to everything and you can do all by walking as I did, if you prefer. Or there’s metro station close if you want to go farther. It’s worth the price and location. I’d deffo come back. Nice experience!

The Airbnb is centrally located near Taksim Square (and the metro, which is super helpful for getting around Istanbul). This is a great option for solo travelers or close friends, as the space is small but comfortable. As a business traveler, the wifi wasn't always reliable which made working a challenge - so just keep that in mind. However, there are some cafes in Taksim Square and the Cihangir neighborhood if you need faster internet. The apartment was great value for money, and Safa was incredibly responsive and willing to help with anything we needed.

description: This prestigious apartment in a recently renovated historic building is located in the famous Galata district, on a peaceful street just 200 meters from the Şişhane metro station. With its high ceilings, elegant furniture and spacious rooms designed by a famous architect, the apartment is equipped with all the necessary appliances and has a large balcony overlooking the Galata Tower. Our professional team will be happy to provide you with 24/7 online concierge service to make your stay comfortable.

reviews.text: Burak was such an attentive and responsive host. He accommodated our request to check in around midnight and greeted us in person. Also, he provided us with extra towels upon request. The street is a bit dirty, but it is walking distance to both Galata and Karaköy. It's very easy to find nice cafes and restaurants nearby. Considering that, the apartment was surprisingly quiet. Even though there was a bar right next door playing loud music, we didn't hear anything at all. It's worth noting it's on the 5th floor without an elevator though. However, I gave it a 4 star because of the cleanliness. Bathroom especially was not very well cleaned --there were shaved hairs of a previous guest and the shower was heavily clogged. The shower box could not sustain water and after each shower we would have a wet bathroom floor, which I found very uncomfortable. Burak was nice enough to get the apartment cleaned again, but unfortunately it did not improve the situation much.

Prime location but too basic for the price. The apartment is very well located and close to galata tower and the tram station. But the pictures are much prettier than reality, the apartment is only basically equipped. The bedroom is comfortable but there could be more than 2 hangers for clothes and a proper bed stand to put your stuff. For the kitchen, it’s missing stuff for you to prepare a basic meal, like a knife, cooking spoons and a kitchen towel. Also the balcony is not locked and it could be entered from the outside or the apartment next door, that wasn’t very pleasant. Note: It’s a 4th floor with no elevator.

Very close to the tower, you can see it from the balcony. There’s a very short walk to all the hustle and bustle, but it’s very calm and quiet around the apartment which we loved. The bed is very comfortable and the bathroom is clean and nice. Burek was incredibly responsive and kindly accommodated a late checkout for us. Some reviews said smaller than the photos, but I think it’s represented well. Works perfectly for a couple traveling. Great water pressure in the shower and great kitchen necessities. Would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay here. The apartment feels bigger than the photos and the terrace is especially lovely and very private. It was very clean, had amenities like coffee, and the shower was great! You do have to climb up a hill to reach the entrance and it is on the top floor up 4 sets of stairs, which was fine for us but worth noting. Overall we loved the place and felt it was really good value and would stay again.

This was one of the best apartments I’ve stayed in. Aside from a small misunderstanding about early check-in (which was quickly solved), everything was great. Here’s what I thought:
Pros:
- short walking distance to everything you need, including public transport
- Burak is very friendly and will really help you with anything.
- Beautiful views on both sides
- Very quiet, almost no noise from streets or other apartments.
- Hot water and shower is incredible.
- Everything is very comfortable
- No smoke or strange smells at all in the apartment
Small cons:
- there were a few essentials missing (like dish soap), but I restocked a lot myself.
- If you have a fine eye for cleanliness, you’ll see that things aren’t perfect, but it’s still totally adequate.
- I think almost the whole building is airbnb, this is common, so it feels a little like a hotel with only yabancılar rather than hiding away in a local apartment. Not a big deal, and had no effect on me, but just a vibe preference :)

description:
Historic 4-story townhouse (c.1905) designed for large groups: 8 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms + 4 kitchens, high ceilings, air conditioning in every room.
Garden level with chef-ready kitchen, 18-seat dining, and private garden; upper floors have balconies and flexible sleeping incl. divans + 2 portable singles.
Fast Wi-Fi, hotel-clean. Self check-in (keypad + lockboxes).
Central Şişli: 3 min to Osmanbey metro, 8 min to Nişantaşı; natural-gas heating, 24/7 hot water.

reviews.text: The house was described very accurately and is great for larger groups. The separate floors offer plenty of privacy while still having communal spaces to spend time together. The location is good, everything was clean, and communication with the host was smooth and reliable. We had a great stay and would definitely recommend it.

28 ocak-1 şubat tarihleri arasında 4 aile 4 günlük bir konaklama yaptık. İlandan görüp beğendiğimiz ev konusunda biraz tereddütlerimiz vardı ancak evi görünce hepsi ortadan kalktı. Ev tertemizdi, her şey düşünülmüştü, 8 yetişkin ve 8 çocuk evimizde gibi rahat ettik. Bodrum kat biraz nemliydi ama bodrum katta bulunan mutfak ve yemek alanı çok kullanışlıydı. Hal böyle olunca tüm sabah kahvaltılarımızı evde yaptık. Marketlere çok yakındı. 10 metre yakınında otopark var, gece de aracınız kalıyor tabi anahtar bırakıyorsunuz,günlüğüne 700 lira verdik. Metroya yürüme mesafesindeydi, toplu taşımayla her yere rahatça ulaştık. Evde doğalgaz olması da çok güzel, ev sıcacıktı, banyodan akan suyun tazyiki çok yeterliydi. Çamaşır makinası, bulaşık makinası ve deterjanlarına kadar her şey düşünülmüştü.2. Katta bulunan oturma odasında 8 yetişkin rahatça oturduk. Muhit güzeldi, sokak sesi gürültüsü yoktu. Aileler için mükemmel, şiddetle tavsiye ederim.Ev sahibine de ayrıca çok teşekkür ederim.

Owner was very friendly and location was good. The building was renovated so it looked clean and nice. But the 1st floor was basement. There were not clean air so it was humid. There were many red fly bugs at 1st floor bed room. And also 1st floor bed had a lot of bed bugs. I couldn’t sleep at 1st floor. 1st floor’s restroom didn’t have a good ventilation so it was very humid, bad smell, and not clean. Other floors were fine. (Hot shower didn’t work sometimes though) the owner was friendly so I hope they will fix all of issues.

We had an amazing stay at this house! It had everything we needed and even more. We were a group of 12 people, and the space was perfect for all of us – spacious, comfortable, and very well equipped. The house was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was helpful and easy to communicate with.
Top, top, top stay — highly recommended!

We had a great stay at the house, which was perfectly suited to our large family. The owners were very responsive and helpful; whenever I messaged them, they replied promptly and were always happy to assist. Check-in and check-out were also very straightforward and easy.
Before our stay, I asked if the house could have some extra cleaning as three of us have asthma. When we arrived, we could see that this had been taken into consideration, and the house was very clean, which we really appreciated.
The only small issue we had was with a cat that lives in the garden. We weren’t aware beforehand that the cat was always there. Unfortunately, the cat was unwell and had diarrhoea, which meant that we didn’t feel comfortable using the garden during our stay. This was a shame as the garden was one of the best features of the house.
I should mention that I didn’t raise this issue with the owner during our stay, as we simply decided to leave the cat there and manage the situation ourselves.

description:
Located in Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museums, theaters, concert halls and cinemas, this duplex unit is waiting to welcome its new guests. It is within walking distance to places such as Taksim, Şişli and Nişantaşı.

High speed Wi-Fi available.
Elevator, parking, 24/7 security, reception.
New & High quality furniture.
You can enjoy cityview from your own balcony and terrace.
Please kindly check all photos for details.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text:
We stayed here for 4 days as a group of 3 and had a very pleasant experience. The host was friendly, responsive, and always willing to help when needed. The apartment was clean, tidy, and exactly as described. We also appreciated having an extra bed available, which made our stay more comfortable.
The bathrooms were very clean, and both the balcony and terrace were great places to relax. The neighborhood was quiet and pleasant. One thing to note is that getting around is a bit easier if you have a car, so we would recommend driving if possible.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to others 🙂
Such an amazing place to stay in, it was clean, lots of amenities provided. Also good facilitated apartment with a gym and sauna. Definitely worth the price, would love to go back!

description:
This lovely Stylish Historical 4-floors House to stay is perfect for group trips

This 4-floor Townhouse boasts kitchenettes, mini- Ifridges, full bathrooms on each floor with showers, & Air Conditioners on all levels. The top floor is perfect for gatherings, complete with a fully- equipped kitchen, dining & seating area, and a charming terrace. The ground floor features a private back garden equipped with 2 swings and a Sun

reviews.text: The host was so nice and incredibly responsive. The location was amazing. Really close to Galata Tower. As a budget stay, it makes sense! However, the photos don’t really reflect the reality of the place. It’s small, so fitting 12 people is challenging. It has three bathrooms, one of which doesn’t have an independent shower (it’s a part of the same bathroom space) and has a very weird smell, the one in the basement is pretty dirty and we all had to shower in one of the three bathrooms. Overall okay property. I just didn’t think it corresponded to the reviews I saw on Airbnb.

We had an amazing stay at this spacious 6-bedroom apartment in Istanbul! The place was exactly as described, large, comfortable, and perfect for a group. The host was exceptionally friendly and helpful throughout our stay. He made sure we had everything we needed and went above and beyond to assist us.
The apartment was clean, well-equipped, and located in a convenient area, making it easy to explore the city. If you're looking for a great place with a reliable and accommodating host, I highly recommend this apartment! Would definitely stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay at the house. The host was very hospitable and helpful. The house was neat and clean.
The only points to mention were that the house and rooms are a little smaller than expected from the pictures. The living room is on the top floor and the only space for everyone to gather and being a large group of 14, it was a little tight. The hot water shut off one night but the host came and fixed it.
But overall we were satisfied with our time there.

We had a such a pleasant stay here. We are family of 10 with 3 kids and the Airbnb could accommodate us comfortable.
